title: Senior Partner Engineer
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV 

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

About the team 

The Partner Engineering team’s vision is to establish Roku as the preferred platform of choice for our partners (media companies) to distribute and monetize their content globally. The Partner Engineering team’s mission is to be the technical advocate and point of contact for the Partner’s Engineering organization within Roku to help them deliver the best content viewing experience globally for the Roku user community. On a day-to-day basis, we work with engineers from partners organization to help them develop, test, certify, and launch partners direct-to-consumer (DTC) apps in compliance with the Roku platform distribution agreement. We represent partners’ roadmap and technical needs by working cross-functionally with the assigned Partner Engagement Managers, product and engineering teams within Roku. 

About the role 

Roku's platform is live across the multiple European countries, and our European footprint is growing — through Roku TV licensing partners, through our own streaming hardware, and through the local broadcasters and streaming services that make the platform worth owning in each market. 

You will be the senior engineer for our European partners: the person who makes their apps fast, stable and certifiable on Roku, who represents their technical constraints to our platform and OS teams, and who makes each new market launch a technical success rather than a scramble. 

You will be the engineer for a portfolio of European partners — public service and commercial broadcasters, subscription streaming services and pay-TV operators — working with the Partner Engineering team in San Jose and with the Partner Engagement Manager in London who owns those partners’ relationships. You will debug crashes, memory and launch-time issues, diagnose partner-reported streaming problems, and give your partners hands-on support through Roku certification. 

How you’ll work with the Partner Engagement Manager. The Partner Engagement Manager from Roku owns the partner relationship, the launch plan and timeline, partner priorities, and communication during incidents. You own the technical diagnosis, the integration work, and technical sign-off on certification and launch readiness, working engineer to engineer with the partner’s technical team. When something breaks, the Partner Engagement Manager coordinates the response and keeps the partner informed; you find the root cause and the path to a fix. 

Level: Senior individual contributor, with no direct reports. 

Reports to: Director, Partner Engineering, based in San Jose. 

Location and work arrangement: London, UK, in the office Monday to Thursday, with flexible Fridays. Travel within Europe up to 40% of your time. Regular late-afternoon calls with San Jose, whose working day starts at 4pm UK time. 

On-call: For major partner launches and live events, the Partner Engagement Manager is the on-call escalation point and brings this role in for technical diagnosis, which can mean occasional work outside normal hours. 

Expected impact: European partners’ apps pass certification and launch without technical surprises. Additionally, you’ll own the stability, performance and engagement metrics for your partners' apps, and keep each at or better than its benchmark: Roku's certification thresholds and the best-performing apps on the platform. 

- Stability: crash rate, unexpected app closures and out-of-memory terminations 

- Performance: launch time, video start time, video start and playback failures, and rebuffering 

- Engagement: streaming hours per subscriber 

- App Certification and public release: time from technical onboarding to launch in each new market 

- Incidents: platform-caused incidents affecting your partners' apps, and time to resolve them 

What you'll do 

European market expansion 

- Sign off the technical readiness of each new market launch. The Partner Engagement Manager owns the launch plan and timeline; you work with Channel Publishing and Certification to get global and local broadcasters and streaming services onto the platform ahead of a market opening — scoping integrations, running technical onboarding, and clearing the issues that would otherwise surface on launch day. Then write down what “technically ready” meant for that market, so the next launch is faster and cheaper. 

- Represent regional technical requirements inside Roku engineering. European partners hit constraints that do not exist in North America: built-in broadcast TV tuners on Roku TVs, accessibility obligations, rules on how prominently European content is shown, privacy rules for viewing data, and regional differences in content protection and delivery. You will work out what each means technically, and turn it into concrete platform requirements, feature requests and firmware bugs — and follow them to resolution. You don’t need to be an expert in each regulation but should be capable to work cross-functionally with Roku legal, product, engineering to drive these requests to resolution, 

- Help European partners integrate Roku Pay, working with Roku technical teams: you advise partners on their integration, debug it, and test European purchase flows for multi-currency pricing, VAT and invoicing expectations, strong customer authentication (PSD2/SCA) at purchase and re-authentication, and local payment method coverage. 

- Resolve platform issues on Roku TV and operator devices in Europe. When a TV maker’s or operator’s hardware makes partner apps misbehave, you reproduce the problem, measure which devices and apps it affects, and work it to a fix with Roku engineering teams. 

Core Partner Engineering 

- Diagnose and resolve partner app defects end to end — BrightScript/SceneGraph and TypeScript crashes, memory pressure, launch-time and playback-start regressions, general performance problems, and Roku Search integration issues. When the cause is in the partner’s app, you agree the fix with their engineers, who change their own code; you prototype or suggest the patch where it helps. When it’s in the Roku platform, you file it with a reproducible case and work the fix with the team that owns it. 

- Debug streaming and playback problems across DASH and HLS, from manifest and DRM issues to playback problems on physical hardware. 

- Drive adoption of AI-assisted app development to lower partners' total cost of building on Roku. Help partners' engineers use AI coding assistants with Roku's developer tools to build, debug and certify apps faster, feed what you learn back into those tools, and measure the savings in time to certify and engineering effort per release. 

- Get partner apps through Roku certification. When an app fails on launch time, memory, crash rate or playback, you find the root cause and agree the fix with the partner’s engineers, rather than relaying the result. Roku’s certification team runs the review; you give the technical sign-off that the app is ready. 

- Own the technical side of partner escalations from first report to resolution, finding the root cause and driving the fix with the firmware, media, platform and channel publishing teams, and keeping the Partner Engagement Manager and the partner’s engineers informed. 

What success looks like in your first year 

- By 90 days: you’re the engineer for a portfolio of European partners, can debug and profile their apps on your own, and have taken at least one partner defect from first report to root cause. 

- By 6 months: European partners ask for you by name. You have carried a certification escalation to resolution and turned at least one European constraint into platform work that Roku engineering is delivering. 

- By 12 months: you have signed off the technical readiness of a new market launch or a major Roku TV partnership, your partners’ apps stay within Roku’s thresholds for launch time, memory and crash rate, and the market-readiness playbook you wrote is what the next engineer uses. 

What we're looking for 

Required 

- 7+ years in software engineering, with meaningful time spent debugging and optimizing applications on constrained or embedded platforms — smart TV, set-top box, mobile or games console. 

- Proven AI-assisted coding experience: regular, hands-on use of AI coding tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode) in real development work, with specific examples of AI tools used in production workflows. 

- Strong practical debugging skill: you are comfortable taking an ambiguous “the app is slow on this TV” report and working it down to a root cause with logs, traces and telemetry. 

- Working knowledge of adaptive streaming — DASH and/or HLS — and the failure modes around manifests, DRM and fMP4 playback. 

- Experience in a partner-, customer- or developer-facing engineering role, with the judgement to know what to share, when to escalate, and how to say no to an external stakeholder without damaging the relationship. 

- Comfort with data: SQL against large telemetry datasets, and a habit of quantifying impact before proposing a fix. 

- Proficiency in at least one of C/C++, Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, and willingness to become fluent in BrightScript. 

- Based in or able to work from our London office Monday to Thursday, with availability to travel within Europe up to 40% of the time. 

Strongly preferred 

- Direct experience with European broadcast or streaming: working at or with a public service broadcaster, commercial broadcaster, European subscription streaming service, or pay-TV operator. 

- Familiarity with European platform and regulatory context — DVB and HbbTV broadcast standards, the European Accessibility Act, the Audiovisual Media Services Directive (AVMSD), GDPR as it applies to viewing data, or strong customer authentication (PSD2/SCA) in payment flows. 

- Experience launching a product or platform into a new country or region, with exposure to the technical, regulatory and partner-onboarding work that involves. 

- Professional working proficiency in a second European language — German, French or Spanish are the most immediately useful. 

- Prior work on smart TV platforms, embedded Linux, or media pipelines.

How to be successful in this role: 

- 7+ years in a full-cycle, quota-carrying closing role, with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding monthly and quarterly targets

- Fluency in English and French

- Experience partnering cross-functionally with partnerships and marketing to build brand presence in a new market

- Proven experience self-sourcing pipeline through outbound prospecting and cold calling into Upmarket accounts

- Strong background in B2B SaaS, with experience across EMEA and Upmarket segments

- Highly empathetic to customers and skilled at building long-term relationships that drive retention

- Technically fluent enough to understand Vanta's software and build credibility with technical stakeholders and decision-makers

- Exceptional problem-solver with a passion for making an impact in a fast-moving, high-growth environment

- Comfortable managing multiple deals simultaneously with varying deal complexity and stakeholder involvement

- Curious, resourceful, and energized by building in ambiguous, fast-paced startup environments

What you can expect as a Vanta’n: 

- Industry-competitive salary and equity

- 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

- 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend

- Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

- Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

#LI-hybrid

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

description:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

The Opportunity 

Internal communications at Multiverse isn't a downstream function. It's a strategic one.

You'll own the story Multiverse tells itself — making sure every colleague understands who we are, why it matters, and where we're going. That means shaping All Hands, advising the exec team, translating data into narratives people can actually repeat, and building the rhythms that keep colleagues informed week to week — not just when something big happens.

If you want to own the internal narrative of one of the most ambitious companies in the UK skills and AI space — this is the role.

Specifically, you will

- Own the internal FAQ and "what to say if asked" resources that equip every colleague to be an informed and confident ambassador for the business

- Take editorial ownership of All Hands: theme, narrative arc, content commissioning, and speaker preparation, ensuring it consistently moves the needle on alignment and energy

- Support our Exec team with internal-facing communications - town halls, written updates, video messages - ensuring tone and content are consistent with our external narrative

- Build a rhythm of regular leadership communication that doesn't only happen at All Hands, so colleagues feel informed week-to-week, not just quarter-to-quarter

- Own the content programme that tells the employee story: learner outcomes, team culture, career progression, mission moments, taking guidance and inspiration from the EVP and aligning with priority recruitment marketing campaigns where required

- Partner with the People team on key cultural moments so messaging is coherent and consistently on-brand

- Own and optimise our internal channels (Slack, intranet, email newsletters), deciding what goes where, at what frequency, and in what format, and build measurement into the channel strategy through open rates, engagement, and feedback loops

- Work hand-in-hand with Data & Insights and the wider Comms team to translate internal performance data into narratives that colleagues can understand, use, and repeat

- Build a simple framework for measuring whether internal comms is working — do people feel informed, do they understand the strategy, can they articulate the narrative — and report quarterly to the Director of Communications on channel health and narrative consistency

About you 

- You embody the mission. You believe in equipping workers to win in the AI era, and you want every colleague to feel that purpose in how they show up at work

- You have hands-on experience leading internal communications in a fast-moving, complex organisation, and you've owned narrative, channels, and leadership comms

- You understand that internal comms is not a downstream function. You sit at the intersection of Data & Insights, Product, and external Comms

- You're a strong, instinctive writer and editor, able to sharpen a leadership message, a town hall script, or a sensitive change announcement with equal confidence

- You know how to translate data into story: you can take customer ROI evidence, learner outcomes, or operational performance figures and turn them into something every Multiverser can articulate and believe in

- You're fluent in AI tools and use them to move faster and think bigger, but you apply rigorous human judgement to everything that goes out under Multiverse's name

- You're calm and clear-headed under pressure: comfortable drafting sensitive internal communications in real time when external scrutiny spikes, and confident telling leadership what needs to be said and when

- You're operationally strong on channels - Slack, intranet, email

- You partner well with senior leaders: you can hold your own in a room with the exec team, give honest counsel on tone and timing, and earn trust quickly

- You thrive in networked organisations, collaborating fluidly with People, Product, Tech, Data & Insights, and the wider Comms team

- You see All Hands and leadership comms as strategic levers, not logistical exercises, and you have a track record of using them to drive genuine alignment

Benefits 

- Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

- Health & Wellness - private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

- Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

- Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

- Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked! 

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here .

Our Commitment to Safeguarding 

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy , our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. This is a visible senior role requiring strong technical expertise, commercial judgement and the confidence to influence and constructively challenge senior stakeholders.

- Deputise for the UK CFO, including supporting interactions with the Board and Executive Committee.

- Experience of regulatory and prudential requirements, including PRA and FCA frameworks, ICAAP, ILAAP, and recovery and resolution planning.

- Experience working within a regulated UK banking environment.

- Strong budgeting, forecasting, performance analysis and business-case development skills.

- Experience working effectively across a matrix organisation.

- Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the confidence to engage and constructively challenge at Board and Executive level.

title: Customer Success Manager - Enterprise
description:
About Hiya 

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

About the Role 

You’ll own a portfolio of Hiya’s largest enterprise customers across the UK and Europe, with full accountability for retention, renewals and expansion. As a trusted adviser to their senior leaders, you’ll prove the measurable value of Hiya Connect and grow each account over time. You’ll work closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product and Hiya’s leadership team.

You’ll need fluent English and business-level proficiency in at least one of French, Spanish or German, as you’ll manage many of your European accounts in those languages.

What You'll Do 

- Own 20–25 strategic enterprise accounts across the UK and Europe. You’ll be accountable for gross and net revenue retention, renewals and expansion.

- Build executive relationships from Director to C-level, working across customer experience, contact centre, marketing, fraud, security and procurement.

- Develop strategic account plans that map each customer’s objectives, success metrics, buying centres and whitespace into a clear growth roadmap.

- Lead executive and quarterly business reviews that quantify return on investment (ROI), such as answer-rate uplift, contact-centre efficiency and fraud reduction, and agree next priorities.

- Run complex renewals and multi-year negotiations covering pricing, contract structure, procurement, legal and security, and forecast them accurately in the CRM.

- Partner with Sales and Solutions Engineering to find and close expansion across new business units, geographies, use cases and Hiya products.

- Spot risk early through usage, health and relationship signals. Turn customer insight into clear input for Product, Engineering and Marketing.

What We Are Looking For 

- Typically 5+ years in customer success, strategic account management or enterprise account management at a B2B SaaS or technology company

- Fluent English plus business-level proficiency in at least one of French, Spanish or German, with the confidence to lead executive conversations, renewals and commercial negotiations in that language

- A track record of owning and growing large, complex enterprise accounts, including six- or seven-figure renewals and expansions against a net revenue retention (NRR) or quota target

- Experience influencing senior executives and working through large organisations with many stakeholders

- Strong commercial sense: you can build a value case, lead a negotiation and link product capabilities to a customer’s financial and operational outcomes

- Experience creating and running strategic account plans and executive business reviews

You’ll Likely Stand Out If You Have 

- Experience managing enterprise customers in regulated industries such as financial services, insurance, telecoms, utilities or healthcare, ideally across several European countries

- A background in communications technology, CPaaS, contact-centre solutions, caller ID, fraud prevention or conversation intelligence

- Working knowledge of UK and EU regulation on caller ID, spam and fraud

- A record of turning customer feedback into product or go-to-market improvements

How We Work 

Hiya is not a passive environment. We expect people to take ownership, form opinions, and engage directly with hard problems.

We work with a high degree of transparency and autonomy . Context is shared openly, and decisions are discussed, challenged, and then made. Once a call is made, we commit and move forward.

You'll be expected to work through ambiguity, weigh tradeoffs, and take responsibility for results, while keeping a high bar for quality and customer trust.

Every team member at Hiya is expected to live our core values:

- Serve, our customers and partners by holding a high bar for trust and quality

- Own, share in success and open up to failures

- Lead, listen, show up with a point of view but commit entirely once a decision has been made

- Improve, even if it means changing course or contradicting ourselves

- Do, rather than observe

How We Invest in You 

Compensation & Ownership
Equity Compensation: ownership aligned with your impact and the company's growth

We offer an L&D budget to support your growth and real internal mobility so career pathing isn't just a talking point — because we're building this with people who own the outcome.

Come Work With Us! 

We're building a team with diverse perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. We evaluate candidates through a business lens and believe that diversity and unique viewpoints make our company stronger, more dynamic, and a great place to build a career.

We've been recognized by Built In, GeekWire, Comparably, G2, Forbes, and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for our culture, innovation, leadership, compensation, and more. At Hiya, we're a people-centric company focused on helping each employee grow both personally and professionally. We create a culture of support and empowerment that challenges the status quo, resulting in an energized team that's passionate about their work. You'll love working here if you're looking for an innovative challenge that's disrupting an industry. Come join us!

Hiya is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Revenue Enablement Manager
description:

- Build and maintain a unified global curriculum with clear applications for Mid-Tier and Enterprise motions, balancing global consistency with necessary regional adaptations.

- Translate field needs into clear learning outcomes, facilitator guides, practical exercises, and reusable assets.

- Coordinate cohort intake and operational readiness across regional BDR leaders, Sales, People, and Talent Acquisition teams.

- Deliver learning efficiently using a blend of e-learning, virtual sessions, and in-person training (directly or via regional partners).

- Prepare BDRs for future commercial roles (e.g., Sales, Account Management) while managing clear performance-based expectations.

- Analyze cohort performance by region and stage to resolve bottlenecks and optimize delivery.

- Collaborate with regional teams to ensure local market relevance without compromising global standards.

- Transparent Growth: Progression decisions are timely, objective, and grounded in clear competency evidence.

- Measurable Value: Executive leadership receives clear, data-backed insights on cohort health, capability growth, and revenue contribution.

- Scalable Operations: The Academy scales seamlessly across global regions without losing quality or accountability.

What You Bring

- Commercial & Enablement Background: Direct experience in BDR/SDR roles, BDR leadership, Revenue/Sales Enablement, or sales performance program management.

- Program Architecture: Proven track record of designing, running, or scaling structured sales onboarding or development programs with clear milestones.

- Instructional Design & Facilitation: Strong expertise in adult learning principles, workshop facilitation, and turning strategic concepts into practical, engaging training.

- Analytical & Operational Skills: Data-driven mindset with experience using performance metrics and feedback to evaluate programs and drive continuous improvement.

- Tech & AI Positive: Comfortable using modern sales engagement platforms, learning technology, and approved AI tools to enhance productivity.

- Proactive Leadership: Collaborative yet assertive approach—able to operate independently, take full ownership, and advocate for high standards.

Preferred (Nice-to-Have)

- Experience in payments, fintech, SaaS, or complex B2B technology sectors.

- Familiarity with Salesforce, Learning Management Systems (LMS), and sales engagement tools.

- Experience building or administering skills assessments, certification programs, or analytics dashboards.

- Fluency in additional languages relevant to Checkout.com ’s key global markets.

Additional Information

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

title: Application Scientist
description:
About CuspAI 

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us. 

The Role

We hire across a spectrum of backgrounds. Some Application Scientists are computational (atomistic and molecular simulation, machine-learned force fields), some are experimental (synthesis, processing, characterisation, lab automation), and some are data-driven (materials and cheminformatics, optimisation). What they share is the ability to turn a partner’s problem into a plan, deliver it, and translate fluently between experimental, computational, and machine learning teams.

We operate a matrix structure. You will have a home team, but may contribute to projects in another pillar as demand and your expertise evolve.

Your Impact

You will own the scientific delivery of partner projects, from scoping to results. Working with our technical programme managers, ML researchers, platform engineers, and lab integration team, you will make sure our platform answers the questions that matter to partners, and that what is learned on each project feeds back into tools and workflows used across the company.

Alongside delivery, you will help build the cross-cutting capabilities that future projects depend on, such as validated workflows, harmonised data pipelines and agentic design campaigns.

Application Areas

We are particularly interested in candidates with expertise in one or more of the areas below. You do not need to cover a whole pillar.

- Electronics : Semiconductor processing, device-level modelling and electronics, photonic and thermal materials

- Energy : Catalysis, batteries, photovoltaics and multiscale kinetics.

- Environment : Porous and soft materials, interfaces, and separations

- Cross-cutting : Materials informatics, automated experimentation and optimisation.

What You Will Do

Project leadership and delivery

- Lead partner projects from scoping to delivery, as a key point of contact alongside the technical program managers.

- Write technical scopes that define objectives, deliverables, success criteria, and timelines.

- Prepare regular technical reports and presentations for partners and internal teams.

Science and campaigns

- Apply and extend our platform to partner problems, using simulation, machine learning, data-driven optimisation, or experiments as the project requires.

- Design and steer discovery campaigns, including agentic and closed-loop campaigns with partner labs.

- Assess when models, simulations, and data can be trusted, and contribute to validating them against experiments.

Bridging experimental and computational teams

- Translate platform recommendations into clear, executable experimental plans, and translate lab realities back into requirements for internal teams.

- Make sure data from partners and our own workflows are clean, structured, and consistent.

- Work closely with partner labs, including on-site visits at key stages of a project.

Capability and product development

- Build and automate workflows that run reliably at scale within our platform.

- Relay partner feedback to TPMs, ML researchers, and platform engineers to improve tools and workflows.

- Stay informed about advances in your field and contribute to the scientific direction of your team.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications

- A PhD in chemistry, materials science, physics, chemical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.

- Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one of: atomistic simulation (including machine-learned force fields); experimental materials or chemistry, ideally with automation or high-throughput methods; materials or cheminformatics with machine learning and optimisation.

- A track record in one or more of the application areas above.

- Python skills for data handling, analysis, automation or modelling, and familiarity with version control (Git).

- Exceptional ability to communicate with both experimental and computational scientists, and to translate between them.

- A personal passion for CuspAI's mission and the potential of AI to unlock breakthroughs in materials science.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical)

- Industry experience, particularly in the semiconductor, electronics, energy, or chemical sectors.

- Experience leading projects or collaborations with external partners, including writing technical scopes or proposals.

- Experience with multiscale modelling, from atomistic to mesoscale, continuum or device level.

- Practical synthesis or processing experience, with an understanding of what makes a route feasible and reproducible.

- Professional software engineering practice, such as code review, testing and deployment.

- Prior experience in a start-up or fast-growth technology company.

Additional Considerations

These roles can be based in our London, Cambridge, Amsterdam, or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office at least three days per week. There may be regular travel to partner sites and other CuspAI offices for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

- A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

- Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

- Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

- ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

- Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

- Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

- True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other

Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.

Talent Acquisition Recruiter – Maternity Cover 

London | Full time | 4 days in the office + 1 day from home | Approx. 12 months 

At Inditex, recruitment is about much more than filling vacancies.

It’s about connecting with people, spotting potential, understanding our brands and helping candidates find their path with us.

We’re looking for an energetic, creative and proactive Recruiter to join our London Talent Acquisition team and support recruitment across our retail management population in the UK and Ireland.

You’ll need to trust your eye for talent, know how to engage people from the very first conversation and enjoy accompanying candidates through their journey with us — from first contact to contract.

What you’ll be doing 

- Own end-to-end recruitment for retail management positions across the UK and Ireland.

- Proactively identify and connect with talent through LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, Recruitee and new sourcing channels you bring to the table.

- Build relationships with candidates and guide them through their recruitment journey, making sure every interaction feels engaging, personal and transparent.

- Partner closely with HR Managers and Area Managers , understanding their teams, their stores and the talent they need.

- Run one-to-one interviews, group interviews, Recruitment Days and Branding events.

- Visit stores, markets and events to stay connected to what is happening in retail and where the best talent is.

- Build strong talent pipelines before the vacancy even exists.

- Get involved in creative Talent Acquisition projects — from recruitment partnerships and employer branding to talent strategy, corporate projects and digital initiatives.

- Constantly look for better ways to recruit. If one route doesn’t work, you find another.

Who we’re looking for 

You probably have around 2–3 years of recruitment experience within retail and a strong understanding of the UK market.

You’ll also be someone who:

- Has strong experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and genuinely enjoys proactive sourcing.

- Knows how to connect with candidates and turn a first conversation into real interest.

- Has a strong eye for talent and is confident assessing potential, not just matching CVs to job descriptions.

- Understands fashion and retail and is curious about brands, competitors and the market.

- Brings energy, personality and strong communication skills.

- Is confident working with demanding stakeholders and comfortable challenging when needed.

- Thinks outside the box and doesn’t accept “there are no candidates” as the final answer.

- Takes ownership, works autonomously and brings ideas rather than waiting for direction.

- Is organised enough to manage multiple recruitment processes, stakeholders and projects at the same time.

Experience with Recruitee, Indeed or similar recruitment platforms is a plus.

If you love fashion, people and the challenge of finding the right talent — and you want a role where your ideas can genuinely shape how we recruit — we’d love to meet you.

INDINDITEXSM

title: Senior Sales Executive (ME Perform)
description:
Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. Since 1983, we have brought decision-makers together through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms and performance programmes, working across all sectors and regions. 

Our overriding approach is one of collaboration, and our belief that “We’ll be our most successful when we work together.” We recognise excellence and actively develop top performers into future leaders. Our culture promotes teamwork, continuous learning and global career growth. 

About Perform 

Perform by Marcus Evans is our performance-improvement consultancy. We don’t sell off-the-shelf training. We start with a diagnosis of what is actually holding a team or an organisation back, prescribe the programme that fixes it, deliver bespoke learning pathways facilitated by vetted trainers/coaches, and then assess what changed. Clients get a written view of the gaps, the fix and the result. 

Job Summary 

We are hiring a Senior Sales Executives to sell Perform to senior leaders at large organisations: Heads of HR, L&D, Talent and Transformation, and the business executives who sponsor their programmes. You will own the sale from first conversation to signed contract, working with our Programme Scientist, who builds the diagnosis and prescription behind every proposal. This is a consultative sale with long cycles, several stakeholders and meaningful deal values. We are looking for someone who has done it before and wants to build a book of business from the start. 

This is an onsite role based in our London office. 

Key Responsibilities 

- Generate and qualify your own pipeline through targeted outreach, networking, referrals and social selling to senior HR, L&D and business leaders

- Run structured discovery calls using our Initial Discovery Template, so the client’s real performance problem is clear before any proposal is written

- Work with the Programme Scientist to turn discovery into a bespoke diagnosis, prescription and quote, and present it to the client sponsor

- Position Perform as an expert advisor, qualify prospects rigorously, and manage intake so each quarter’s cohorts are full and the programme stays selective

- Negotiate pricing and terms within our pricing framework, and take contracts through to signature

- Keep every opportunity current in HubSpot CRM, from contact to lead to deal, so forecasting and reporting are accurate

- Stay with the client after signature through delivery and assessment, and use the findings to open expansion and renewal conversations

- Share what you learn from the market (objections, competitors, pricing pressure) with the leadership team so the offer keeps improving

Qualifications 

Required: 

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Behavioural Science or related fields.

- At least five years of B2B sales experience, including closing complex, high-value deals with multiple stakeholders

- Proven experience selling leadership development, learning and development, coaching, talent, HR consulting or other professional services to senior buyers

- A record of meeting or exceeding targets, with examples you can discuss

- Excellent written and spoken English, and the credibility to hold a conversation with a C-suite executive

- Comfort with discovery-led, consultative selling rather than product pitching

- Right to work in the UK

Preferred: 

- Experience selling to financial services, banking, technology or other regulated, multinational clients

- An existing network among HR and L&D decision-makers

- Experience working alongside subject-matter experts or consultants to build proposals

- HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator or comparable CRM and prospecting tools

- Additional languages

Marcus Evans is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity, and all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need.

title: Senior Field Marketing Manager - North

Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
. 

Hiring and how we work 

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
. 

See yourself at Twilio

About the job 

This position is needed to lead and execute the regional field marketing and high-touch event strategy across the UK & Nordics, accelerating pipeline conversion and driving measurable revenue growth across key target accounts.

As Senior Field Marketing Manager, you will serve as the field marketing engine for Twilio’s North region. Working closely with Sales Leadership, you will design and deliver targeted 1st-party events, C-level dinners, technical workshops, and partner co-marketing activations. You will engage key decision-makers, open doors in strategic accounts, and accelerate deal velocity across core products like WhatsApp for Business, Voice AI, and Conversations.

Responsibilities 

In this role, you'll:

- Partner closely with North Sales Leadership and Account Executives to align event programs directly with regional revenue targets and priority accounts across Strategic and New Business segments.

- Design hyper-focused event experiences (e.g., C-level roundtables, founder dinners, technical deep-dive workshops, and roadshows) built to solve specific regional customer pain points.

- Lead end-to-end strategy, content localisation, speaker sourcing, venue management, and execution for proprietary Twilio regional events across key North tech hubs (e.g., London, Stockholm, Copenhagen).

- Own regional presence at strategic industry conferences and hyper-scaler co-marketing events (AWS, Meta, Google) in partnership with the Partner Marketing Manager.

- Establish strict lead and attendee follow-up SLAs with regional SDR and AE teams to convert event engagement into qualified pipeline and deal velocity.

- Develop targeted post-event content and micro-campaigns to enable Account Executives to maintain momentum with enterprise account teams.

- Measure and report on event success through commercial metrics: target account penetration rate, pipeline created/influenced, deal velocity, and closed-won revenue.

- Manage the apportioned regional field marketing budget and local vendor relationships to ensure optimal ROI and flawless execution.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

* Required: 

- 5–7 years of enterprise software/SaaS field marketing experience, with a proven track record of owning event strategy and execution tied directly to pipeline and revenue generation.

- Deep familiarity with the UK & Nordics region, including regional business etiquette, key enterprise tech hubs, local event ecosystems, and localized content preferences.

- Impeccable English written and verbal communication skills to write compelling local messaging and engage with regional enterprise buyers and agencies.

- Demonstrated commercial acumen with the ability to act as a trusted peer to Senior Sales Leadership and Enterprise Account Executives.

- Hands-on experience using CRM and marketing automation tools (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo) to track event ROI, account attendance depth, and pipeline conversion across the funnel.

- Exceptional organisational discipline and project management skills to handle multiple complex event activations simultaneously.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

*Desired: 

- Familiarity with account-based marketing (ABM) methodologies and account-level pipeline tracking within enterprise SaaS.

Location 

This role will be remote, and based in the UK.

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to learn from each other. For this role, approximately 25–30% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way across the DACH region.

What We Offer 

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

The successful candidate's starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Equal opportunity employer 

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Twilio is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us.

Twilio is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Twilio thinks big. Do you? 

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions. 

. 

Stay alert to recruitment fraud 

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

. 

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Director, Partnerships 

Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. As we continue to scale our global platform, the Director, Partnerships will play a critical role in growing and commercialising strategic football partnerships across global markets.

ROLE OVERVIEW 

The Director, Partnerships will lead and develop strategic relationships with key partners, including national federations, premier league, league 1, and championship clubs, as well as global governing bodies and football associations. Serving as the primary strategic contact, this role drives revenue growth, elevates brand presence, and delivers exceptional commercial value to partners' retail businesses through cross-functional collaboration and senior-level relationship management. The Director, Partnerships delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.

HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT 

Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

- Represent Fanatics as the trusted face of the brand within the sports community, building advisor-level relationships with senior stakeholders to ensure mutual satisfaction and long-term partner retention.

- Introduce innovative ideas and best practices that enhance partnership value and deepen fan engagement across digital, in-venue, and retail touchpoints.

- Drive revenue growth through partner activations and joint marketing initiatives that elevate the fan experience and strengthen commercial outcomes.

- Monitor and analyse performance metrics to continuously optimise financial returns for both Fanatics and its partners, keeping the fan at the centre of every decision.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

- Stay current with industry trends, competitor activities, and developments in sports retail to proactively identify new commercialisation and renewal opportunities.

- Develop and execute forward-thinking strategies that grow and commercially enhance partnerships with associations, leagues, and clubs.

- Leverage data and market analysis to identify emerging opportunities, solve complex challenges, and inform strategic direction across the partnership portfolio.

- Champion a culture of continuous improvement by introducing best practices that push the boundaries of what partnership value can deliver.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

- Lead strategic business reviews against contracts and business plans, presenting relevant performance data with internal teams to drive accountability and results.

- Manage the full partnership lifecycle end-to-end, including onboarding, ongoing reviews, escalations, and relationship nurturing, ensuring every commitment is met on time and within plan.

- Proactively identify risks and opportunities within the portfolio and take decisive action to protect and grow the value of each partnership.

- Hold cross-functional teams accountable for delivering on partner goals, maintaining high standards of execution across all touchpoints.

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

Cross-Functional Leadership: 

- Collaborate with senior leadership, ecommerce, product development, licensing, new business, buying, marketing, and operations to align on launches and partner goals, ensuring seamless communication and delivery of commitments.

- Drive alignment across internal stakeholders to ensure the organisation is consistently positioned to meet and exceed partner expectations.

- Oversee internal teams supporting the partnership portfolio, fostering a high-performance environment built on clarity, collaboration, and shared accountability.

People Leadership: 

- Provide strong, inspiring leadership that builds confidence, drives effective change, and develops talent within the partnerships function.

- Create a team culture grounded in BOLD principles, empowering individuals to take ownership, innovate, and deliver outstanding results for partners and fans alike.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY 

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:

- Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes

- Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance

- Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working

- Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING 

Required Qualifications: 

- 8+ years of experience in partnerships, account management, or business development, preferably within sports, sports retail, or ecommerce environments.

- Demonstrated ability to manage senior client relationships with strong negotiation and strategic thinking skills, and a proven track record of driving revenue growth through strategic partnerships.

- Deep understanding of football club operations, league structures, and fan engagement strategies, with the ability to operate credibly at the highest levels of the sports industry.

- Strong commercial acumen with the ability to analyse complex data and market trends to inform strategy and optimise financial performance.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, internally and externally.

- Proven project management capability, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

- Willingness to travel internationally as required to support partner relationships and business objectives.

If you do not meet all of the requirements for the role, but still have relevant partnerships or account management experience please do reach out.

Education: 

Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Sports Management, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

ABOUT US 
Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. description:
ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

- la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

- la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’Unité de Formation et de Recherche (UFR) Mécanique. L’UFR de Mécanique a pour mission d’assurer la formation en mécanique des élèves du cursus ingénieur d’ENSTA, des élèves de masters de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, et la formation par la recherche d’étudiants français et étrangers au niveau master et doctorat. L’Unité développe également des activités de recherche dans le domaine de la mécanique des matériaux et des structures, de la mécanique des fluides, des vibrations et de l’acoustique. Ces activités sont réalisées grâce à un important parc expérimental de haut niveau en mécanique des solides et des fluides, tant pour l’enseignement que la recherche. Sur le campus de Brest, l’UFR de Mécanique compte une cinquantaine d’enseignants chercheurs, une cinquantaine de doctorants/post-doctorants ainsi qu’une dizaine de personnels techniques (ingénieurs, techniciens). Les activités de recherche des membres de l’UFR de Mécanique du site de Brest sont menées au sein de l’Institut de Recherche Dupuy de Lôme (IRDL, CNRS UMR 6027, www.irdl.fr ). La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les enseignants-chercheurs de l’ENSTA, pôle thématique de recherche « Structure Interaction Fluide (StIF) » de l’IRDL.

L’ENSTA est l’un des partenaires du projet SEARENITY, retenu dans le cadre de l'appel à projets « CORIMER Navire Bas Carbone » (financement Ademe, France 2030). Le projet vise à développer un robot autonome capable d’intervenir en continu sur les coques de navires pour les nettoyer et limiter l’apparition d’algues et coquillages afin de réduire sa consommation énergétique et ses émissions de C02.

L’ENSTA intervient sur 2 aspects du projet pour lequel les verrous techniques sont nombreux et pointus :

- le système d’attraction magnétique : définition, simulation et tests.

- le volet hydrodynamique du robot : modélisation, simulation numérique et essais en veine aérodynamique

La présente fiche de poste concerne les aspects hydrodynamiques.

Missions / Activités principales : 

La personne recrutée prendra en charge l’évaluation numérique des efforts subis par le robot dans différentes configurations d’opération, et proposera des pistes d’optimisation de forme, afin d’améliorer les performances. Les modèles développés seront également confrontés à des essais de validation dans la nouvelle veine aérodynamique de l’école. Elle sera amenée à produire des rapports et présentations techniques, mettre en œuvre des outils de simulation numérique et des essais, et travailler de manière collaborative avec l’ensemble des partenaires du projet SEARENITY.

Les missions détaillées sont les suivantes :

- Etude expérimentale en soufflerie 

Essais de caractérisation et de validation en veine aérodynamique, afin de valider les simulations numériques pour l’estimation des efforts, en fonction de différents paramètres (influence de la vitesse de l’écoulement, influence de l’angle d’incidence). Mise en place du protocole d’essais, conception du support et impression 3D du modèle réduit de drone, calibrage des capteurs, mise en œuvre de la veine aérodynamique.

2. Etude numérique pour le fonctionnement en zone immergée 

Détermination numérique des efforts moyens rencontrés par le drone en condition réelle le long de la coque. Les simulations numériques seront réalisées avec un code de calcul commercial validé, constituant l’une des références à l’heure actuelle pour la simulation d’écoulements à haut Reynolds.

3. Dimensionnement des efforts d’impact en splash-zone 

Détermination numérique des efforts d’impact à la traversée de la surface libre, pour différentes vitesses du navire, et différents angles d’incidence du drone. Les simulations numériques seront réalisées à l’aide d’un code de calcul développé par l’ENSTA, spécifiquement dédié aux cas d’impacts. Plusieurs trajectoires de rentrée dans l’eau seront simulées, afin de cerner les efforts maximaux subis par la structure.

4. Optimisation de forme du robot 

Le fonctionnement nominal du drone en zone immergée, et la phase d’entrée dans l’eau conduisent à des formes géométriques optimales très différentes. Une étude bibliographique sera menée pour orienter la recherche d’une forme extérieure la plus adaptée, au sens d’un compromis sur les efforts acceptables. Cette étude bibliographique sera éventuellement complétée par des calculs de traînée et d’impact sur des géométries académiques, afin de fournir une aide à la décision pour les concepteurs du drone.

Présentation de l’Ecole 

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris) . Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID). Les activités de recherche des membres de l’UFR de Mécanique du site de Brest sont menées au sein de l’Institut de Recherche Dupuy de Lôme (IRDL, CNRS UMR 6027, www.irdl.fr ). La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les enseignants-chercheurs de l’ENSTA, pôle thématique de recherche « Structure Interaction Fluide (StIF) » de l’IRDL.

Le recrutement s’inscrit dans le projet MULTIRIM, qui vise à développer des solutions innovantes en propulsion marine. Les propulseurs marins à entraînement circonférentiel constituent une alternative aux hélices classiques marines, en présentant plusieurs avantages : manoeuvrabilité, compacité, discrétion acoustique, amélioration de la traînée de la carène par l’absence de ligne d’arbre. Cependant, la présence d’une tuyère embarquant le moteur électrique d’entraînement pénalise le rendement. Une piste d’amélioration est d’adopter un propulseur à plusieurs étages à l’instar des moteurs d’avion, afin de regagner environ vingt points de rendement. La configuration même de l’entraînement extérieur, sans arbre, supprime la complexité mécanique rencontrée sur les hélices contrarotatives classiques.

Or, il existe très peu de bancs d’essai pour les propulseurs à entraînement circonférentiel, pour une seule hélice, ainsi que très peu de données expérimentales de référence. Les difficultés sont de deux ordres. Du point de vue fonctionnement, le refroidissement du moteur électrique nécessite des échanges thermiques, et la liaison rotor/stator est assurée par un palier hydrodynamique. La mise ne eau dans une veine hydrodynamique est ainsi obligatoire. Par ailleurs, l’absence d’arbre d’entraînement empêche une mesure aisée du couple d’entraînement, valeur requise pour déterminer le rendement global du propulseur.

Intégrer plusieurs étages propulsifs au sein d’un même propulseur au sein d’un banc d’essai expérimental n’a jamais été proposé au niveau international. Cependant, le mode de fonctionnement de l’entraînement circonférentiel le permet aisément.

Disposer de résultats expérimentaux de référence, tant pour les efforts globaux que pour l’écoulement (champ de vitesse, de pression) présente un intérêt fort pour la communauté scientifique. En particulier, l'écoulement fortement tourbillonnaire, la présence d'éléments tournants rendent la simulation numérique particulièrement difficile et des résultats de référence permettront de valider les modèles numériques.

Aussi, le premier objectif de ce projet est de développer un banc d’essais modulaire, afin de tester plusieurs configurations d’hélices, de vitesses d’entraînement différenciées, de formes de tuyère, et évaluer précisément le rendement global. D’autre part, le principe des moteurs à plusieurs étages est de récupérer la puissance perdue par le premier étage, en redressant l’écoulement, un propulseur idéal accélérant l’écoulement uniquement de manière axiale. Un second objectif du projet consiste à caractériser cette récupération d’énergie opérée par les étages supérieurs.

Le projet associe les compétences en modélisation de machines électriques de l’IRENav et les compétences en modélisation hydrodynamique de l’ENSTA-IRDL (UMR CNRS 6027) et de l’IRENav. L’ENSTA met par ailleurs à disposition sa veine aérodynamique dédiée aux applications marines, et l’instrumentation associée. Ce projet s’inscrit dans un projet plus vaste financé par l’Agence Innovation Défense (Projet AID RD-PROP), visant à proposer des méthodologies de modélisation et de conception de propulseurs électriques navals intégrés à entrainement circonférentiel. La personne recrutée sera intégrée dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire de 3 enseignants-chercheurs, 1 doctorante et 2 post-doctorantes.

Missions / Activités principales : 

La personne recrutée prendra en charge la conception et le test d’un banc d’essai multi-étages pour propulseur à entraînement circonférentiel, pour usage en veine aérodynamique. La caractérisation du rendement du propulseur sera réalisée par mesure directe des efforts, et mesure indirecte de la vorticité résiduelle dans le sillage aval à l’aide de mesures non intrusives du champ de vitesse (méthode PIV).

La personne recrutée sera amenée à produire des rapports et présentations techniques, mettre en œuvre des essais (étalonnage, mesure d’efforts, velocimétrie laser), et travailler de manière collaborative avec l’ensemble des partenaires du projet RD-PROP.

Les missions détaillées sont les suivantes :

Tâche 1 : Conception et fabrication d’un banc moteur dédié 

La conception d’un banc d’essai propulseur s’appuiera sur les compétences de la plateforme de conception MASMECA de l’ENSTA, ainsi que sur l’expertise de l’IRENav sur les moteurs à entraînement circonférentiel. Le banc d’essai sera prévu pour être modulaire, et fonctionner dans une gamme de vitesses de rotation représentative d’un propulseur réel.

Tâche 2 : Détermination du rendement maximal atteignable 

Parallèlement à la conception et la fabrication du banc moteur, un modèle semi-analytique (disque actuateur sous tuyère) sera développé, afin de proposer une estimation théorique du rendement maximal atteignable par un propulseur sous tuyère. Cette estimation prendra en compte la traînée de la tuyère, l’absence de flux transverse dans le sillage aval. La principale simplification concerne le frottement visqueux sur les pales, non pris en compte par ce type de modèle.

Tâche 3 : Méthodologie de quantification de l’écoulement transverse 

Une méthodologie de détermination du champ de vitesses par technique PIV non intrusive dans un plan du sillage sera mise en œuvre, à l’aide d’un laser, d’une caméra rapide et d’un ensemencement de l’écoulement. L’influence de la position de la section transverse par rapport au corps étudié sera étudiée, ainsi que les paramètres numériques de l’algorithme PIV. Différents indicateurs de champ de vitesse intégré seront testés, pour qualifier au mieux la signature de perte de rendement lié à l’écoulement transverse. La méthodologie développée sera validée sur un écoulement classique de la littérature.

Tâche 4 : Mise en œuvre d’un benchmark de référence dans la veine aérodynamique de l’ENSTA 

Le banc d’essai sera utilisé pour une première conception d’un jeu d’hélices contrarotatives (2 étages), adaptées au rim-driven, et d’une géométrie de tuyère simplifiée. Ces premiers tests exploratoires permettront de valider la chaîne complète de test (banc + instrumentation des efforts + post-traitement sillage aval) dans l’objectif de publier à terme un benchmark de référence au niveau international.

Les résultats obtenus pourront mener à publication scientifique.

company: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
description:
ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

- la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

- la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’Unité de Formation et de Recherche (UFR) Mécanique. L’UFR de Mécanique a pour mission d’assurer la formation en mécanique des élèves du cursus ingénieur d’ENSTA, des élèves de masters de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, et la formation par la recherche d’étudiants français et étrangers au niveau master et doctorat. L’Unité développe également des activités de recherche dans le domaine de la mécanique des matériaux et des structures, de la mécanique des fluides, des vibrations et de l’acoustique. Ces activités sont réalisées grâce à un important parc expérimental de haut niveau en mécanique des solides et des fluides, tant pour l’enseignement que la recherche. Sur le campus de Brest, l’UFR de Mécanique compte une cinquantaine d’enseignants chercheurs, une cinquantaine de doctorants/post-doctorants ainsi qu’une dizaine de personnels techniques (ingénieurs, techniciens). Les activités de recherche des membres de l’UFR de Mécanique du site de Brest sont menées au sein de l’Institut de Recherche Dupuy de Lôme (IRDL, CNRS UMR 6027, www.irdl.fr ). La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les enseignants-chercheurs de l’ENSTA, pôle thématique de recherche « Structure Interaction Fluide (StIF) » de l’IRDL.

Le recrutement s’inscrit dans le projet SUBPERF-AI, qui porte sur une démarche de réduction drastique du cycle de développement de nouveaux concepts sous-marins, en s’appuyant sur les progrès récents de l’intelligence artificielle (IA), et plus particulièrement le machine learning. Au contraire de l’existant en IA basé sur des modèles ininterprétables de type boîte noire, le projet vise à construire une méthodologie de construction de modèles physiques, de complexité adaptée à la physique sous-jacente, en ayant recours à l’expertise humaine et se plaçant comme un outil de conception complémentaire dans l’écosystème existant.

Les objectifs principaux du projet sont :

- Développer une méthodologie de détermination automatisée du modèle d’efforts hydrodynamiques de corps sous-marin, avec utilisation de l’IA (machine learning), sur la base des données de la cinématique, des trajectoires, et des paramètres de contrôle, facilement accessibles, lors des essais maquette ou réel, ou lors d’une simulation numérique.

- Placer l’expert humain en capacité de contrôler la construction du modèle aux différents stades : qualité des données d’entrée, qualité de la phase d’apprentissage du modèle, et outils/règles de certification a posteriori.

La personne recrutée sera intégrée dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire de 3 enseignants-chercheurs, un doctorant et un second post-doctorant.

Missions / Activités principales : 

La personne recrutée prendra en charge la construction d’un modèle d’effort hydrodynamique « expert » et la génération de données expérimentales. Le modèle hydrodynamique expert sera déterminé en suivant la méthodologie classique de l’ITTC, à l’aide d’une campagne d’essais dans la veine aérodynamique pour la caractérisation des efforts (essais en modèle captif du type PMM (Planar Motion Mechanism)). Ce modèle sera implémenté dans un simulateur temporel, dont les résultats seront confrontés sur des manœuvres standards réalisées dans le bassin à drones de l’ENSTA. La confrontation des résultats de trajectoires expérimentales aux trajectoires simulées, obtenues sur la base des essais en modèle captif, pourra amener à questionner la méthodologie standard, en particulier lors de la présence de non-linéarités importantes ou de termes croisés non négligeables. Les essais en bassin fourniront par ailleurs les données de cinématique nécessaires au travail de thèse.

Les missions détaillées sont les suivantes :

Tâche 1 – conception et fabrication d’un drone sous-marin 

Conception d’un drone générique de géométrie simplifiée, et instrumenté. Le drone recevra un capotage extérieur, afin de tester plusieurs configurations : géométrie parallélépipédique typique d’un ROV d’exploration, et géométrie cylindrique de type drone torpille.

Le drone sera instrumenté pour mesurer les paramètres de contrôle, la cinématique et les trajectoires, ainsi que les efforts propulsifs (poussée, couple) et les efforts de contrôle.

Tâche 2 – essais statiques et dynamiques en modèle captif 

Réalisation d’essais de caractérisation dans la veine aérodynamique de l’ENSTA, en similitude complète de Reynolds, pour les vitesses envisagées d’utilisation en eau du drone.

Mesure des efforts en statique, sur les 6 degrés de liberté. Caractérisation des efforts de plans porteurs et du propulseur.

Mesure des efforts en dynamique, en mouvement forcé à l’aide de l’hexapode : masses et inerties ajoutées, termes liés aux vitesses angulaires.

Tâche 3 – Identification dérivées hydrodynamiques 

Identification des dérivées hydrodynamiques (ou coefficients hydrodynamiques) à partir des essais en modèle captif.

Tâche 4 – Adaptation du simulateur temporel 

Prise en main du simulateur temporel de l’ENSTA, et de l’environnement de développement.

Adaptation du code de calcul pour intégrer des lois de commande issues de mesures expérimentales.

Tâche 5 – Essais libres et standardisés, en bassin 

Réalisation d’essais aux trajectoires prédéfinies (zigzag horizontal ou vertical, accélération horizontale, …).

Réalisation d’essais pour parcourir l’espace complet des 6 degrés de libertés.

Enregistrement de l’historique des contrôles (vitesse hélice, angles plans porteurs, …), des trajectoires et des efforts des organes de contrôle.

Tâche 6 – Rejeu trajectoires simulateur temporel 

Rejeu numérique des trajectoires, afin de valider si le modèle d’efforts est suffisamment complet pour prédire correctement les trajectoires mesurées expérimentalement.

Les résultats obtenus amèneront à publication scientifique.

Project Delivery - from award to acceptance

- Own customer reporting, deliverables and acceptance (FAT/SAT), with the documentation trail for invoicing and audits

- Run several projects in parallel, each at a different stage

Process & Reporting 

- Set the bid and project rhythm for the team: calendar, gates, templates, dashboards

- Review the status of every live bid and project weekly with your sales director: deadlines, compliance, risks, resources needed

- Run lessons learned after every bid, won or lost

Candidate Profile 

- 5+ years in bid, proposal or project management in defence, aerospace or security

- Proven record of compliant, on-time submissions to NATO agencies, EU programmes or European ministries of defence, several of them in parallel

- Scale-up or lean-team experience is a significant advantage; prime experience is welcome if you want more breadth and speed

Skills & Qualities

- Built for parallel work you run several bids and projects at once, prioritise hard and never drop the ball

- Committed you own the outcome, not just your part of it; submission peaks are part of the job and you plan for them

- Calm under pressure fixed deadlines, late amendments and competing requests do not throw you

- A clear writer structured, scoreable English; you turn engineering input into compliant answers

- A leader without authority you get engineers, Finance, Legal and partners to deliver on time

Be the CRM project lead across Revenue
