title: Partner Account Manager, Intégrateurs de solutions de gestion
description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision 

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane 

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 350 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Localisation et déplacements 

Poste basé à Paris , selon la politique hybride de Pennylane, avec des déplacements réguliers en France auprès des partenaires, de leurs équipes et lors d’événements professionnels. Le portefeuille pourra inclure des partenaires franciliens et nationaux ; son allocation définitive sera précisée avec le manager.

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez nous ?

Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant.

Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? 

Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action :

- Développer les comptes partenaires , en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs.

- Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell , en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente.

- Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence , grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret.

- Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant , en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs.

- Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain , en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 

1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenaires

- Comprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur.

- Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes.

- Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes.

- Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles.

- Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu.

2. Animer le business Resell et Cosell

- Créer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire.

- Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable.

- Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane.

- Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés.

- Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion.

3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateurs

- Identifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires.

- Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe.

- Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau.

- Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation.

- Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats.

4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomes

- Maîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes.

- Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités.

- Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs.

- Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux.

- Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire.

5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relation

- Assurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales.

- Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires.

- Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat.

- Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage.

- Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence.

6. Collaborer en interne et contribuer à la stratégie Partnerships

- Coordonner les plans partenaires avec les équipes AE, Marketing, Ops, Produit et les équipes d’accompagnement concernées.

- Faire remonter des retours terrain précis sur les besoins des intégrateurs, les objections, les évolutions de marché et les opportunités commerciales.

- Proposer des initiatives marketing, commerciales ou produit pour accélérer la croissance des partenaires.

- Partager les bonnes pratiques et les succès avec l’équipe afin de contribuer à la performance collective.

- Maintenir des informations fiables dans le CRM et respecter les processus de vente et de suivi partenaires.

Profil recherché : 

Compétences incontournables :

- Tu as une expérience confirmée en vente indirecte B2B, gestion de comptes partenaires ou développement de réseaux de revendeurs et d’intégrateurs;

- Tu as idéalement au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans un environnement logiciel ou SaaS B2B ; une expérience plus senior sera appréciée pour gérer des partenaires stratégiques et des cycles complexes;

- Tu sais élaborer et piloter des plans de croissance avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction et des équipes opérationnelles;

- Tu as une approche commerciale orientée résultats, sais piloter un pipeline et transformer les analyses en actions concrètes;

- Tu es à l’aise dans les rendez-vous terrain, les négociations, les présentations et les démonstrations produit;

- Tu sais engager plusieurs parties prenantes chez un partenaire et construire une relation de confiance dans la durée;

- Tu es proactif, créatif et résilient : tu sais prendre des initiatives et maintenir une dynamique même lorsque les résultats prennent du temps;

- Tu es rigoureux dans le suivi des opportunités, le forecast et l’utilisation du CRM;

- Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et sais collaborer avec des fonctions commerciales, marketing, produit et opérations;

- Tu maîtrises le français et peux participer à des échanges professionnels en anglais.

Atouts appréciés 

- Une connaissance des solutions de comptabilité, finance, gestion, ERP ou logiciels de gestion pour les PME;

- Une expérience auprès d’intégrateurs, de revendeurs, de VAR ou d’éditeurs logiciels B2B.

- Une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes de distribution logicielle et des enjeux de déploiement chez les clients;

- Une expérience de gestion de grands comptes partenaires, de plans de migration de parc ou de cycles Resell et Cosell.

Ce que nous recherchons surtout :

Au-delà de ton expérience, nous recherchons une personne qui :

- Sait créer rapidement de la confiance et de la crédibilité auprès de dirigeants et d’équipes terrain;

- Aime être au contact des partenaires et transforme cette proximité en actions commerciales mesurables;

- Sait conjuguer vision stratégique du compte et exécution opérationnelle au quotidien;

- Est à la fois autonome, coachable et généreuse dans le partage de ses apprentissages avec l’équipe;

- A envie de contribuer à la croissance d’un réseau historique tout en faisant évoluer ses pratiques.

Process de recrutement :

- Screening Talent Acquisition — 45 min : motivation, expérience en partenariats logiciels, connaissance de l’écosystème et disponibilité pour les déplacements.

- Entretien Hiring Manager — 45 min : réalisations concrètes, gestion de portefeuille, activation et développement de partenaires, approche terrain et collaboration.

- Étude de cas — environ 1 h : analyse d’un portefeuille d’intégrateurs, proposition d’un plan de croissance, priorisation du pipeline Resell/Cosell et présentation d’une approche de démonstration ou d’enablement.

- Entretien final — environ 45 min : vision du canal, contribution stratégique, collaboration transverse et adéquation avec les ambitions de Pennylane.

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

Beyond consulting, we are strongly committed to promoting ethical and accessible AI. We have launched the School of Data to support career transitions into tech roles, and established an AI Research Centre in both Paris and Shanghai.

In the context of Artefact’s accelerating growth, we are looking for a B2B Marketing Intern to join our Marketing team starting in January 2027 .

The role : 

Are you passionate about B2B marketing in the Tech area and want to work in an environment where your impact on business growth is recognised?

If this sounds like you, and you’re ready to step-up your career and level of responsibility, then you might just be our next B2B Marketing Assistant Intern. 

The Marketing team at Artefact directly contributes to the business by engaging with existing clients and prospects to convert them as leads to generate sales. We do so by working closely with the heads of departments & consultant teams, as well as using KPI to make sure we create the right marketing deliverables and use the right channels to drive engagement, and ultimately leads and revenue. 

We do this through demand generation campaigns and events/webinars’ organisation , combined with PPC and social advertising to ensure brand and lead-gen campaigns support business objectives.

You’ll be working closely with the rest of the Artefact’s worldwide Marketing team, that’s why fluently speaking in English to share your best practices and train your peers is also required. You will be collaborating with the Marketing Specialists Global and France of the team, who report to the CMO of the Group, all based in Paris.

What you will do: 

- Using our marketing automation tool (Pardot) to conceive and roll-out mailing and lead nurturing campaigns (mailings, newsletters, landing pages) to drive customer acquisition.

- Helping to organize events (webinars, business breakfasts, podcasts, participation in trade fairs & conferences with booths and speaking slots) and ensure a multi-channel attractive communications of these events through our website & landing pages, mailing series and social media (LinkedIn and Instagram).

- Managing LinkedIn advertising campaigns according to objectives (awareness, acquisition) mixing organic and paid approach, to support and generate leads for the management team.

- Coordinating with our design team and briefing them to craft impactful and visually appealing assets that effectively communicate our key messages on social media every day.. 

- Analyzing our Marketing Performance dashboards to understand and improve how our inbound marketing activity turns into and converts customers.

title: Post-doctorant(e) :  Problèmes publics des centres de données - Chaire SHS TerrAINs  - CDD de 18 mois
description:
Qui sommes-nous ? 

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en problèmes publics des centres de données pour rejoindre le département de recherche Sciences Économiques et Sociales (SES) et plus particulièrement la chaire SHS TerraAINs. 

Contexte scientifique : 

La Chaire SHS TerrAINs s’intéresse aux enjeux territoriaux du développement des infrastructures numériques et plus particulièrement des centres de données en France. Elle est portée par Pauline Gourlet et financée par la Région Ile de France (2026-2029).

Longtemps demeurés une infrastructure invisible, les centres de données ( data centers ) se trouvent désormais au cœur des problématiques des politiques publiques et industrielles et la Région Ile de France concentre aujourd’hui ces infrastructures (plus de 165 en 2024), avec de nombreux projets de data centers hyperscale à l’étude.

Vecteurs d’innovation, objets de spéculation, instruments de réaffirmation de puissance nationale, leur développement rapide génère aussi de nombreuses inquiétudes, voire du rejet, en France (comme à l’étranger), et ne fait pas à ce jour l’objet d’une planification concertée, mais relève encore largement d’opportunités isolées. Or, ces projets d’infrastructure se trouvent à la croisée d’enjeux locaux, voire hyper-locaux — de l’aménagement territorial aux effets sur l’environnement — et d’enjeux nationaux et internationaux — de la tension sur les réseaux d’électricité aux questions de souveraineté technologique et d’investissement.

Au sein de la Chaire, le ou la post-doctorant(e) étudiera la manière dont les centres de données, objets clés de l’infrastructure numérique, se développent et organisent différents problèmes publics relatifs aux « territoires » à différentes échelles territoriales. Comment en retour, la définition et la hiérarchisation de ces problèmes peuvent permettent des arbitrages concertés pour planifier leur déploiement ? 

Les modalités de participation à la construction de ces problèmes publics, autant que la fabrique des données nécessaires pour nourrir les positions des acteurs, sont autant un enjeu de démocratie technique qu’une manière de retrouver prise sur l’aménagement des milieux de vie. 

En articulant sociologie des sciences et des techniques et études urbaines avec une méthodologie innovante de recherche-action , TerrAINs contribue à rendre visibles et discutables les infrastructures numériques, tout en expérimentant des outils de représentation des problèmes et de participation, adaptées aux enjeux infrastructurels contemporains.

La Chaire est organisée selon trois axes principaux : 

- Analyse des discours sur les centres de données, et notamment les discours médiatiques régionaux, nationaux et étrangers ;

- Description des modalités du « faire infrastructure » : pratiques situées, relations aux milieux, frictions. Cet axe investira trois sites franciliens concernés par des projets de centres hyperscale.

- la chaire est conçue comme un laboratoire de recherche-action qui expérimente de nouvelles modalités de représentation et de participation autour des infrastructures numériques.

Vos missions principales seront de : 

- Assurer des missions de recherche dans le cadre de la Chaire Terrains

- Participer à l’animation de la chaire et contribuer aux projets menés par les autres membres de l’équipe

- Participer à des actions de valorisation des travaux menés au sein de la chaire

- Assurer des missions d’encadrement (stagiaires, workshops étudiant) 

Consulter la description des missions complètes dans la fiche de poste détaillée. 

Nous recherchons une personne avec un profil SHS – interdisciplinaire ( humanités environnementales, Science and Technology Studies (STS) ou anthropologie expérimentale, géographie sociale, architecture / design…) avec une solide maîtrise théorique et empirique des transformations socio-environnementales, des savoirs situés, des problèmes publics, de l’enquête collective et des relations entre sciences / société. 

Niveau de diplôme exigé : doctorat ou équivalent

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers). 

Vous bénéficierez de :

- flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service)

- télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible

- Remboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75%

- Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne...

Découvrez notre environnement de travail, nos engagements en image et en vidéo sur notre page dédiée .

En tant que Lead Data Engineer, vous concevrez l'architecture de transformation, piloterez la création des pipelines de données, et mettrez en place un monitoring rigoureux pour assurer une migration "zéro défaut". Vous travaillerez sous la responsabilité du Program Leader et en étroite collaboration avec les équipes projet locales et globales.

VOS RESPONSABILITÉS PRINCIPALES

1. Architecture et Stratégie de Transformation des données : 

- 
Définir l'architecture technique et la stratégie de migration des données de nos systèmes sources (legacies) vers le template cible Workday.

- 
Identifier le périmètre technique de la migration et concevoir des modèles de données répondant aux exigences fonctionnelles et de sécurité.

- 
Documenter de manière précise les systèmes sources, les flux, et les règles de transformation complexes.

2. Ingénierie et Développement (Hands-on & Leadership) :

- 
Assurer l'intégrité, le chiffrage et la sécurité des données RH (données sensibles) tout au long du processus.

3. Monitoring des erreurs, Tests et Qualité des données : 

- 
Mettre en place les outils de monitoring des pipelines et de gestion des erreurs (alerting, logs) pour identifier, isoler et corriger les anomalies en temps réel lors des phases de tests et de "Go-Live".

Concevoir des mécanismes de contrôle qualité automatisés (Data Quality) pour garantir la conformité absolue des données migrées.

- 
Coordonner les tests de migration (unitaires, intégration, fonctionnels) et organiser les activités de validation post-migration.

4. Leadership Technique et Coordination : 

- 
Piloter techniquement les ressources data impliquées dans la migration, animer les rituels techniques et garantir les délais et la qualité des livrables.

- 
Maintenir une communication claire avec les parties prenantes (Data Stream Leader, équipes métiers, intégrateur externe), vulgariser les enjeux techniques et remonter les alertes avec des plans de mitigation.

CE DONT VOUS AUREZ BESOIN POUR RÉUSSIR

-

- 
Bases de données : Maîtrise des bases de données relationnelles (PostgreSQL) et compréhension des bases NoSQL.

🚀 CONTEXTE & ENJEUX STRATÉGIQUES

Au sein de Decathlon Digital, l'équipe Finance Data engage une initiative majeure : transformer les métiers de la finance par l'intégration de l'IA Générative et Agentique.

Face à la fragmentation des analyses exécutées par la fonction FP&A, notre ambition est de construire des solutions plus standardisées avec l’appui de l’IA. Il s'agit d’implémenter des couches d'intelligence centralisées et agnostiques des outils, capable d'interagir avec l'ensemble de notre infrastructure (Workday, Data Lake, EPM, ...) pour faire évoluer nos interfaces d'une logique de consultation vers une logique d'action.

Dans ce cadre, nous développons des débriefs de performance financière générés par l’IA pour toutes les activités de l’entreprise. Il aide nos collaborateurs et managers à accéder instantanément à une information fiable et sur laquelle ils peuvent prendre des décisions.

Déjà déployé avec succès en France, Espagne, Italie et Belgique, ce projet est le premier d’une série à venir.

Pour mener ce projet, nous ne recherchons pas uniquement un.e développeur.se, nous avons besoin d'un.e " Builder " : un.e personne capable de traduire un besoin métier en solution technique, de l’implémenter, la qualifier, la déployer et la maintenir dans le temps.

title: People ops - M&A and International Expansion
description:
Health can’t wait . 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

The M&A and International Expansion role 

Alan is diversifying its activities in the fields of healthcare, prevention and insurance through mergers and acquisitions, and is actively expanding internationally. In addition, Alan recruits talent worldwide and enables its employees to work remotely in complete safety.

“Alaner, everywhere”. The role makes sure each acquisition and each country opening is legally secure, fast and humane: from HR due diligence, to transferring employment contracts, to fully integrating the people who join us.

You'll join the Expansion crew inside the People team. You'll work closely with the crew owner, and with Corporate, Finance, team Leads and General Managers involved in each deal.

The People team 

The People team is made up of 13 people who work in an environment shaped by Alan's Leadership Principles. Every one of them is a genuine fan of our products (Culture being one of them) and deeply committed to Alan's Prevention and Health mission.

The team covers Learning and Development, Payroll and Admin, Employee Experience and Operational Efficiency, Compliance and Employment Law, Comp and Ben, and now M&A and International Expansion.

It is a generalist team: everyone shares three core missions, namely People on-call (answering the day to day questions from Alaners, which is now AI-powered), individual situation management, and HRBP responsibilities. This represents roughly 50% of our time. Then each person owns one or more cross-functional topics depending on their flavour. In your case: M&A and expansion.

Your missions 

On top of the core missions shared across the People team, you will work on a very diverse range of high-impact topics:

You will own to the People workstream of M&A transactions from due diligence to integration, alongside the crew and in close collaboration with the Corporate team, Legal, Finance and the business owners of each deal.

Depending on the nature of the deal, you will own:

- HR due diligence: reviewing headcount, employment contracts, collective agreements, compensation & benefits, liabilities and risks of target companies, and flagging red flags clearly to the deal team;

- Transferring employment contracts in France and abroad, and choosing the right path for each deal and country;

- Integrating acquired teams: day-1 and first-months plans, harmonising contracts and benefits, communicating with acquired employees, onboarding them into Alan's way of working;

- You will support the people transition of acquired teams, working with the crew and leads on team set-up, keeping key talents, and supporting every individual situation with care;

- Working with external advisors (law firms, HR advisory, relocation and EoR providers): writing clear briefs and challenging their advice.

Also:

- Opening new countries on the People side : entity vs employer of record, compliant local contracts, benefits and payroll partners

- You will handle international relocations and cross-border situations for Alaners moving or working between countries (visas, social security, tax, type of contract);

- Building reusable playbooks (HR due diligence checklist, integration playbook, "country opening – People" checklist) so each new deal is faster than the last

- Taking on global and cross-border individual situations (mobility, work from anywhere, sensitive cases)

- Raising the team's expertise : sharing your knowledge of employment law and M&A practices with the crew and the wider People team

- Leveraging AI and automation to multiply the impact of your work

Outcomes within your first months in the team 

By 2.5 months: 

- You are autonomous on day-to-day People on-call requests;

- You have mapped our current M&A and country-opening practices and shared a first list of gaps and quick wins;

- You have contributed to the People workstream of at least one live deal or country opening (due diligence, contract transfer or integration);

- You have contributed to our reusable playbook (e.g. HR due diligence checklist);

- You have shadowed and been reverse-shadowed on individual situation management.

By 5 months: 

- Depending on the ongoing projects, you own the People workstream of a deal end to end, from due diligence to integration, with the crew as a sounding board;

- You have run, or co-run, one talent density assessment and the parting ways cases that came with it;

- You handle cross-border individual situations without supervision;

- Your playbooks are used by the crew and by Legal / Finance on new deals;

- Leads and crew members come to you as the go-to expert on these topics.

Is this what you are looking for? 

You may be a great fit for this role if: 

- You have around 5 years of experience focused on HR M&A and integration topics, for example in a reputable HR advisory firm or in an HR team that focuses on these topics.

- You have worked on acquisitions in the Tech industry, not only on very large corporate groups, and you know the method is not the same.

- You master HR due diligence and the transfer of employment contracts.

- You have worked on post-merger integration, including talent density and parting ways, not only on the pre-signing side.

- You have international exposure: you have worked on deals or entities outside France.

- You are fluent in English, written and spoken (all of our internal processes, documentation and communications are in English).

- You are adaptable and creative: you adjust your method to each type of company and deal instead of copy-pasting one process.

- You are very organised: you run several confidential workstreams in parallel without dropping balls.

- You are a strong communicator, with very different audiences (founders, acquired employees, leads, lawyers), in writing and orally.

- You are strong technically and can teach us things.

- You show judgement and discretion with confidential information and sensitive human situations.

Nice-to-have 

We are not looking for all of the below. Any one of these can be a strong signal.

- You have a legal background, ideally in employment law.

- You have worked in or with a Tech scale-up that made several acquisitions.

- You have opened entities or set-up employers of record in new countries.

- You speak another language relevant to our expansion (e.g. Spanish, Portuguese; Arabic).

- You are AI-enthusiastic and actively use tools to multiply your impact.

Level range 

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

⭐️ The mission of the Union Relations Lead

Unions and social partners play a central and legitimate role in how social protection is designed, negotiated and implemented in France. We're looking for a Union Relations Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with unions, their federations, and the broader paritariste ecosystem, making Alan a trusted, substantive and well-known interlocutor of French social partners, and supporting our Enterprise & Public Sector teams across large private employers and public institutions.

⭐ What makes this role genuinely unique 

- You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health tech companies builds its relationships with the French social partner ecosystem (from confederations to sector federations to paritariste institutions).

- You'll operate at the highest levels of the paritariste ecosystem: confederal leadership, sector federations, IP boards, organisations patronales.

- You'll shape the strategy, not just execute it. Alan is at an early stage of building this capability (the playbook is yours to define)

- You'll work directly with Founders, Public Affair as well as Public Sector and Enterprise leadership.

- Real ownership from day one, in one of the fastest-growing tech unicorns in Europe.

⭐️ Your role

Relationships & Presence 

- Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with the organizations that represent employees and members across the sectors that matter to Alan (unions, federations, and the structures that convene them).

- Map the ecosystem, prioritize interlocutors , and design the engagement strategy at confederal, federal and branch level.

- Represent Alan in federations, working groups, congrès and paritariste institutions where our sector’s future is discussed.

- Be the credible consistent Alan voice social partners recognise 

Partnership with Alan's Enterprise & Public Sector work 

- Be a partner to our teams serving large private employers and public sector clients, briefing them on the social partners context and how Alan’s offer speaks to their priorities

- Introduce the right contacts at the right moment in the commercial cycle, turning Alan’s ecosystem relationships into concrete commercial leverage.

- Share Alan’s content with social partners to help them assess Alan on its merits and form their own view.

Sector Engagement & Anticipation 

- Follow the dialogue at branch level and across the paritariste ecosystem and turn that understanding into internal clarity.

- Represent Alan in the federations and working groups where our sector's future is discussed, contributing a constructive and recognizable voice.

- Be a sharp, early internal voice on where social dialogue is heading and on the implications for Alan's strategy.

Build & Scale 

- Knowledge base : Build and maintain a knowledge library on social partner positions, branch agreements, and paritariste institutions shared with Enterprise and Public Sector deal teams to increase win rates.

- Framework & tools : Implement processes and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of our social partner engagement and documentation.

- Collaboration : Share best practices with the broader Enterprise & Public Sector team and contribute proven methodologies to their scaled commercial operations.

- Market intelligence : Provide competitive intelligence on how social partners and competitors position themselves in our key markets.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Union Relations Lead role at Alan if you: 

- Have at least 8 years of total experience in social partner relations : in a union organization, a branch federation, a paritariste institution, or in an external affairs role at a mutelle, IP or insurer

- Have legitimate credibility at federation level: ability to engage federation leadership as a peer, built through a personal representative past or years of substantive engagement at federation level on employer side.

- Have deep knowledge of the paritariste ecosystem : branch agreements, confederal mandates, protection sociale reforms, and how institutions at each level function

- Have proven ability to build trust with social partners from the employer/state side

- Have outstanding stakeholder management : calm, long-game, trustworthy, discreet, able to represent Alan substantively without making it about yourself.

- Have ability to translate Alan’s product and strategy into compelling narratives for social partner audiences

- Demonstrable impact from prior social-partner work on an organization’s commercial and strategic outcomes

- Are a self-starter : comfortable building from scratch in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

- Are ego-free and lever-minded: you accelerate others, you don't seek the spotlight.

- Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris. 

Nice to have: 

- A confederal or federal elected / permanent past.

- Experience inside a paritariste institution

- Experience inside a sector federation on its social dialogue agenda.

- Legal background in droit social and comfort reading accords collectifs quickly.

- International exposure to the European social dialogue ecosystem.

- Prior experience with RFPs or tenders involving union-negotiated or paritariste schemes.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌 Perks & Benefits 

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer: 

- Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. 

- Flexible office with hybrid setup . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ.

- All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

- Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish.

- Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). 

- Transport . Generous transit benefit

- Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

- Personal growth through coaching : At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture . 

- Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. 

Important note: we hire people, not roles. 

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman : Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. 

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

title: Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
About Papers

Papers AG is a Swiss cyber security engineering house and an incubator for our product portfolio. We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it.

Your portfolio includes:

- Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones.

- Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks.

- Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets.

As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges.

Your role

We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline.

Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking.

If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you.

Success Metrics (First 90 Days) 

- 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics.

- 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows.

- 90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput.

Core Responsibilities 

1. Storytelling That Converts 

- Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy.

- Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth.

- Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion.

- Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct.

2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution 

- Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers.

- Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel.

- Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle.

3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA 

- Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale.

- Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI-generated copy, visual assets, landing page content, and email sequences before deployment.

- Prompt Engineering & Template Optimization: Continuously iterate on, standardize, and version-control skills, design systems and context workflows to ensure output matches brand voice, compliance standards, and conversion best practices.

- Scale & Efficiency Metrics: Track content throughput, error rates, and time-to-market reduction, driving continuous improvement in pipeline efficiency.

4. Analytics, Attribution & Data Ops 

- Tracking Infrastructure: Implementation and maintenance of event tracking, pixel setups, UTM parameters, and server-side tracking across all digital properties.

- Attribution Modeling: Own multi-touch attribution models to accurately trace pipeline generation, conversions, and revenue back to specific campaigns, channels, and AI-driven experiments.

- Data Integrity & Governance: Regularly audit marketing data across CRMs, marketing automation platforms, and internal databases to clean anomalies and maintain a single source of truth.

- Performance Reporting: Build and manage real-time dashboards providing actionable insights into CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and ROI across experiments.

What We Are Looking For 

Essential Experience & Qualifications 

- 3–5+ Years in Growth/Marketing Operations: Proven track record in a fast-paced B2B or B2C growth environment, managing campaign ops, marketing automation, and technical data pipelines.

- Passionate Builder: You deeply identify with our products. We are a fast-moving, mission-driven team, and this role requires intrinsic dedication rather than a standard 9-to-5 mentality.

- Hands-on AI Tooling Expertise: Demonstrated experience applying modern LLMs and generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Higgsfield) into real-world marketing workflows, beyond simple basic prompts.

- Technical Analytics Proficiency: Deep hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and data visualization tools.

- Automation Skills: Proficiency with automation platforms to connect API endpoints and pass payload data reliably.

- CRM & Automation Platforms: Direct administration experience with platforms like Zoho.

Preferred Technical Skills 

- Basic technical understanding of Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS for lightweight API scripting, data manipulation and rapid landing page iterations

Mindset & Soft Skills 

- Systems Thinking: Ability to map out complex, multi-step processes and translate business requirements into efficient technical architecture.

- Agile Adaptability: Comfort operating in fast-paced sprint cycles with changing priorities and a bias toward continuous shipping and learning.

- Obsessive Attention to Detail: An eagle eye for QA; AI speeds up production, but your judgment ensures quality control and brand alignment.

Working Environment & Expectations 

- Execution Velocity: We prioritize shipping experiments quickly, learning from real-world data, and iterating fast.

- Tooling Ownership & Independence: You will have complete autonomy over our stack. We expect you to proactively recommend and implement the best modern automation and AI solutions. You define the tools you need to win.

- Asynchronous Communication: Clear documentation, meticulous task tracking, and transparent status updates are core to how we work, allowing you to manage your own time effectively.

Why join Papers? 

- Work with cutting-edge technology that actually matters with a team that is obsessed with redefining what cutting edge means.

- High ownership, low bureaucracy. Your voice drives the strategy, giving you the independence to define your own processes.

- Influence the Growth strategy from day one.

- Competitive compensation structure tied directly to your impact, with clear pathways for career growth.

- 25 days paid vacation per year.

- Regular team events and retreats (at least quarterly).

- Support for your ongoing learning and development.r

title: Senior Embedded Performance Engineer
description:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. 

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Performance Engineer who is passionate about getting the most out of embedded systems — from low-level Linux tuning and hardware integration to high-performance video and data pipelines. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to hardware, moving across the stack, and solving the kinds of problems where milliseconds, bandwidth, startup time, and system efficiency matter.

You will work across the AuterionOS ecosystem on topics such as:

- Embedded Linux performance and system tuning

- Low-latency video streaming and media pipelines

- C/C++, Python, and Bash-based platform development

- Hardware integration, system profiling, and end-to-end optimization

- Collaboration with experienced and driven engineers across Auterion

Responsibilities 

- Work within the Apps & Simulation team and collaborate with other development teams to build high-performance products for autonomous systems.

- Design, optimize, and maintain performance-critical components within AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.

- Improve end-to-end system behavior across compute, networking, video, and hardware interfaces, with a strong focus on latency, throughput, reliability, and resource efficiency.

- Analyze and optimize demanding workloads such as real-time telemetry, video streaming, media processing, and communication between distributed system components.

- Investigate system bottlenecks across the full stack, from kernel and OS behavior to application-level code and tooling.

- Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases, and translate them into robust technical solutions.

- Propose and implement new platform capabilities with a strong emphasis on measurable performance gains in real-world deployments.

- Participate in daily stand-ups, release planning, and prioritization discussions.

Qualifications and Skills 

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

- 5+ years of professional experience writing object-oriented C++ and/or Python.

- Deep experience with embedded Linux systems, including cross-compilation, debugging, profiling, and performance tuning.

- Strong hands-on background in diagnosing and optimizing real-world system behavior, including CPU, memory, I/O, networking, boot time, and application latency.

- Experience building or optimizing low-latency video or data-streaming pipelines, ideally on embedded platforms.

- Excellent understanding of software systems that span embedded devices, higher-level applications, and fully integrated products.

- Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, implementation, debugging, and testing.

- Experience with video codecs, GStreamer, RTP/RTSP, or hardware-accelerated media pipelines.

- Solid experience with Debian/Ubuntu-based systems, Bash scripting, and systemd.

- Experience with Docker and docker-compose in complex development and deployment environments, as well as qemu.

- Strong debugging and performance analysis skills at both system and application level, combined with a proactive and self-directed working style.

- Proficient in ROS2/DDS-style middleware and experienced with networking across multiple OSI layers, including REST APIs and performance-sensitive communication paths.

- Experience with system integration and interfacing sensors or peripherals, especially via USB and Ethernet.

- Experience working in an agile engineering environment with stand-ups, sprint planning, and shared ownership across teams.

- Bonus: Experience with build systems such as CMake, including improving build performance in large-scale software projects.

Benefits 

- Flexible working hours

- Stock Options

- Generous holiday allowance

- Company pension plan 

- Car parking 

- Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

- Mental health and wellbeing support

- Learning and development opportunities

About Auterion 

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

As OpenSpace's Solutions Consultant for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, you'll be the technical and commercial partner to our Account Executives. title: Computational Scientist / Scientific Machine Learning
description:
Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation, and control stack for the fusion energy reactors of the future.

Spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and backed by top investors, our technology enables reliable operation, real-time monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices. We are founded by world-class experts at the intersection of fusion physics, advanced control, and AI (ex-Google DeepMind, EPFL). We are assembling a founding engineering team in Lausanne to build our core technology platform.

We are looking for a Computational Scientist specialized in Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) to join our team. This job is for you if you know how to write numerical solvers that are fast, correct and differentiable end to end, and want to see them run against real plasma data and inside real control systems.

We are looking for a PhD-level or senior computational researcher for this role.

Responsibilities

- Design, implement and validate differentiable solvers in JAX for plasma physics problems such as free-boundary equilibrium, transport and state estimation.

- Make them robust and fast enough for production use via advanced numerical techniques for differential equation time stepping, as well as optimization of GPU/TPU performance.

- Using automatic differentiation for model calibration against experimental data, parameter estimation and controller design and optimization, working with our data and control engineers.

- Code ownership: quality, testing, verification against reference solutions, packaging and documentation.

Requirements

- Substantial code written in a differentiable framework. Our stack is in JAX, Julia or PyTorch experts are very welcome if they’re happy to switch.

- Strong background in numerical methods for ODEs and PDEs: discretisation, stiff and implicit solvers, nonlinear and sparse linear solvers.

- Demonstrated ability to operate at the frontier of SciML, Universal Differential Equations, Neural ODEs, and other emerging hybrid data-driven/mechanistic paradigms.

- Evidence of independent work at the highest level: a PhD or thesis, published code that is used by others, or an industry project you owned.

- Experience in the following fields an advantage but not strictly required:

- The JAX ecosystem: Diffrax, Equinox, Optax, Lineax.

- Plasma, fluid, electromagnetic, or other multiphysics simulation.

- Having led the design of a scientific codebase used by others.

What we offer

- Play a key role at a dynamic, fast-growing startup, shaping the technical solutions and products from the ground up.

- Build cutting-edge technology to monitor and control plasmas in real fusion devices, working side-by-side with leading plasma and control experts.

- Great working conditions, located in Lausanne, Switzerland, a city and country known for its high quality of life.

- Competitive salary and equity compensation and benefits including immigration assistance.

title: Senior C/C++ Low Latency Engineer
description:
Your job 

This role is crucial for our organization. Our Technology team is small and therefore you get a lot of responsibilities and freedom! You are triggered by being faster than the competitors and you like to focus on quality. As you can imagine in a small team, there is a flat hierarchy and everybody is really hands-on to be the best in what we do!

We are looking for senior C/C++ Engineers with extensive knowledge and experience in building, testing, monitoring and maintaining large scale parallel applications and databases. As a C/C++ Engineer at Mathrix in the low latency environment, your focus will be on the code which facilitates the automated trades on various exchanges worldwide.

Our companies’ performance is highly dependent on the performance of our data processing pipelines. You will regularly need to appeal to all aspects of your developers’ skillset to find new and innovative ways to optimize your code. Some examples:

- low-latency networking code for fast communication with exchanges

- context-switch-free code

- design and implement custom data storage structures with minimalistic footprint

- data pipelines using a streaming paradigm

- complex trading logic for the decision engine with the lowest possible compute time

- re-implement existing code using advanced features of the CPU (SIMD)

To accommodate the growth of the company, we spend increasing efforts on the maintainability and manageability of our large, highly optimized and multithreaded codebases while preserving its main purpose (low latency). You will have to maneuver yourself between these worlds to get the best results.

In addition to writing code, the Technology team builds and maintains the global (hardware) infrastructure to facilitate the trading. In your job you will be regularly involved in all aspects of the pipeline and different tech stacks; from hardware compositions, network design to data logging pipelines for the traders and quants.

Who are you 

Due to the growth of our organization, we are looking for more than one C/C++ Engineer. As the new team member, you bring the following skillset:

- extensive and thorough knowledge of C and C++ in Linux

- an understanding of – and the ability to verify - the assembly the compiler will produce from the code you write

- understanding what (GNU/Linux) system calls you invoke will do and cost

- knowledge of x64 hardware and how to use it efficiently

- understanding what storage structures to select or implement given their use (time complexity)

- ability to work with debuggers and profilers

- operative coding (git, documentation)

- ability to absorb from and provide knowledge to the team

- pro-active, a self-starter, honest, flexible and stress resistant

In addition to the above, having a background in one of the specializations below are nice to have:

- experience with network engineering; either (low latency) networking hardware deployment or networking protocol implementations

- experience with Big Data engineering and knowledge of Big Data best practices and implementations best suited for different use cases

What we offer 

- Excellent remuneration (including discretionary bonus)

- Fun and inspiring work environment

- Experienced and knowledgeable colleagues

- 25 vacation days

- Additional benefits: going out for dinner regularly, Friday afternoon drinks, yearly office trip(s), weekly massages, monthly meal allowance

title: Strategic Account Executive - Switzerland
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role 

We're looking for an experienced, driven Strategic Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs' growth across Switzerland's largest enterprises. Our ideal candidate has a well-established network and a proven track record of selling to C-level and senior decision-makers at major Swiss brands and is passionate about the transformative possibilities of AI voice technology.

In this role you'll act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor, enabling clients to leverage our industry-leading models and ElevenAgents — our end-to-end platform for building and deploying AI voice agents — to reimagine their customer experience, internal workflows, and monetization strategies.

In this role you will:

- Build and manage a growing portfolio of strategic accounts across Switzerland to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals.

- Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs' conversational AI capabilities, including ElevenAgents, can drive customer engagement, contact center automation, and operational efficiency for consumer and retail brands.

- Lead consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, building compelling business cases that translate AI voice technology into measurable business value for senior executives and economic buyers.

- Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends, particularly as they apply to Swiss consumer and retail organizations operating at scale.

- Demonstrate expertise, or a strong willingness to learn, about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs' voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, IVR modernization, and in-app assistants.

- Develop and execute account strategies to expand ElevenLabs' presence within the Swiss consumer and retail sector, navigating complex procurement and organizational structures.

- Partner closely with Customer Success, FDEs and Solutions Engineering to ensure smooth onboarding, deployment, and expansion of accounts.

- Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, educating C-suite and senior operations leaders on emerging trends in generative AI, voice interfaces, and conversational agents.

Requirements 

- 7+ years of quota-carrying strategic sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms.

- Proven success closing deals and managing long, complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across business, IT, legal, and procurement.

- Well-connected in the Swiss consumer and retail landscape, with an existing network of senior individuals and strong executive presence and ability to build relationships at the C-suite and board level.

- Experience selling technical solutions to product and engineering leaders; ability to translate complex technology into business value.

- Deep understanding of enterprise procurement and legal processes in Switzerland, with the ability to accelerate deal velocity within complex organizational structures.

- Comfort operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment, including building new playbooks and iterating quickly.

- Passion for voice and audio AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers.

- A hybrid of customer and product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction and scale.

- Swiss German is the preferred default language for this role; fluency in both Swiss German and French is a strong plus given Switzerland's multilingual market. Strong English is also required for internal collaboration.

Location 

This is an in-country role based in Zurich.

Warum funktioniert ein Creative diese Woche und nächste Woche nicht mehr? Und wie wird aus einem Like eine Bestellung, in der Schweiz und bald auch in Europa?

Genau dafür suchen wir dich. 
Wir holen Content und Creative gerade ins Haus. Meta läuft seit August bei uns statt bei einer Agentur. Jetzt suchen wir eine Person, die Verantwortung übernimmt: für unseren Content, für unsere organischen Kanäle und dafür, dass bluu in der Schweiz und in Europa sichtbar wird und wächst.

Deine Verantwortung

- Organic Social Growth: Du verantwortest das organische Wachstum unserer Kanäle @bluuwash in der Schweiz. Gleichzeitig baust du sie im EU-Raum aus. Dein Ziel: mehr Markenbekanntheit und mehr Umsatz in jedem Markt.

- Sparring Paid Social: Unsere Junior Growth & Brand Managerin betreut die Paid-Kanäle. Du bist ihr Sparringpartner: Ihr schaut gemeinsam auf die Performance, leitet daraus ab, was als Nächstes kommt, und du setzt es direkt als Content um.

- Content & Creatives: Du entscheidest, wie bluu dargestellt wird und wie unsere Ads aussehen. Du entwickelst Angles und Hooks und schreibst die Ad-Skripte, für unsere eigenen Videos und für unsere UGC-Creator. Du filmst und schneidest selbst. Hinter der Kamera bist du sicher unterwegs. Wenn du auch gern vor der Kamera stehst, umso besser.

- Organic Content aus dem Alltag: Du filmst Office-, Behind-the-Scenes- und Produktcontent und machst daraus Reichweite auf unseren Kanälen.

- E-Mail, WhatsApp & Redaktionsplan: Du verantwortest das gesamte E-Mail-Marketing und baust WhatsApp als neuen Kanal auf. Die Leitplanken für den Redaktionsplan setzen wir gemeinsam mit der Head of Marketing. Die Detailplanung und die Umsetzung über alle Kanäle liegen bei dir.

Das sind deine Kernaufgaben, nicht die ganze Stelle. 
Wir sind ein Startup, und die Rolle entwickelt sich mit uns. Laufend kommen neue Themen dazu, zum Beispiel:

- neue Produkte im Markt positionieren und dafür den passenden Content entwickeln

- Content laufend anpassen, testen und weiterentwickeln, je nachdem, was funktioniert

- neue Formate, Kanäle und Märkte ausprobieren

Wenn du gern Neues anpackst und dich wechselnde Prioritäten nicht aus dem Konzept bringen, bist du bei uns richtig.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Junior Growth & Brand Managerin, mit Customer Experience und mit Product zusammen und berichtest direkt an die Head of Marketing.

Das bringst du mit

- mehrjährige Erfahrung im Social Media, Content oder Digital Marketing, idealerweise bei einer D2C-Marke mit Onlineshop

- nachweisbare Erfolge beim Aufbau organischer Social-Kanäle

- Du liest Performance-Daten, zum Beispiel aus Meta Ads, und leitest daraus ab, welcher Content als Nächstes kommt

Nice to have: 

- Erfahrung mit dem Ausbau in neue Märkte, zum Beispiel DE oder AT

- erste Erfahrung mit WhatsApp-Marketing

- Erfahrung mit Creator- und UGC-Kooperationen

- Du stehst ab und zu gern selbst vor der Kamera

Das erwartet dich bei bluu

- echte Verantwortung für Kanäle und Märkte, die du selbst prägst

- ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen und echten Entscheiden

- Themen, die du von null aufbaust, zum Beispiel WhatsApp und neue EU-Märkte

So bewirbst du dich

Variante A: Motivationsvideo (max. 3 Minuten) 
Erzähl uns:

- was dich an bluu und der Stelle begeistert

Format, Stil und Setting wählst du selbst. Sei kreativ und bring deine Persönlichkeit rein. Wir wollen sehen, wie du denkst, nicht wie perfekt du dich präsentierst.

Variante B: Motivationsschreiben und Portfolio 
Im Motivationsschreiben erzählst du uns, warum du zu bluu passt. Im Portfolio zeigst du Content, den du selbst konzipiert, gefilmt oder geschnitten hast, am besten mit ein paar Worten dazu, was funktioniert hat und warum.

title: ML Intern: Optimization Quality & Monitoring
description:
Our common vision

Our mission is to help marketing teams unlock their full growth potential with AI. Our AI-powered attribution creates real transparency, showing how digital advertising investments perform across channels. On that foundation, we optimize budgets so our customers can sustainably grow their bottom line. We support leading European brands across e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance & energy, and many other industries in making their marketing smarter, more efficient, and more impactful.

About the role

Nexoya runs fully automated, AI-driven budget optimizations and simulations for enterprise marketing portfolios across many ad channels. Every result that reaches a customer must be correct, explainable and on time. As our ML Intern, you make sure it is: you monitor pipeline health, check the quality of predictions, optimizations and simulations, investigate anomalies and turn recurring manual checks into reliable tooling. You work closely with our ML engineers and Customer Success, and you see directly how your work shapes our customers' budget decisions.

Your responsibilities

Monitor the automation and assure result quality

- Monitor the automated prediction, optimization and simulation pipelines across customer portfolios and track run health, completeness and timeliness.

- Verify that predictions, optimization proposals and simulation results meet our quality standards before they reach customers: budget shifts, expected KPI changes, channel constraints and funnel-level effects.

- Investigate failed or unexpected runs, identify the root cause (data, configuration or model) and resolve it or escalate it with a clear diagnosis.

Assure the quality of results over time

- Define and maintain plausibility checks for optimization and simulation results, for example for budget planning, seasonal shifts or new channel tests.

- Make sure results are consistent and explainable, so that customers and account managers can trust them without manual checks.

- Compare optimized and simulated outcomes with realized performance, document deviations and feed the findings back to the ML team.

Safeguard data and model quality

- Monitor input data for gaps, anomalies and tracking changes that affect optimization quality.

- Track model fit and prediction accuracy per portfolio and flag degradation early.

- Maintain portfolio configurations such as funnel steps, constraints and target definitions together with the responsible teams.

Automate the operational workflow

- Replace manual checks with Python scripts, validation rules and alerts.

- Build and maintain dashboards that show run status, data health and model performance across portfolios.

- Write runbooks so that operational knowledge is shared, not held by one person.

The impact you will have

- Customers receive optimization proposals and simulations that are correct and delivered on time.

- Issues are caught before customers see them, not after.

- The time the ML team spends on operational work goes down measurably, because recurring steps are automated.

- Customer Success can trust automated optimization and simulation results without checking them by hand.

Your experience and skills

- Recently completed Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field.

- Solid Python skills, including pandas and NumPy, and comfort working with SQL.

- Good understanding of statistics and basic machine learning concepts such as regression, model evaluation and overfitting.

- A careful, structured way of working: you check results before you share them and you document what you do.

- Ability to explain technical findings clearly to non-technical colleagues.

- Fluent English, spoken and written, is a must.

Bonus points

- Experience with optimization methods, for example constrained or non-convex optimization.

- Familiarity with Marketing Mix Modeling, attribution or digital advertising metrics.

- Experience with data pipelines, scheduled jobs or monitoring tools.

- Experience with Git, Docker and cloud environments.

- Fluent in German or Italian.

Your future work life

- Purpose: Your work directly influences how enterprise marketers allocate their budgets.

- Responsibility: You own the quality of a defined part of our automation from day one, with a personal development roadmap and regular feedback.

- Learning: You work alongside experienced ML and data engineers on production systems, not on side projects.

- Culture: A transparent company culture at eye level, where every person is valued and supported.

- Strategy: You take part in shaping company strategy and culture during our quarterly Strategy Days.

- Events: Regular team events, on-site and off-site.

Application process

- Profile review and short phone screen

- Take-home case study

- Case discussion with the ML team

- On-site interview and team evaluation

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
description:
About Nebius: 

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Role Summary

Nebius Token Factory is building production-grade inference for open-source, customer, and internally optimized models. This role owns the path from model artifact to fast, reliable, cost-efficient endpoint. The work sits at the intersection of model internals, inference engines, serving architecture, benchmarking, and production deployment.

What You Will Do

- 
Own a platform-level optimization pillar such as quantization, speculative decoding, KV -cache optimization, engine selection, or long-context serving.

- 
Create reusable evaluation, benchmarking, and rollout frameworks across multiple model families.

- 
Provide technical direction to MLEs, Applied Scientists, GPU kernel engineers, and infrastructure engineers on shared performance goals.

- 
Optimize LLM and VLM endpoints for latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.

- 
Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, or similar systems.

- 
Build and productionize model-compression workflows, including quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.

- 
Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV -cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving.

- 
Build reproducible benchmark harnesses for TTFT , TPOT , tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token.

- 
Partner with GPU kernel engineers and platform engineers to diagnose bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.

- 
Write clear design docs, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.

Required Qualifications

- 
Strong Python and PyTorch engineering skills.

- 
Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM , or high-throughput transformer inference systems.

- 
Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or equivalent internal systems.

- 
Strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks, including KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.

- 
Ability to reason quantitatively about latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost tradeoffs.

- 
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.

Preferred Qualifications

- 
Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8 , INT8 , INT4 , NVFP4 , MXFP4 , AWQ , GPTQ , SmoothQuant, or related techniques.

- 
Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or other inference acceleration methods.

- 
Experience with agentic workloads, including tool calling, structured outputs, streaming APIs, high concurrency, and multi-step orchestration.

- 
CUDA or Triton familiarity, even if the role is not primarily a kernel-engineering role.

- 
Open-source contributions to vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, FlashInfer, LMCache, PyTorch, Triton, Ray, KServe, or related projects.

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Voor onze opdrachtgever Snelstart zoekt Sound People een senior growth marketeer die strategie en data naadloos verbindt. Snelstart helpt dagelijks ondernemers, boekhouders en accountants slimmer te werken en groeit hard. Met 180.000 gebruikers is het een van de grootste boekhoud en accountancy software platforms van Nederland Jij wordt eigenaar van de volledige growth-loop: acquisitie, activatie en engagement, en werkt nauw samen met Marketing, Product, Data en Sales. 

De rol van senior growth marketeer bij Snelstart 

• Ontwikkel, voer uit en schaal de growth-strategie voor self-serve en sales-led acquisitie. 

• Ontwerp en run high-impact experimenten over de hele funnel (campagnes, onboarding, pricing, funnels, content, AI-automatisering). 

• Analyseer gedrag en data diepgaand; identificeer patronen, kansen en bottlenecks. 

• Bouw repeatable growth loops en automatisering voor schaal. 

• Optimaliseer paid performance kanalen (creatives, audiences, attributie). 

• Co-creëer met Product voor betere activation, onboarding en retention. 

• Zet moderne tooling in: AI-personalisatie, marketing automation, tracking, testing, analytics. 

• Werk met leadership aan prioritering, rapportage en roadmap-invloed.

Er is veel te doen en je krijgt veel vrijheid én verantwoordelijkheid. Je maakt diepe impact en je mening wordt serieus genomen. Jouw data inzichten en suggesties vormen de basis voor belangrijke beslissingen en keuze die Snelstart gaat maken in de toekomst. Je zit én aan de knoppen én je bepaalt mede de richting voor verdere groei van de organisatie o.a. mbt tot klantinzichten.
