title: Studio Director
description:
As Studio Director, you will lead the end-to-end operation of Suitsupply's photo studio, ensuring the efficient delivery of high-quality visual assets across every customer touchpoint. You will drive operational excellence through process optimization, resource planning, and technology enablement, partnering closely with Creative, Brand, Merchandising, Marketing, E-Commerce, and Production teams. This role calls for a strong operational mindset, balancing quality, speed, cost, and capacity while identifying opportunities to simplify processes and increase productivity. You will own the studio's technology roadmap, including AI-driven solutions, and lead a cross-functional network of photographers, stylists, retouchers, and producers. Your leadership will directly shape the scalability, efficiency, and creative output of one of Suitsupply's core content production functions. 

What You Will Do 

- Lead day-to-day studio operations — managing capacity, resource allocation, schedules, and workload planning — and ensure output is delivered on time, on budget, and to quality standards. 

- Coordinate photographers, stylists, retouchers, and producers, and establish KPIs and reporting to track throughput, turnaround, utilization, and quality. 

- Own and continuously improve end-to-end studio workflows, using production data and bottleneck analysis to eliminate inefficiencies and drive scalable ways of working. 

- Evaluate, implement, and optimize technologies for production planning, asset management, and workflow automation, leveraging AI to accelerate content production and improve quality control. 

- Build business cases for technology investments and drive adoption across the studio team, partnering with Technology and Digital teams. 

- Serve as the primary operational point of contact for studio matters across Creative, Brand, Marketing, Merchandising, Retail, E-commerce, and Production teams. 

- Manage external partners — retouching, production, equipment, and technology vendors — negotiating contracts and rates to ensure cost-effective, high-quality service. 

- Own the studio operating budget across external retouching, tooling, technology, equipment, and resources, monitoring productivity, utilization, and costs to optimize spend. 

- Support strategic planning and future studio capability development. 

Who You Are 

- 10+ years in studio operations, content production, or related operational leadership, with proven experience managing high-volume production in fashion, retail, e-commerce, or a comparable industry. 

- Strong operational and analytical mindset, using data and metrics to improve workflows, simplify processes, and drive efficiency. 

- Experience implementing new technologies, workflow management systems, and AI-enabled solutions; hands-on with platforms such as Creative Force, Photoshop, and Figma. 

- Strong project, stakeholder, and resource management skills across competing priorities and deadlines. 

- Commercially minded, with experience managing budgets, vendors, and operational performance. 

- Self-directed, pragmatic, and solution-oriented, with strong ownership and accountability. 

- Bachelor's degree in Photography, Creative Production, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred. 

What You Will Get 

- Autonomy: We empower you to take ownership, make meaningful decisions, and drive impact without layers of sign-off. 

- Growth: We see your potential as a key asset. At Suitsupply, you'll have abundant opportunities to learn, grow, and excel in a supportive environment that encourages development at every step. 

- Corporate Social Responsibility: Our commitment to sustainability and ethical business is unwavering. We work exclusively with suppliers who uphold the highest standards, in alignment with the International Labour Organization. 

- Style: Immerse yourself in a world of beautifully crafted, high-quality products, and enjoy a 40% discount on Suitsupply products. 

- Compensation: We offer a competitive salary of based on relevant skills and experience.

description:
Job description :

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and technical teams to analyze business needs, define requirements, and ensure successful delivery of features within an Agile/SAFe environment.

The role involves managing the product backlog, preparing and refining user stories, facilitating requirements workshops, supporting PI Planning and sprint execution, and coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT). The ideal candidate will have knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power BI, Power Pages, and Dataverse, as well as the ability to leverage AI tools to improve requirements gathering and business process analysis.

Key responsibilities :

- Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders, Product Owners, and SMEs to gather, analyze, validate, and document business and technical requirements.

- Feature & Backlog Management: Analyze upcoming roadmap features, identify business value, dependencies, risks, and gaps, and continuously refine the product backlog.

- User Stories & Acceptance Criteria: Create and refine Epics, Features, and User Stories with clear scope, detailed acceptance criteria, dependencies, and relevant functional and non-functional requirements.

- Business Process Documentation: Prepare process flows (as-is/to-be), mockups, business rules, data mappings, impact assessments, and other supporting documentation as required.

- Microsoft Power Platform: Understand Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven), Power BI, Power Pages, Dataverse, access structures, data models, solution architecture, and inbound/outbound data flows.

- Agile & SAFe Delivery: Participate in PI Planning, backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily meetings, system demos, and other Agile/SAFe ceremonies.

- PI Preparation: Support pre-PI planning activities, identify knowledge gaps and dependencies, prepare refinement materials, and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure feature readiness.

- Definition of Ready & Definition of Done: Ensure that User Stories meet the agreed Definition of Ready (DoR) before entering a sprint and contain the necessary information to support the Definition of Done (DoD).

- Technical & Cross-Team Coordination: Collaborate with development leads, testers, Product Owners, and other teams to clarify technical feasibility, resolve dependencies, and maintain alignment on scope and responsibilities.

- User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Prepare UAT scenarios, use cases, and sample test data; coordinate end-user testing; collect and analyze feedback; and document decisions and follow-up backlog items.

- Delivery & Release Support: Verify that delivered functionality meets business requirements, prepare sprint release notes, and ensure that documentation, user guidance, and training materials are updated.

- Documentation & Traceability: Maintain centralized and accessible project documentation in tools such as SharePoint or Wiki, ensuring traceability from Epics and Features through User Stories, acceptance tests, and releases.

- AI-Assisted Analysis: Use AI capabilities such as Copilot, AI agents, and other relevant tools to support requirements gathering, process analysis, validation of assumptions, and initial solution ideation.

- Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify business processes, improve requirements quality, and maintain a backlog buffer of approximately 1.5–2 sprints of ready User Stories.

Job requirments:

- Proven experience as a Business Analyst in Agile/Scrum and SAFe environments.

- Strong experience in requirements elicitation, stakeholder management, business process analysis, and documentation.

- Practical knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including:

- Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven apps)

- Power BI

- Power Pages

- Microsoft Dataverse

- Data models, access structures, and data integrations.

- Experience defining and refining Epics, Features, User Stories, and detailed Acceptance Criteria.

- Knowledge of backlog management, refinement sessions, sprint planning, and PI Planning.

- Experience with business process modelling, process flows, mockups, business rules, data mappings, and impact assessments.

- Understanding of functional and non-functional requirements, including performance, scalability, availability, security, auditability, and GDPR/privacy.

- Knowledge of Definition of Ready (DoR), Definition of Done (DoD), and requirements traceability.

- Experience supporting UAT, including test scenario preparation, test data coordination, feedback analysis, and defect or backlog item management.

- Ability to identify dependencies, clarify scope, assess gaps, and coordinate with technical teams and business stakeholders.

- Familiarity with technical documentation, solution architecture, data models, APIs, and integration flows.

- Experience using documentation and collaboration tools such as SharePoint, Wiki, and backlog management platforms.

- Awareness of AI tools, including Copilot and AI agents, for requirements analysis, process improvement, and solution ideation.

- Strong communication, analytical, facilitation, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

- Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple features and priorities in a structured delivery environment.

Binnen Whitevision krijg je de ruimte om door te groeien naar rollen met meer strategische, organisatorische en internationale impact. title: Agentic AI Principal
description:
We are looking for an Agentic AI Principal to act as a senior technical authority and trusted client advisor for complex agentic AI transformation in Germany, the Netherlands and the wider DACH region.

Operating at Principal level, you will shape enterprise AI strategy, define agentic architecture blueprints, lead high-value C-suite engagements and guide complex programmes from opportunity through delivery. You will bring deep hands-on credibility in multi-agent systems, governance and safeguards, while setting reusable patterns and raising capability across teams.

The role has particular focus on sovereign, compliant and production-grade agentic AI for regulated German, Dutch and European enterprises, with a primary focus on healthcare and life sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech and healthcare providers). Experience from other regulated sectors, such as financial services and insurance, automotive and manufacturing, energy and telecommunications, is equally welcome.

Our delivery model is moving from large time-and-materials teams to small, AI-first, multidisciplinary pods accountable to a business outcome. You will anchor the agentic side of that work, pairing with our data, tech advisory and industry domain leads from presale through delivery.

This is a client-facing, builder's leadership role. You will start with a small, senior team and grow it through technical depth, delivery excellence and thought leadership, rather than inheriting a large organisation.

Job responsibilities

Shaping and winning 

- Agentic AI advisory and strategy: shape and solution complex German, Dutch and DACH pursuits with account, commercial and delivery leaders, translating client needs into differentiated propositions, credible architectures and executable delivery approaches that support regional pipeline conversion.

- Independently drive complex pursuits with technical and executive stakeholders, including shaping the commercial model (fixed-price, outcome-linked), trade-offs and risk.

- Act as a sparring partner to C-suite buyers (CEO, CIO, CDO, CISO, COO): frame business-outcome hypotheses, challenge assumptions and define a thin slice of agentic delivery that proves value quickly.

- Represent Thoughtworks' agentic AI expertise in strategic client conversations, industry forums, partnerships and thought leadership where appropriate.

Designing and building 

- Design and build engineering: set the architecture direction for complex, production-grade agentic AI systems, including multi-agent workflows, orchestration, tool use, memory, context strategy, retrieval, evaluation, observability and enterprise integration.

- Integrate agents with the German enterprise core: SAP (S/4HANA, BTP), LIMS, QMS and clinical systems, MES/PLM and industrial systems, and legacy back-office platforms, using open protocols such as MCP and A2A where they fit.

- Ensure agents run on trustworthy data foundations, working with data engineering and data product teams on data quality, semantics and access.

- Design solutions for regulated German and EU environments, with strong consideration of data sovereignty (EU and German sovereign cloud, open-weight or self-hosted models where required), privacy, security, responsible AI and applicable regulation, including the EU AI Act and GDPR; for healthcare and life sciences GxP, EU MDR/IVDR and the European Health Data Space; and for other sectors DORA, NIS2 and BaFin requirements where relevant.

- Guide teams in balancing rapid experimentation with robust production engineering, including evaluation-driven development, testing, CI/CD, reliability, cost and performance optimisation.

- Provide technical and delivery leadership for complex programmes, staying hands-on enough to validate architecture, unblock teams, manage technical risk and ensure successful execution.

- Partner with product, data, software engineering, enterprise architecture, governance and change specialists to design end-to-end solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

Governance and safeguards 

- Establish reusable patterns for observability, auditability, traceability and control of agentic systems, enabling teams to demonstrate safe and reliable behaviour in production.

- Translate EU AI Act obligations (risk classification, human oversight, logging, technical documentation, GPAI-provider responsibilities) into concrete engineering controls and evidence.

- Engage early with works councils (Betriebsrat, ondernemingsraad), data protection officers and information security, supporting DPIAs and co-determination processes so agentic solutions that touch employee workflows can go live.

Principal-level leadership and growing capability

- Set technical direction across multiple teams and initiatives, defining reusable patterns, frameworks and engineering standards for agentic AI delivery.

- Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, build the next generation of the German team, and raise AI fluency and agentic engineering standards across specialists and generalists.

- Evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies and frameworks and guide their responsible adoption based on client context, engineering quality and business value.

- Build our German and Dutch market presence through local-language points of view, ecosystem and partner initiatives (hyperscalers, SAP, European model providers) and community events.

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

- Deep expertise in modern software engineering and Python, with a strong track record of setting standards for testing, CI/CD, observability, maintainability and production reliability.

- Recognised experience architecting and delivering complex GenAI and agentic AI systems at enterprise scale, from early discovery through production deployment.

- Deep knowledge of agentic architectures and frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex or equivalent, including tool use, orchestration, memory, multi-agent coordination and interoperability protocols (MCP, A2A).

- Strong expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation, advanced information retrieval, vector databases and enterprise knowledge integration.

- Experience designing evaluation strategies for GenAI and agentic systems, including quality, safety, reliability, latency and cost measures.

- Strong understanding of AI governance and safeguards, including guardrails, red-teaming, observability, responsible AI and secure deployment practices (prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse).

- Significant experience deploying AI systems on major cloud platforms using containers, orchestration and production-grade infrastructure patterns, including EU sovereign cloud, hybrid or on-premises setups and self-hosted open-weight models.

- Experience with model adaptation and optimisation techniques, including prompt/context engineering, fine-tuning where appropriate, and application-level performance optimisation.

- Ability to make sound architecture trade-offs across model capability, reliability, security, compliance, performance and cost.

- Working knowledge of the EU AI Act, GDPR and sector rules (for healthcare and life sciences: GxP and GAMP 5 computerised-system validation, EU MDR/IVDR, EHDS; for other sectors: DORA, NIS2, BaFin) and how they shape agentic system design.

- Strongly preferred: delivering AI in healthcare or life sciences (e.g. R&D, clinical, regulatory, manufacturing quality, commercial). 

- Nice to have: integrating agents with SAP and industrial or manufacturing systems; data product and data platform foundations for AI.

Consulting and Commercial Track Record

- Proven ability to lead C-suite and senior client engagements, rapidly establish credibility and advise on both business and technical choices.

Professional Skills

- Proven ability to mentor senior engineers and technical leaders and raise standards across a wider engineering community.

- Self-directed, prioritisation-led working style, with creative problem-solving in fixed-scope, outcome-driven work.

- Experience navigating German and Dutch stakeholder structures, including works councils, data protection officers and procurement.

- German B2 minimum , C1 strongly preferred; fluent English. Dutch is a plus for Netherlands-based candidates.

Other things to know

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. title: AI Engineer (Agentic AI)
description:
Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Medior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD 

GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a useful answer. It does this with agents: specialised AI components that each handle part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can't just sound fluent. It has to be correct, and you must be able to see which source it comes from. This is not a pilot project: the platform runs in production and is used heavily every day.

As a medior, your focus is on building. You work independently, on challenges that come from customers and on challenges we spot ourselves. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? You say so, and your colleagues think along with you.

You build and improve the agents of GenIA-L and the way they work together.

You build and maintain our knowledge packages: for each legal article, an expert-validated set of commentary, case law, parliamentary history and practical interpretation. You also work on the pipelines that create these packages and keep them up to date.

You make quality measurable. With evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability really improve. Not by gut feeling, but with evidence.

You build features for customers, such as analysing their own documents and new ways to search case law.

You work directly with editors and subject-matter experts, and check with them which parts of a legal question really matter.

You come up with and test ideas to make the product sharper or faster, and alternate AI experiments with back-end development.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You enjoy following new AI developments, but you don't just follow the herd: you stay critical. You think in a structured way and can break a complex problem into smaller pieces. You work independently, take initiative when things are unclear and are eager to learn fast. And you enjoy working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like.

- You have several years of experience in software or ML engineering. Depth in recent projects counts for more than years.

- Strong experience in agentic AI. 

- You have good knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries.

- You have helped build an LLM application that runs in production. Not just prototypes, notebooks or courses.

- You have hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or comparable orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer (RAG) setup is not enough.

- You have measured the quality of an LLM system with evaluation sets or observability, and can give a concrete example. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus.

- You have back-end experience, including building REST APIs.

- You have experience in Kubernetes. Experience with Postgres is useful.

- Experience in a legal, tax or other knowledge-intensive domain is a plus.

WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR 

On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck.

- A place where you have influence from day one: on the approach, the processes, and the direction.

- Colleagues who deliberately chose Lefebvre Sdu over big tech jobs because here, they're building something that doesn't exist yet.

- Base salary between €4,477 and €5,793 per month, based on a 36-hour week, since that's full-time for us. Plus a lot of extra allowances (see below).

- A bonus tied to company performance: a fixed year-end bonus of 4% and profit sharing of up to 6%.

- 23 vacation days and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday pay and 4% is freely allocable. Want more vacation? Just buy it.

- A bonus of up to 10% of your salary, based on company performance and individual performance.

- A solid pension plan through PGB, including supplementary partner insurance.

- Collective insurance plans.

- A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer or a public transport reimbursement, plus an attractive bike plan. For employees with a commute of less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement.

- Two days a week in the office in The Hague, within walking distance of Voorburg station. The rest of the week, wherever you work best.

- Room to grow: in your craft, in your role, in the organization.

WANT TO KNOW MORE? 

We'd love to tell you everything about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you'll hear from us within 2 working days. Any questions first? Text or call Nadine at 0628556265.

More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. You’ll define the technical direction for Airwallex’s Payments Platform, lead architecture decisions and build highly reliable, high-volume distributed systems that directly affect merchant experience and business outcomes.

You’ll drive complex initiatives across payment gateways, acquiring, issuing, card networks and local payment methods, while partnering with product, business, infrastructure and external engineering teams to turn merchant needs into technical solutions.

- Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence across engineering, product and business stakeholders.

Preferred

- Experience integrating major card networks such as Visa and Mastercard.

- Experience with local payment methods such as iDEAL, Klarna, Trustly or similar.

- Familiarity with authorisation, capture, refunds, chargebacks, settlement, reconciliation, fraud, risk or PCI/compliance workflows.

- Experience mentoring senior engineers and leading cross-team technical initiatives.

- You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

- You own the outcome and you don’t wait for permission to fix what’s broken.

- You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you’ll run with it.

- Own the timeline, rollout plan and account while it is in implementation, preparing and executing onboarding plans with strong project management and directing work across the internal team.

- Act as the subject matter expert in change management and adoption, leading customers through introducing a new travel tool and policies, and providing guides, templates and recommendations to support long-term success.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer 

Shiftbase is building the self-driving assistant for shift-based businesses across Europe. Our customers range from independent restaurants in Amsterdam to multi-location retailers in München, and they spend hours every week on scheduling, time tracking, payroll prep, and HR admin. We want to take that work off their plate and eventually do it for them. 

Underneath that product vision sits a data challenge. Insight, automation, and AI all depend on data people can trust, and the foundation for it doesn't exist yet. 

You will build the foundation that fixes this. 

What you'll do 

- Architect the warehouse. Design and own our BigQuery and Dataform warehouse from the ground up. Build a layered, well-modeled foundation, medallion staging through marts, not only the models that sit on top. Ask every day whether the whole company can trust and reuse it. 

- Make the data flow reliably. Build ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads, orchestration, and retries, so pipelines run on time without anyone watching them. Ship monitored pipelines that hold up in production. 

- Take the transform layer. Own the Dataform model-building and transform layer, taking full responsibility for the transformation layer and freeing up capacity for semantic modeling and business definitions. This unblocks the whole team. 

- Build trust into the data. Make validation, freshness monitoring, alerting, and lineage the default. Diagnose failures at the root cause. leadscorev2 is the outcome this role exists to prevent. 

- Serve the whole company. Feed clean, governed datasets to Metabase, HubSpot, and the ML and AI work the product ML team owns. Push modeled data back into the tools business teams act on, including HubSpot and Customer.io . 

- Own the Platform handshake. Run the day-to-day collaboration with the Platform team on our GCP foundation, a bridge that only gets part-time attention today. 

- Treat the warehouse like a product. Keep documentation, lineage, and discoverability current so departments trust the data assets, and handle sensitive HR and workforce data to GDPR standards. 

What success looks like in your first 3–6 months 

- The warehouse has a real foundation. The first vertical slice, our accounts model, ships with tests and monitoring. 

- You fully own the Dataform transform layer, creating capacity for semantic modeling and business-definition work 

- Pipelines run against a defined freshness SLA, and you catch breaks before stakeholders do. 

- Documentation and lineage cover what you own, and datasets that were stuck now flow to the teams that need them. 

- 

What we're looking for 

You have built warehouse foundations yourself. You designed them rather than maintaining someone else's, with a track record in: 

- Designing layered warehouse architectures (medallion, bronze-silver-gold) and dimensional models (star and snowflake) that teams reuse 

- Advanced SQL as your daily working language 

- Hands-on BigQuery, since our stack is GCP 

- Building a SQL transform layer in Dataform, or strong dbt experience. 

- ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads and real orchestration, scheduling, and dependency management 

- Data quality, testing, freshness monitoring, and lineage built in from the start 

- Python for pipeline code, scripting, automation, and API integration 

- Reviewable, repeatable change through Git and PR-based deployment 

Nice to have, not required: another modern cloud warehouse such as Snowflake or Redshift; managed ingestion such as Airbyte; preparing data for ML, LLM, and agentic use cases; and familiarity with B2B SaaS metrics and HR or workforce data. English is our working language, and Dutch is not required. 

This role isn't infrastructure engineering, ML or MLOps, or dashboard analysis. The Platform team owns infrastructure, the Product ML team owns ML, and the business teams own dashboards. It also isn't for someone who has only maintained a warehouse another person designed. You build the foundation properly, stay transparent about data quality and trade-offs, and treat the warehouse as a product for the whole company. You'll report to the Head of Operations and partner closely with the Platform team on the company's data architecture.

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
About Shiftbase 

We build workforce software that helps people get work done. More than 10,000 companies use our platform every month to plan shifts and track time, with less admin in the way. 

We work from our Zoetermeer office with over 80 people and we grow every year. The culture is open and informal. You can push back on an idea regardless of title, and we change how we work when someone makes the case in retro. 

About the role 

You build frontend features that customers use the day you release them. You sit in a product team with backend, QA, design and product, and you take a feature from a rough product idea to a screen a planner can use without a manual. 

Your time is a balance between working on features, bugs and resolving technical debt. 

Claude Code is how our engineers write software. Everyone here uses it daily, and whole features now go out with an agent doing most of the coding. You still own what you merge, so you read the diff, you know why it works, and you can defend it in review. The interesting part of the job is deciding what to hand to an agent, what to write yourself, and what context the agent needs to get it right the first time. 

You ask what a planner is trying to do before you read what the ticket says. You automate the parts of your own process that don't need a human. 

Year one, in order 

First, ship. Deliver features in scheduling and time tracking. Start small, then take one full feature from the product conversation through to release. 

Then, own an area. Pick up a product surface end to end and become the person the team asks about it, including what it should do next. That covers how AI fits your area, which patterns you document for the agent and which calls you keep for yourself. 

Along the way, make what you build safe to change. Restructure and test the paths you build on while you build on them. Extend test coverage where it's lacking. We move fast and keep quality up by automating what a human doesn't need to do, including the checks that catch what an agent got wrong. 

What you'll do 

- Design and build frontend features starting from rough product ideas 

- Deliver features with Claude Code, from the prompt through to the pull request, and review the output as closely as a colleague's 

- Write the patterns, conventions and project context our agents work from, so generated frontend code lands in the right shape 

- Turn tangled domain rules into screens people can use without a manual 

- Fix bugs in your own features and in code you've never seen 

- Improve the code you touch while you touch it, so the next feature in that area costs less 

- Write and maintain automated tests in Jest and Playwright 

- Ship in short cycles with your product team 

- Pair, review, and teach what you know 

How we work 

Frontend in Angular, backend in PHP, a web app and a mobile app in React Native. Tests in Jest and Playwright. We develop AI-assisted with Claude Code as the primary tool, and a growing share of our code starts there. Human review and engineers owning what they ship keep it safe. We ship in short cycles in product teams with mixed specialisations. We pair often, with each other and with an agent open. Every quarter you get time to build and ship one of your own ideas, and we run hackathons. 

Must-haves 

3+ years of professional experience with an SPA framework, Angular preferred. Depth in React or Vue works if you can show you'll carry it over. 

You ship. You've delivered features to real users at a steady pace, and you can tell us what you cut to get them out. 

You've shipped production code with an AI agent. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar. Tell us where you let it run, where you took the keyboard back, and what you changed about your own workflow after a month of it. 

You automate your tests. Jest and Playwright, or equivalents, and you have an opinion about what deserves a test. 

You simplify. Hand you a tangled domain problem and you produce a screen that hides the tangle. 

You explain your choices. In review, in a design discussion, and to a product manager who doesn't read code. 

You work as a peer. You pair, you review, and you make the people around you better without needing a title to be heard. 

Nice-to-haves 

- Claude Code in particular, or agent setups you've tuned for a team rather than yourself 

- TypeScript at depth 

- Storybook or component library ownership 

- React 

- TDD 

- PHP, or enough backend to reason about the API you're consuming 

- Familiarity with a complex, regulated domain (ours covers scheduling, time tracking, leave, and labour law across countries) 

This might be your dream job if… 

✅ You want your work in front of customers within days 

✅ You'd rather own a feature end to end than take a finished spec 

✅ You want a say in how a team writes frontend code with agents while the answer is still open 

✅ You improve the code you touch without being asked, and you stop before it turns into a six-week rewrite 

✅ You like a domain that takes months to learn 

This probably isn't your dream job if… 

⛔️ You want the technical approach decided before the ticket reaches you 

⛔️ You want a job where AI stays out of your editor 

⛔️ You'd merge agent output you can't explain in review 

⛔️ You'd stop shipping to finish a refactor 

⛔️ You prefer pixel work and would rather leave tests and architecture to someone else 

⛔️ You'd rather work alone than pair and review 

What we offer 

- A laptop on Mac, Windows, or Linux 

- 32 or 40 hours workweek 

- Hybrid, from home or the Zoetermeer office 

- 25 vacation days based on a 40-hour contract 

- Pension plan 

- NS business card or travel expenses reimbursed. 

- Training budget for personal development 

Please be aware that this is not a remote position and we are not taking applications in consideration outside of the Netherlands for this position.

description:
Dit is Shiftbase

Meer dan 10.000 bedrijven. Ruim 250.000 gebruikers. Eén missie: personeelsplanning en tijdregistratie simpel maken. Ons platform is gebouwd om makkelijk, flexibel en schaalbaar te zijn, of je klant nu 15 of 2500 medewerkers heeft.

Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Zoetermeer en onze hub in Amsterdam werken 85+ collega's aan een product waar bedrijven blij van worden. De sfeer? Open, informeel en hands-on. Hier geen eindeloze vergadercycli. Wel korte lijnen, snelle beslissingen en ruimte om jezelf te zijn.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Account Executive voor de Nederlandse markt ben jij de persoon die kansen omzet in betalende klanten.

Je bedient de B2B-markt over de volle breedte: van horeca tot retail, van zorg tot transport. Bedrijven die vaak nog met Excel of een verouderd systeem werken en waarbij jij in één demo laat zien hoeveel tijd ze terugkrijgen. De use case is herkenbaar, de waarde is snel duidelijk en dat maakt je verkoopcycli lekker kort.

Het grootste deel van je pipeline is warm. Onze marketing levert continu leads aan van bedrijven die actief op zoek zijn, en dat gaat hard. Maar we willen niet afhankelijk zijn van alleen wat er binnenkomt. Je krijgt de ruimte, en de verwachting, om zelf ook kansen te creëren in accounts die je interessant vindt. Hoe we dat als team het beste aanpakken, bepalen we samen. Jouw ervaring in de praktijk weegt daarin mee.

Het volledige sales process is van jou, van discovery en demo tot onderhandeling en close. Na de close draag je het account over aan ons Customer Success-team. Jij focust volledig op new business. Je werkt met tempo en volume, en je weet wanneer een deal aandacht verdient en wanneer je hem moet laten gaan.

Je dag bestaat voor een groot deel uit bellen en demo's, want dit is een hands-on salesrol. Sporadisch ga je op pad naar een klant voor een persoonlijk gesprek.

Je bouwt mee aan een groeiend salesteam binnen een snelgroeiende organisatie, en dat vraagt energie, initiatief en doorzettingsvermogen. Je deelt wat voor jou werkt met het team, want we worden hier beter van elkaar.

Wie ben jij?

Een salesprofessional met een paar jaar ervaring die energie krijgt van tempo, van veel gesprekken en van scoren. Je hebt bewezen dat je kunt presteren in een snelle SaaS-salesomgeving en je wilt nu een volgende stap zetten in een team dat hard aan het opbouwen is. Je wacht niet tot de telefoon gaat: als je een account in gedachten hebt, vind je zelf een weg naar binnen.

Verder herkennen we je aan het volgende: je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring in high-velocity software sales (SaaS), je bent commercieel scherp zonder je klant uit het oog te verliezen, je bent leergierig en staat open voor coaching, en je beheerst Nederlands uitstekend. Engels is een pre.

Profielen die ons aanspreken: je komt uit de SaaS-wereld en hebt ervaring met snelle funnels en hoge volumes. Denk aan omgevingen zoals Lightspeed, Zenchef of vergelijkbare SME-gerichte hospitality- of retailtech.

Of je hebt een leidinggevende achtergrond in de horeca, bent tech-savvy en hebt slimme techoplossingen geïmplementeerd in die rol, en je wilt nu de overstap maken naar software sales aan onder andere de horeca. In beide gevallen: je snapt de wereld van onze klanten als geen ander.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Een rol waarin je een SaaS-oplossing verkoopt die bedrijven écht vooruit helpt, in een omgeving waar resultaat en plezier hand in hand gaan.

Groei is hier geen loze belofte. We investeren serieus in je ontwikkeling vanaf dag één. Je start met een gedegen 30-60-90-dagen-onboardingprogramma met duidelijke milestones, zodat je precies weet waar je staat en waar je naartoe werkt. Je wordt daarnaast getraind en gecertificeerd via Winning by Design, hét toonaangevende salestrainingsprogramma voor SaaS, inclusief SPICED-certificering. Daarbovenop krijg je een persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget van €1.000 per jaar om te investeren in wat jou verder brengt: cursussen, conferenties, boeken of coaching. Jij kiest.

Verder bieden we een brutojaarsalaris van €55.000 tot €75.000 inclusief vakantiegeld op basis van 40 uur per week, afhankelijk van je ervaring. Daarnaast 25 vakantiedagen, een flexibele regeling voor thuis en op kantoor werken, een goede pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding (NS Business Card of kilometervergoeding).

De werksfeer? Ontspannen, met gratis lunch, bootcamp op donderdag, vrijdagmiddagborrels en kwartaal-BBQ's.

Hoe werken we samen?

De eerste 3 maanden verwachten we een hogere aanwezigheid op kantoor in Zoetermeer. Logisch: je wilt het team, het product en de klant snel doorgronden, en dat gaat nu eenmaal sneller als je er bent. Na je onboarding werken we meer hybride.

Woon je op maximaal anderhalf uur reisafstand? Dan verwachten we je minimaal één keer per week op kantoor, op dinsdag of donderdag. In de praktijk gaan we hier flexibel mee om zodra het vertrouwen er is. Woon je dichterbij of heb je geen probleem met wat meer reistijd? Elke dag op kantoor is natuurlijk ook gewoon mogelijk. Daarnaast is er de hub in Amsterdam waar je terecht kunt.

Waarom Shiftbase?

Je verkoopt geen vaag platform dat niemand begrijpt. Shiftbase is marktleider in Nederland en groeit hard in Duitsland. Een product dat 10.000+ bedrijven dagelijks gebruiken omdat het hun werk simpelweg makkelijker maakt. Dat merk je in elk salesgesprek: klanten snappen de waarde, de use case is herkenbaar en de feedback is positief.

Tegelijkertijd zijn we geen logge olietanker. Met 85+ collega's ben je geen nummer, want wat jij doet heeft directe impact op de koers van het bedrijf. Maar we zijn wél groot en stabiel genoeg om je een serieuze carrière te bieden. Geen start-up-roulette, maar een bewezen business met internationale groeiambities waar jij onderdeel van wordt.

title: Freelancer UX/UI Designer (Design Engineer)
description:
UX/UI Designer (Design Engineer) 

Location: Amsterdam, NL (beautiful office right near Leidseplein) 

Work Structure: Hybrid (4 days on-site, 1 day flexible remote) 

Experience Level: 2–4 years 

Type: Freelancer 

About Creative Clicks 

At Creative Clicks, we move fast, think big, and drive results. As a global leader in data-driven performance marketing, we combine high-impact user experiences with sharp creative to scale brands across continents. 

Our culture is built on our Triple E philosophy: Energy, Entrepreneurship, and Expertise . We operate with a vibrant, agile startup mentality and no corporate red tape. If you have an idea, you test it. If you see a friction point in a user journey, you fix it. We are expanding our Amsterdam headquarters and looking for a designer who ships: a UX/UI Designer who takes their own work from Figma all the way to a live Next.js production site. 

The Role 

This is not a classic handoff role. You design the experience and you publish it. Your Figma file becomes a live page because you built it, in Next.js, often the same week. 

Day to day you will design and ship high-converting landing pages, onboarding quiz funnels, and lifecycle emails; manage the websites they live on; and keep improving them with CRO experiments. AI-assisted building ("vibe coding" with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or v0) is core to how this role works, not a side experiment. You will touch several verticals and own things end to end: design, build, CMS, tracking, iteration. 

What You’ll Do 

- Design and publish, yourself: Map user journeys, wireframe, design high-fidelity screens in Figma, then build and deploy them in Next.js. No waiting on a dev sprint. 

- Own the website stack: Manage our sites end to end. Set up and maintain a headless CMS so the team can edit content without touching code, and keep deployments, domains, and tracking healthy. 

- Run optimisations and CRO: Analyze user behavior and funnel data, form hypotheses, ship A/B tests, and iterate based on real performance metrics. 

- Work across verticals: Landing pages are the core, but you will also design and build onboarding quiz flows and email campaigns, so the same brain covers the whole funnel. 

- Frontrun with AI: Actively use AI design and coding tools to collapse the distance between idea and live page. Prototype in hours, ship in days. 

Who You Are 

- The sweet-spot experienced: 2–4 years as a UX/UI, product, or web designer, with shipped web work to show for it (conversion-driven e-commerce or startup experience is a major plus). 

- Master of Figma: Clean component-based design systems, auto-layout, interactive prototypes. 

- You publish, not just hand off: Comfortable enough with Next.js, React, and Tailwind (with AI tools doing the heavy lifting) to take your own design live in production. You don’t need to be a senior engineer. You need to ship. 

- Infrastructure doesn’t scare you: Hosting and deployments (e.g. Vercel), domains and DNS, analytics and tracking scripts, and headless CMS setup (Sanity, Contentful, Payload, or similar) are things you can figure out and own. 

- Data-informed and AI-native: You design what works, not just what looks good. You read funnel data, session recordings, and test results, and you turn them into the next iteration. 

- Thrives in a dynamic culture: Rapid A/B testing, quick iterations, shifting priorities based on performace data. You enjoy that. 

- Portfolio driven: Live URLs beat static mocks. We want to see things you designed AND built. 

To Apply 

Send us your CV and a portfolio with live links: pages you designed and shipped yourself. Tell us briefly what you built, what you would improve, and which tools you used to get it live.

title: Product Owner Core Systems
description:

We ontwerpen fietsen en e-bikes die passen bij het moderne stadsleven: functioneel, doordacht en met veel aandacht voor design, detail en gebruik. Het product staat centraal, maar het merk gaat verder dan mobiliteit alleen. Veloretti beweegt zich op het snijvlak van design, lifestyle en stedelijke cultuur.

Als Product Owner Core Systems ben je verantwoordelijk voor de belangrijkste business- en operations-applicaties zoals het ERP-systeem en het Dealer Portal. Je combineert in deze functie de strategische doorontwikkeling met het dagelijkse management van de applicaties. Wat je doet 

- Beheer en prioriteer de backlog: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de backlog van het ERP-systeem, het Dealer Portal en aangrenzende integraties en applicaties. Je vindt daarbij de balans tussen business value, technische haalbaarheid, effort en toekomstvastheid.

title: Senior Voice Routing Specialist
description:
The Challenge 

We connect over 500’000 callers in 190 countries: that represents 36,000 calling corridors and over 100 million calling minutes. We work with various global suppliers optimising for call quality. It’s complex. Each calling corridor has its own quality quirks and legal and regulatory rules to work within. We want someone to own call quality and routing holistically across all of it: routing daily to optimize what's happening right now, while watching the data for the long-term trends that tell us where to fix things next.

A failed call is not a metric to us. It's someone not hearing their mother's voice or its an important business call that fails. We also have real ambitions to scale calling well beyond where we are today, so this complexity isn't going anywhere. It's only going to grow.

Talk360 has been profitable since 2025, expanding beyond our core calling app into embedded, B2B2C calling for partners. We are lean, around 30 people globally, spread across the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine, and beyond. That means this role has real scope from day one: no layers between you and the decisions that matter, and no shortage of things worth tackling.

This is a remote opportunity.

What You'll Do 

- Own call quality holistically : hold the full picture of call quality end to end, working with the team on both the daily grind and the long-term view, moving fluidly between quick fixes and structured experiments.

- Manage zones, codes, and origins : own and continuously refine our zone, dialing code, and call origin management, keeping the underlying structure clean and accurate across all 900 zones.

- Update routing continuously : change routing several times a day, from immediate fixes to longer-running tests of new suppliers.

- Work cross-functionally by design : partner daily with Ozcan, who owns supplier account management and deal creation, and Mahmoud, who runs hourly monitoring and support-team escalations to suppliers. Work with Ewan on automating the processes behind routing, and with Product and CRM to improve the experience for our end users.

- Move routing toward automation : work toward (semi) automated routing and pricing, reducing how much of this still runs on manual, single-person work.

What You'll Bring 

- Hands-on experience with international A-Z calling and telco routing: zones, codes, LCR, and SIP response codes, built at a telco, carrier, or comms platform with real cross-border calling experience.

- NOC or technical support background: comfortable troubleshooting live voice traffic and reading call detail records and quality metrics like ASR and ACD.

- Exposure to a routing/testing platform such as iTest or an equivalent tool. Familiarity with Digitalk Cloud Carrier (DCC), our current routing platform, is a plus.

- Nice to have: working technical literacy in SIP signalling and SBC concepts

Who You Are 

- Process driven and meticulous: you build the audit trail as you go, not after something goes wrong. You are methodical and analytical by nature, and you would rather have a clean, repeatable process than a clever one-off fix.

- Hands-on: you do the routing work yourself, day to day, not just direct others to do it.

- A strong communicator: equally at ease explaining a routing issue to Product or Marketing as debating a fix with a supplier's NOC team.

- Ownership without a script: you see a bottleneck and you fix it rather than wait to be asked.

- Genuinely commercial: you understand a dropped call or a bad route costs Talk360 real money and a real user's trust, not just an SLA breach.

Recruitment Process 

- Recruiter screening

- Hiring manager screening with COO

- Technical interview

- Case study

What you get 

Learning and growth 

- €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving. 

Time to recharge 

- 25 vacation days 

- Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs 

- Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we'll tell you more during the interview) 

Work from anywhere 

- As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas. 

A team you'll actually want to be part of 

- Weekly team lunch every Thursday 

- Regular team moments and outings 

- An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond 

Set up for success 

- Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work 

- Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance 

An environment to grow and make impact 

- A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission 

About Talk360 

Talk360 was founded with a clear purpose: to become the most accessible and reliable calling app for African diaspora communities, both within Africa and abroad. For our users, calls are not transactional, they are emotional lifelines to family, friends, and essential support networks. When service quality drops, they feel it immediately. That responsibility drives everything we build.

Over the past years, Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide last year. We successfully spun off our payments arm into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by the discontinuation of Skype, and achieved profitable growth from 2025 onwards, marking our transition from early-stage scale-up to a disciplined, sustainable business.

As we continue to grow, we are expanding beyond our own B2C app. We are now launching our first embedded calling products within partner platforms, bringing Talk360’s technology into new ecosystems and enabling partners to offer international calling directly within their own products.

Our ambition is bold: to become the world’s most trusted way to call any real phone number — connecting migrants, travellers, professionals, and businesses across the globe.

Here’s what our users say: 

“I like Talk360 because it saves me a lot of money. I used to call from Zimbabwe for 15 rands a minute. Talk360 came to the rescue. Now I can call my mother for hours.” — Google Play, South Africa ★★★★★ 

“Talk360 is a simple and reliable app for cheap international calls. It works even if the receiver has no internet, offers good call quality, and has transparent pricing.” — Google Play, United States ★★★★★ 

“It is a flawless experience with no hustles at all and the tariffs are more than just fair.” — Trustpilot, United Kingdom ★★★★★

title: Senior Acquisition Marketeer
description:
The Challenge 

Talk360 connects more than 6 million people across 190 countries. How they find us is changing fast: Search is moving from blue links to AI generated answers and paid and organic increasingly shape each other. A missed opportunity here isn't just a lower ROAS number. It's someone staying connected with family abroad, a business trying to reach a supplier, or someone who urgently needs to reach a real phone number.

As our Senior Acquisition Marketeer, you won't own a channel. You'll own the outcome: Figuring out where Talk360's next valuable user is and the smartest way to reach them, across Google, Meta, TikTok, SEO, app stores, AI search, and whatever comes next. Think investment manager for acquisition, not channel specialist.

Talk360 has been profitably growing since 2025. We're a lean team of around 30 people, with the majority of team working from the Amsterdam office. We're looking for someone genuinely channel agnostic: you don't wake up thinking about Google Ads or SEO; you wake up thinking about where the next valuable Talk360 user is.

What you’ll do 

- Own the acquisition portfolio: Continuously evaluate and reallocate investment across paid channels (Google Ads, Apple Search Ads, Meta, TikTok) and organic channels (SEO, ASO, content), based on where the next euro or hour of effort returns the most.

- Run segment-led acquisition: Adapt proposition, creative, keywords, landing pages, and app store presence for our three core segments, Calling Home, Calling for Work, and Calling When It Counts, and learn which segment performs best in which channel, market, and corridor.

- Connect acquisition to LTV: Track performance past the click or install, through registration, first purchase, calling behaviour, and retention, so decisions get made on CAC and LTV together, not platform ROAS alone.

- Build our AI discovery presence: Develop Talk360's approach to discovery as more of our future users start their search inside AI tools instead of Google.

- Run a continuous experimentation pipeline: Turn acquisition hypotheses (a new high-intent search category, a different proposition, an underserved corridor, a new distribution channel) into small, fast tests, and turn the results into investment decisions.

The Team 

You’ll join a lean Commercial team where acquisition, brand, product marketing, CRM, content and data work closely together. No big silos or layers of approval: You’ll work directly with product, data and creative to turn an insight into a live experiment quickly.

What you’ll bring 

- Strong experience running paid acquisition on Google Ads, Meta, and/or Apple Search Ads, with real budget ownership and results to show for it.

- Working knowledge of SEO and ASO, and a track record of building organic acquisition that compounds rather than resetting every quarter.

- Fluency in CAC, ROAS, conversion, ARPU, and LTV, and the ability to build one framework that lets you compare channels that have never been compared before.

- Comfort moving between data, creative, content, and technology to shorten the distance between an idea and a live experiment.

- Active, current use of AI in your own marketing workflow, for research, analysis, content variation, and speeding up execution, not just openness to using it.

Who you are 

- Channel agnostic and opportunity driven, you're motivated by finding the next valuable user, not by defending a particular channel or discipline.

- Comfortable moving investment away from something that isn't working anymore, even if you're the one who built it.

- Genuinely curious about how AI is reshaping search and discovery and energised by figuring out a playbook that doesn't exist yet rather than waiting for one.

- Analytical: You can find the meaningful signal inside a pile of noisy performance data and act on it.

- Understand the limits of attribution and don't let an imperfect model stop you from making a call.

- You’re able to come to our office in Amsterdam on Mondays, Wednesday and Thursdays

Recruitment process 

- First Call: a short call with our recruiter to get to know each other a bit better

- Hiring Manager Interview: a deep dive into your experience with the Chief Revenue Officer

- Case Study: visit of our office where you will present a practical task to our team

- Meeting with the CEO

What you get 

Competitive compensation 

- Senior Acquisition Marketeer salary: €80,000 – €90,000 gross per year (all-in)

Learning and growth 

- €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving.

Time to recharge 

- 25 vacation days

- Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs

- Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we'll tell you more during the interview)

Work from anywhere 

- As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas.

A team you'll actually want to be part of 

- Weekly team lunch every Thursday

- Regular team moments and outings

- An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond

Set up for success 

- Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work

- Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance

An environment to grow and make impact 

- A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission.

About Talk360 

Talk360 was founded with a clear purpose: to become the most accessible and reliable calling app for African diaspora communities, both within Africa and abroad. For our users, calls are not transactional, they are emotional lifelines to family, friends, and essential support networks. When service quality drops, they feel it immediately. That responsibility drives everything we build.

Over the past years, Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide last year. We successfully spun off our payments arm into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by the discontinuation of Skype, and achieved profitable growth from 2025 onwards, marking our transition from early-stage scale-up to a disciplined, sustainable business.

As we continue to grow, we are expanding beyond our own B2C app. We are now launching our first embedded calling products within partner platforms, bringing Talk360’s technology into new ecosystems and enabling partners to offer international calling directly within their own products.

Our ambition is bold: to become the world’s most trusted way to call any real phone number — connecting migrants, travellers, professionals, and businesses across the globe.

Gestalte das perfekte Foodji-Erlebnis 

Ein großartiges Produkt allein reicht nicht – echte Kundenzufriedenheit entsteht durch starke Beziehungen und einen klaren Blick auf die Entwicklung des Kundenportfolios. Du machst den konkreten Nutzen und Mehrwert von Foodji sichtbar und schaffst damit die Grundlage für langfristige Partnerschaften. 

Deine Mission bei Foodji: 

- (Enterprise-) Kund:innen begleitest du von der Testphase über den Vertragsabschluss durch die gesamte Customer Lifetime. 

- Für dein Kundenportfolio übernimmst du Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Kund:innen Foodji erfolgreich nutzen, langfristig bleiben, wachsen und uns weiterempfehlen. 

- Stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu zentralen Entscheider:innen und dezentralen Stakeholdern baust du gezielt auf und entwickelst sie weiter. 

- Verantwortung für die Gesundheit und Weiterentwicklung deines Enterprise-Kundenportfolios – von der KPI-basierten Analyse der Account Health bis zur Ableitung gezielter Maßnahmen. 

- Vertragsverlängerungen bereitest du aktiv vor und erkennst Kündigungsrisiken frühzeitig – auch wenn sie zunächst nur an einem einzelnen Standort auftreten. 

- Steuerung von internen und crossfunktionalen Projekten zur Weiterentwicklung des Customer Success Bereichs. 

DAS BRINGST DU MIT 

- Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success Management sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Retention-, Vertragsverlängerungs- und Churn-Kennzahlen über ein Kundenportfolio hinweg. 

- Strukturierte, datengetriebene und eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit einem guten Gespür für Kundenbeziehungen sowie der Fähigkeit, Risiken, Kundenpotenziale und nächste Schritte selbstständig zu priorisieren. 

- Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, insbesondere Salesforce, sowie sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse. 

- Kommunikationsstärke auf Entscheider:innenebene – auch in anspruchsvollen Gesprächen – sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Multi-Standort-Accounts mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern strategisch zu betreuen. 

- Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. 

- Präsentations- und Argumentationsfähigkeit sowie ausgeprägte Networking-Kompetenzen. 

- Ein „Do-it“-Mindset, Teamfähigkeit, Selbstbewusstsein sowie eine lösungs- und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise. 

NOCH FRAGEN? 

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! 

DAS BIETEN WIR 

- Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office oder Remote 

- Uncapped Bonus: Deine Leistung bestimmt dein Gehalt – nach oben gibt es keine Grenze 

- bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente 

- Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung 

- EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios 

- JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec 

- KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind 

- Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands 

- Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen 

- Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Entwicklungspfade – z. B. vom SDR zum Account Executive 

- Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland 

- Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür 

- Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! 

ÜBER UNS 

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. 

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst. 

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. 

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns. 

Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

title: Founder's Associate
description:
About Comena 
Comena builds AI agents for industrial distributors and manufacturers to automate their order processing from e-mail inbox to ERP. At distributors across the US and Germany alone, there are 4 million sales and procurement people stuck in manual workflows between inbox and ERP. We want to automate this work and liberate these people to work on more meaningful things.

We’re part of the YC S25 batch - the most selective batch in YC history. We recently raised a seed round from top Silicon Valley investors and are serving customers across US and Germany.

About the role 
We’re looking for a Founder's Associate to work directly with the founders on the highest-priority projects in the company. This is an early-career, high-ownership role for someone who wants to start their own company one day and wants a front-row seat to building an AI startup from the inside first.

This role is for generalists who want to learn how a startup actually gets built. Your initial focus will be split roughly equally across three areas: marketing, hiring, and founder projects. This means helping get Comena in front of the right industrial companies, finding and closing great people to join the team, and supporting the founders with sales and other high-priority projects. Over time, you'll take ownership of whatever the company needs most, from special projects to building out entire functions.

What you’ll do 

- Plan and run marketing campaigns across LinkedIn, email, website, trade shows, and events

- Create content: founder posts, customer stories, case studies, newsletters, and landing pages

- Turn customer conversations and product launches into stories that generate pipeline

- Build sales assets: decks, one-pagers, ROI materials, and support live deals

- Own our hiring funnel: source candidates, run outreach, screen, and coordinate interviews

- Build and use AI systems across marketing, sales, recruiting, and internal operations

- Collaborate with designers to create compelling marketing materials

- Test new channels, formats, and messaging - and measure what actually moves pipeline and hires

- Work directly with the founders on whatever matters most that week

What we’re looking for 

- Excellent writing and communication skills in English and German

- High ownership and low ego

- Good judgment, taste, attention to detail, and follow-through

- Comfort operating in ambiguity and moving quickly

- Wanting to work very hard beyond traditional 9-5 hours

- Fluency with AI tools for research, writing, design, and analysis

- Excitement about startups, AI, and industrial businesses

You might be a fit if 

- You want to found your own company one day and want to learn how it's done first

- You want to work directly with founders and learn fast

- You like being trusted with real responsibility early

- You are excited by execution, not just strategy

- You want a role that can grow quickly with your performance

You're probably not a fit if 

- You want to own one narrow channel or function

- You need a detailed brief before you start

- You prefer coming up with ideas over shipping them

- You don't enjoy writing or talking to people

Why join 

- Work directly with the founders every day

- Learn how an AI startup builds its brand, hires its team, and scales

- Get broad exposure, rapid feedback, and increasing responsibility

- Help modernize how industrial companies operate

About the interview

- 15 min intro call with Youssef

- Take-home challenge

- 60 min coworking call with Jiehua

- In-person meeting

- Offer

description:
A definitive shift is currently happening. Corporates across the globe are no longer just reporting on sustainability; they are actively investing in it as a core financial and strategic asset.

At CEEZER, we are architecting the infrastructure for enterprise-grade Climate Performance Asset management, transforming how the world's largest companies source and manage carbon credits, Energy Attribution Certificates (EAC), and Sustainable Aviation Fuel certificates (SAFc).

Our platform gives the world’s most ambitious enterprises the data-driven precision, real-time monitoring, and framework-compliant reporting required to confidently deploy capital toward high-impact Climate Performance Asset portfolios and true, measurable climate action.

We are looking for a Marketing & Communications Lead (f/d/m) . You will lead CEEZER’s marketing and communications end to end, defining our narrative and building an unmistakably enterprise-grade brand. Partnering with leadership, Sales, Business Development, and Product, you’ll amplify our voice among senior decision-makers at multinational enterprises and make CEEZER their definitive choice.

Your mission 

- Set the vision and strategy. Architect CEEZER's global marketing strategy end to end, owning the roadmap that turns our market position into measurable commercial growth. In close partnership with Sales and Business Development, you'll build demand among decision-makers at leading multinationals and directly shape topline results.

- Define the category conversation. Lead high-impact PR and thought leadership that brings clarity to complex, fast-moving markets. You'll establish CEEZER and its leaders as the authoritative voice at the center of global climate action.

- Own the stage. Build a flagship event strategy that puts CEEZER in the rooms, and on the stages, that matter most, with compelling content that inspires and wins over procurement and sustainability leaders.

- Turn sophistication into advantage. Partner with Product and Commercial teams to translate our technology and data capabilities into clear, value-driven narratives that resonate at board level.

- Build a marketing function for the AI era. Design, hire, and lead a lean, high-performing team that uses AI and modern tooling to deliver outsized output and measurable business impact. This is your chance to build a model for what modern enterprise marketing looks like.

- Raise the bar on every touchpoint. Ensure every sales deck, digital channel, and message reflects the polish, precision, and credibility expected by €1B+ revenue organizations.

What you need to succeed 

- 6–7 years of enterprise marketing or brand strategy experience, with a proven track record of translating complexity into clarity for enterprise buyers.

- Deep experience across Content, PR, Events, and Product Marketing, with a direct focus on generating pipeline, sourcing MQLs, and improving enterprise conversion rates.

- Demonstrated success driving top-of-funnel lead generation and boosting conversion rates by creating targeted content that resonates with ESG, procurement, and executive stakeholders at multinational companies.

- Experience managing and empowering marketing talent to produce high-quality, high-impact work with a small, efficient headcount.

- German fluency (spoken and written) is a strong plus.

- Hands-on experience with Salesforce and Pardot to build, execute, and measure marketing campaigns is also a bonus.

The hiring process 

- An intro call with the People Team

- A call with our CEO, Magnus

- A call with our CRO, Juliane Sterzl

- A panel interview with senior stakeholders

What's in it for you at CEEZER? 

- A mission that matters: Work alongside international teams combining finance, tech, and climate science professionals to direct capital toward the world's most critical climate assets.

- Accelerated growth: We are scaling fast, and your career will too. Take opportunities to lead cross-functional initiatives and expand your strategic influence.

- True ownership: We are building in a brand-new market, meaning many of our best practices don’t exist yet. If you see a better workflow, tool, or strategy, you have the autonomy and backing to build it.

- An empowering environment: We bring together diverse global perspectives, knowing that solving complex climate challenges requires a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise.

- Real enterprise impact: Transform how global corporates approach sustainability. CEEZER hosts 50Mt+ of vetted carbon credits across all pathways, all backed by sophisticated data and institutional-grade risk management.

- A net-zero career: We practice what we preach. From your first day, we fully offset your personal and professional carbon footprint because sustainability is how we operate.
