title: Website Growth & CRO Manager
description:
Berlin, Deutschland · Vollzeit 

Wichtig: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C1 oder C2) ist für diese Position zwingend erforderlich , da die Optimierung von Website-Texten ein zentraler Teil der Aufgabe ist. Bewerbungen mit einem niedrigeren Deutschniveau können leider nicht berücksichtigt werden.

Die Rolle 

Wir suchen einen analytisch starken, umsetzungsorientierten und unternehmerisch denkenden Website Growth & CRO Manager (m/w/d), der die Verantwortung für unsere Websites übernimmt und sie zu leistungsstarken digitalen Vertriebskanälen weiterentwickelt.

In dieser Rolle treibst du Verbesserungen auf unseren Websites, Landingpages und Conversion-Funnels voran. Dabei verbindest du datengetriebenes Experimentieren mit einem guten Gespür für UX/UI, überzeugenden Texten und einem tiefen Verständnis für das Verhalten unserer Kund:innen.

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Conversion-Rates, erkennst Wachstumspotenziale und setzt Erkenntnisse in konkrete Verbesserungen um. Außerdem wirkst du an der Entwicklung eines neuen Produktkonfigurators mit und gestaltest intuitive digitale Erlebnisse, die es unseren Kund:innen leichter machen, unsere Produkte zu entdecken, zu individualisieren und zu kaufen.

Wir suchen jemanden, der analytisch denkt, schnell handelt und Freude daran hat, Ideen von der Erkenntnis bis zur Umsetzung zu bringen. Auch Berufseinsteiger:innen mit außergewöhnlichen analytischen Fähigkeiten, viel Eigeninitiative und großem Potenzial sind herzlich eingeladen, sich zu bewerben.

Deine Aufgaben 

- Website-Verantwortung: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für bestehende Websites, Landingpages und Conversion-Funnels und erkennst kontinuierlich Möglichkeiten, die Performance und die Customer Journey zu verbessern.

- Conversion-Rate-Optimierung (CRO): Du konzipierst und setzt A/B-Tests für ganze Seiten und einzelne Bereiche um, um die Conversion-Rates zu steigern und messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

- UX/UI & Web-Erlebnis: Gemeinsam mit Designer:innen und mithilfe von KI-Tools gestaltest du intuitive, visuell ansprechende und konversionsstarke Web-Erlebnisse.

- Copywriting & Messaging: Du entwickelst überzeugende Headlines, Alleinstellungsmerkmale (USPs), Calls-to-Action (CTAs) und Website-Texte auf Deutsch, die unser Wertversprechen klar vermitteln und zum Handeln motivieren.

- Growth-Experimente & User Research: Du übersetzt Daten und Kundeneinblicke in konkrete Verbesserungen. Eigenständig führst du Kundenbefragungen und User Research durch, um Reibungspunkte und Wachstumschancen zu identifizieren.

- Produktentwicklung: Du wirkst am Aufbau eines neuen Produktkonfigurators mit und gestaltest das digitale Erlebnis rund um unsere Produkte.

- Bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit: Du treibst Umsetzung und Verbesserungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams Performance Marketing, Content, Design und Tech voran.

- KI-gestützte Umsetzung: Du setzt KI-Tools proaktiv ein, um Abläufe zu beschleunigen, Lösungen zu entwickeln sowie Qualität und Tempo der Umsetzung zu steigern.

Dein Profil 

- MUSS: Deutsch auf C1- oder C2-Niveau. Du schreibst und optimierst Website-Texte auf Deutsch als zentralen Teil deiner Arbeit. Profile mit einem niedrigeren Deutschniveau können nicht berücksichtigt werden. 

- Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denken und kaufmännisches Verständnis sowie die Fähigkeit, aus Daten klare Prioritäten und messbare Verbesserungen abzuleiten.

- Erfahrung oder nachweisbares Potenzial in Digital Product Management, Growth, Conversion-Rate-Optimierung (CRO), Growth Design oder E-Commerce.

- Sehr gutes Verständnis von UX/UI-Prinzipien und ein ausgeprägtes ästhetisches Gespür für intuitive, ansprechende digitale Erlebnisse.

- Talent für klare, überzeugende Website-Texte und kommerzielle Botschaften, einschließlich Headlines, USPs und CTAs.

- Unternehmerisches Denken, ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein sowie die Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen, Initiative zu ergreifen und Ideen bis zur Umsetzung voranzutreiben.

- Sicherer Umgang mit KI-Tools als fester Bestandteil deines Arbeitsalltags, um Produktivität und Problemlösung zu verbessern.

- Starke Problemlösungskompetenz, Neugier und die Bereitschaft, zu experimentieren, zu lernen und dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Berufserfahrung: Wir freuen uns über Kandidat:innen mit etwa 3–5 Jahren relevanter Berufserfahrung. Außergewöhnliche Berufseinsteiger:innen mit 1–2 Jahren Erfahrung, einem starken analytischen Mindset, viel Eigeninitiative und herausragendem Potenzial sind ebenfalls herzlich eingeladen, sich zu bewerben.

Warum wir? 

- Ein internationales und unternehmerisches Umfeld: Du arbeitest mit Kolleg:innen in Berlin, Breslau und Helsingborg zusammen.

- Echte Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Du hast direkten Einfluss auf das digitale Kundenerlebnis, die Conversion-Rates und das Unternehmenswachstum.

- Eine Kultur des Vertrauens und der Entwicklung: Du ergreifst Initiative, gestaltest Ideen und wächst gemeinsam mit einem kollegialen, ambitionierten Team.

- Ambitioniertes Wachstum auf starkem Fundament: Du wirst Teil eines etablierten, gründergeführten Unternehmens, das auf langfristiges Wachstum, Qualität und den Aufbau einer skalierbaren Organisation setzt.

- Ein besonderes Produkt in einer besonderen Branche: Du gestaltest die Zukunft der Beschilderung mit, indem du physische Produkte, Technologie und digitale Kundenerlebnisse verbindest.

Standort & Arbeitsmodell 

- Standort: Berlin, Deutschland

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer I
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good. 

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

As a Senior Mechanical Engineer , you take technical ownership of mechanical systems and assemblies — from early concept and architecture through prototyping, qualification, and production. You combine hands-on mechanical engineering , strong problem-solving skills , and technical leadership , actively shaping both our products and the way we engineer them.

What You’ll Do

Work Location: This role is based out of our Kassel office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

- Own mechanical system and subsystem development across the full product lifecycle.

- Design durable mechanical solutions for fixed, portable, and mobile cUAS systems .

- Develop housings, structures, and mounting concepts with focus on thermal performance, weight, stiffness, and environmental robustness .

- Apply structural and thermal simulation (e.g. FEA, thermal analysis) to guide design decisions and validate concepts.

- Take a strong hands-on role in prototyping, testing, and iterative design improvements.

- Solve real-world hardware problems by identifying root causes and implementing practical, robust solutions.

- Work closely with electrical, RF, and systems engineers on mechanical-electrical integration .

- Collaborate with manufacturing partners on DFM/DFA , material selection, surface treatments, and production processes.

- Support qualification activities including temperature, shock, vibration, and environmental testing .

- Participate in design reviews , contribute to engineering guidelines, and continuously improve mechanical design standards.

- Act as a technical mentor , sharing knowledge and experience within the engineering team.

What You Bring

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

- Several years of experience in mechanical design and system integration for complex hardware products.

- Strong background in mechanical design for harsh or regulated environments .

- Experience with structural and thermal simulation tools (e.g. SolidWorks Simulation, Ansys, or comparable).

- Proficiency with CAD tools (e.g. SolidWorks or equivalent) and production-ready technical drawings.

- Strong hands-on skills and confidence working with workshop tools and prototypes.

- Practical understanding of manufacturing processes and design for production.

- Proven problem-solving mindset , comfortable debugging real hardware issues.

- Experience supporting knowledge sharing, reviews, or mentoring within an engineering team.

- Clear communicator who enjoys ownership, collaboration, and technical depth.

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Agentic AI Principal (m/f/d)
description:
We are looking for an Agentic AI Principal to act as a senior technical authority and trusted client advisor for complex agentic AI transformation in Germany, the Netherlands and the wider DACH region.

Operating at Principal level, you will shape enterprise AI strategy, define agentic architecture blueprints, lead high-value C-suite engagements and guide complex programmes from opportunity through delivery. You will bring deep hands-on credibility in multi-agent systems, governance and safeguards, while setting reusable patterns and raising capability across teams.

The role has particular focus on sovereign, compliant and production-grade agentic AI for regulated German, Dutch and European enterprises, with a primary focus on healthcare and life sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech and healthcare providers). Experience from other regulated sectors, such as financial services and insurance, automotive and manufacturing, energy and telecommunications, is equally welcome.

Our delivery model is moving from large time-and-materials teams to small, AI-first, multidisciplinary pods accountable to a business outcome. You will anchor the agentic side of that work, pairing with our data, tech advisory and industry domain leads from presale through delivery.

This is a client-facing, builder's leadership role. You will start with a small, senior team and grow it through technical depth, delivery excellence and thought leadership, rather than inheriting a large organisation.

Job responsibilities

Shaping and winning 

- Agentic AI advisory and strategy: shape and solution complex German, Dutch and DACH pursuits with account, commercial and delivery leaders, translating client needs into differentiated propositions, credible architectures and executable delivery approaches that support regional pipeline conversion.

- Independently drive complex pursuits with technical and executive stakeholders, including shaping the commercial model (fixed-price, outcome-linked), trade-offs and risk.

- Act as a sparring partner to C-suite buyers (CEO, CIO, CDO, CISO, COO): frame business-outcome hypotheses, challenge assumptions and define a thin slice of agentic delivery that proves value quickly.

- Lead AI maturity assessments, identify and prioritise processes for agentisation, and connect architecture choices to measurable business value and ROI.

- Represent Thoughtworks' agentic AI expertise in strategic client conversations, industry forums, partnerships and thought leadership where appropriate.

Designing and building 

- Design and build engineering: set the architecture direction for complex, production-grade agentic AI systems, including multi-agent workflows, orchestration, tool use, memory, context strategy, retrieval, evaluation, observability and enterprise integration.

- Integrate agents with the German enterprise core: SAP (S/4HANA, BTP), LIMS, QMS and clinical systems, MES/PLM and industrial systems, and legacy back-office platforms, using open protocols such as MCP and A2A where they fit.

- Ensure agents run on trustworthy data foundations, working with data engineering and data product teams on data quality, semantics and access.

- Design solutions for regulated German and EU environments, with strong consideration of data sovereignty (EU and German sovereign cloud, open-weight or self-hosted models where required), privacy, security, responsible AI and applicable regulation, including the EU AI Act and GDPR; for healthcare and life sciences GxP, EU MDR/IVDR and the European Health Data Space; and for other sectors DORA, NIS2 and BaFin requirements where relevant.

- Guide teams in balancing rapid experimentation with robust production engineering, including evaluation-driven development, testing, CI/CD, reliability, cost and performance optimisation.

- Provide technical and delivery leadership for complex programmes, staying hands-on enough to validate architecture, unblock teams, manage technical risk and ensure successful execution.

- Partner with product, data, software engineering, enterprise architecture, governance and change specialists to design end-to-end solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

Governance and safeguards 

- Establish reusable patterns for observability, auditability, traceability and control of agentic systems, enabling teams to demonstrate safe and reliable behaviour in production.

- Translate EU AI Act obligations (risk classification, human oversight, logging, technical documentation, GPAI-provider responsibilities) into concrete engineering controls and evidence.

- Engage early with works councils (Betriebsrat, ondernemingsraad), data protection officers and information security, supporting DPIAs and co-determination processes so agentic solutions that touch employee workflows can go live.

- Anticipate technical, organisational and governance challenges in enterprise AI adoption and define practical approaches to address them.

Principal-level leadership and growing capability 

- Set reusable architecture patterns, engineering standards and governance practices across multiple teams and engagements, influencing the evolution of Thoughtworks' agentic AI capability beyond an individual programme.

- Set technical direction across multiple teams and initiatives, defining reusable patterns, frameworks and engineering standards for agentic AI delivery.

- Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, build the next generation of the German team, and raise AI fluency and agentic engineering standards across specialists and generalists.

- Evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies and frameworks and guide their responsible adoption based on client context, engineering quality and business value.

- Build our German and Dutch market presence through local-language points of view, ecosystem and partner initiatives (hyperscalers, SAP, European model providers) and community events.

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

- Deep expertise in modern software engineering and Python, with a strong track record of setting standards for testing, CI/CD, observability, maintainability and production reliability.

- Recognised experience architecting and delivering complex GenAI and agentic AI systems at enterprise scale, from early discovery through production deployment.

- Deep knowledge of agentic architectures and frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex or equivalent, including tool use, orchestration, memory, multi-agent coordination and interoperability protocols (MCP, A2A).

- Strong expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation, advanced information retrieval, vector databases and enterprise knowledge integration.

- Experience designing evaluation strategies for GenAI and agentic systems, including quality, safety, reliability, latency and cost measures.

- Strong understanding of AI governance and safeguards, including guardrails, red-teaming, observability, responsible AI and secure deployment practices (prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse).

- Significant experience deploying AI systems on major cloud platforms using containers, orchestration and production-grade infrastructure patterns, including EU sovereign cloud, hybrid or on-premises setups and self-hosted open-weight models.

- Experience with model adaptation and optimisation techniques, including prompt/context engineering, fine-tuning where appropriate, and application-level performance optimisation.

- Ability to make sound architecture trade-offs across model capability, reliability, security, compliance, performance and cost.

- Working knowledge of the EU AI Act, GDPR and sector rules (for healthcare and life sciences: GxP and GAMP 5 computerised-system validation, EU MDR/IVDR, EHDS; for other sectors: DORA, NIS2, BaFin) and how they shape agentic system design.

- Strongly preferred: delivering AI in healthcare or life sciences (e.g. R&D, clinical, regulatory, manufacturing quality, commercial).

- Nice to have: integrating agents with SAP and industrial or manufacturing systems; data product and data platform foundations for AI.

Consulting and Commercial Track Record

- Proven ability to lead C-suite and senior client engagements, rapidly establish credibility and advise on both business and technical choices.

- Strong consulting and commercial judgement: you can point to data and AI (ideally agentic or GenAI) pursuits you helped shape, sell and deliver in the last three to five years, from around €3M–5M upwards, including fixed-price or outcome-linked elements.

- Experience shaping, solutioning, selling and delivering complex deals of €5M+ in the last few years. Annual target of solutioning, selling and delivering €10M+ TCV in Data & AI deals with an AI-first delivery focus.

- Comfortable discussing P&L, business cases and ROI with executive buyers, not just architecture.

- Consultancy or professional-services experience within the last five years, ideally with German, Dutch or DACH enterprise clients.

- You have grown a practice, capability or go-to-market asset (e.g. a reusable accelerator).

Professional Skills

- Executive presence and communication skills, making complex agentic AI concepts, risks and trade-offs clear to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Proven leadership of complex delivery across multidisciplinary teams, moving fluidly between strategy, architecture, governance and hands-on technical leadership.

- Ability to influence across organisations without formal authority, align diverse stakeholders and navigate ambiguity in high-value or high-risk programmes.

- Proven ability to mentor senior engineers and technical leaders and raise standards across a wider engineering community.

- Self-directed, prioritisation-led working style, with creative problem-solving in fixed-scope, outcome-driven work.

- Experience navigating German stakeholder structures, including works councils, data protection officers and procurement.

- German B2 minimum , C1 strongly preferred; fluent English. 

Other things to know

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

title: Solutions Manager- (German Fluency)
description:
About Zip 

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role 

We’re looking a Solutions Manager with Finance / Procurement System experience (SAP) to lead onboarding for new customers and drive their implementation of our product. We’re also looking for someone who is excited to be hands on and influence our product roadmap.

As every business needs our type of product, you’ll work with a variety of new clients and industries as Zip scales. Current clients include Coinbase, Snowflake, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Databricks.

You Will 

- Lead project teams onboarding new customers, with a heavy emphasis on project / stakeholder management and understanding client requirements

- Responsible for leading the end-to-end implementation for new customers -- roll up your sleeves and build out the customer’s processes from scratch

- Proactive project management across many customers, to manage requirements and tasks across onboardings

- Lead, mentor and train training and Q&A sessions with customers and key stakeholders to empower them to utilize the product without additional ongoing help from Zip

- Collaborate closely with the product and engineering teams to determine which customer requests we should and shouldn’t support, and set expectations with customers

- Do whatever it takes to make customers happy + successfully onboard them as quickly as possible

- Continuously improve the post-sales processes to help our customers accelerate the time to value

Qualifications 

- 8-10 years of experience implementing or administering a finance / procurement tool

- Prior experience with the implementation or administration of a procurement tool / ERP (SAP S/4HANA: procurement and AP, SAP Ariba Buying / Invoicing)

- Hands-on-Mentalität 

- Wohnort bevorzugt in einer großen Stadt

- Kundenorientierte, kooperative Arbeitsweise und Überzeugungskraft in Verhandlungen

- Gestalte Deine Arbeitszeit flexibel und ortsunabhängig – (bis zu) 100% remote. Dank großzügiger Gleitzeit zwischen 6-22 Uhr passt sich Dein Job deinem Alltag an. 

- Arbeite autonom und selbstbestimmt. Wir leben größtmögliche Transparenz, Vertrauen und Offenheit. 

- Immer mobil und schnell dort, wo du gebraucht wirst mit dem Firmen-PKW. 

- Entdecke neue Orte und verbinde Arbeit und Urlaub. Workation ist bei uns bis zu 30 Tage pro Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland möglich. 

- Sorge vor für’s Alter mit unserem Angebot zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge. 

- Arbeite an einer nachhaltigen Zukunft: Gemeinsam gestalten wir eine digitale Infrastruktur, die Menschen entlastet und Ressourcen schont.

Seit der Gründung im Jahr 2018 revolutioniert der Last-Mile-Spezialist die urbane Logistik mit intelligent-flexiblen Lösungen. Das größte anbieteroffene Paketstationen-Netzwerk in Deutschland und Österreich besteht aus über 2.200 Paketstationen in mehr als 800 Städten und Gemeinden und wächst ständig weiter. title: Videograph/in – Social Media & Content - Vollzeit (m/w/d)
description:
Hamburg-Altona · Vollzeit · vor Ort · 4.000–4.300 € brutto/Monat 

Du hast ein gutes Gespür für starke Bilder, kannst Ideen schnell in hochwertigen Content übersetzen und arbeitest gleichzeitig gerne mit klaren Briefings und festen Abläufen?

Als Videograph/in bei ESH produzierst du Foto- und Videocontent für unsere Social-Media-Kanäle, Werbeanzeigen, YouTube und unsere Website.

Du begleitest Produktionen von der Vorbereitung über den Dreh bis zur finalen Umsetzung und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen zuverlässig veröffentlichungsfertiger Content entsteht.

Dabei bekommst du klare Ziele, Briefings und Markenstandards – und gleichzeitig den Freiraum, deine fachliche und kreative Erfahrung in die Umsetzung einzubringen.

Deine Aufgaben

- Du planst und realisierst Video- und Fotoproduktionen für unsere Social-Media-Kanäle.

- Du produzierst Content für Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Werbeanzeigen und unsere Website.

- Du setzt vorgegebene Content-Ideen, Skripte und Briefings visuell um.

- Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Marketing-Team Ideen für neue Formate und Creatives weiter.

- Du führst Drehs selbstständig durch und sorgst für Kamera, Licht und Ton.

- Du sichtest und strukturierst aufgenommenes Material.

- Du schneidest Videos plattformgerecht und bereitest sie für die Veröffentlichung vor.

- Du übernimmst Farbkorrektur, Tonbearbeitung und Qualitätskontrolle.

- Du erstellst Einblendungen, Untertitel, Call-to-Actions und einfache Animationen.

- Du organisierst und archivierst Foto- und Videomaterial nachvollziehbar.

- Du achtest darauf, dass unsere Inhalte unseren Marken- und Qualitätsstandards entsprechen.

- Gelegentlich begleitest du uns auf Veranstaltungen, Messen oder externen Drehs.

So sieht dein Arbeitsalltag aus

Deine Arbeit wechselt zwischen Vorbereitung, Produktion und Postproduktion.

An manchen Tagen setzt du mehrere kurze Social-Media-Videos um, an anderen bereitest du einen größeren Dreh vor oder arbeitest konzentriert an Schnitt und Nachbearbeitung.

Du arbeitest dabei nicht ohne Richtung.

Für unsere Inhalte gibt es klare Ziele, Zielgruppen, Briefings und wiederkehrende Formate. Dadurch weißt du, was mit einem Video erreicht werden soll und welche Anforderungen bei der Umsetzung gelten.

Innerhalb dieses Rahmens bringst du deine Erfahrung und Kreativität ein und entscheidest beispielsweise über Bildaufbau, Licht, Kameraführung oder Schnitt.

Wichtig ist uns, dass Projekte zuverlässig fertig werden und Content nicht nur kreativ aussieht, sondern seinen Zweck erfüllt.

Die Stelle passt besonders gut zu dir, wenn …

- du kreativ bist, aber trotzdem gerne mit klaren Briefings arbeitest,

- du Ideen schnell in konkrete Ergebnisse umsetzen kannst,

- du ein gutes Gespür für Social-Media-Content und aktuelle Sehgewohnheiten hast,

- du gerne mit Menschen arbeitest und Personen vor der Kamera Sicherheit geben kannst,

- du selbstständig arbeiten und gleichzeitig Feedback gut umsetzen kannst,

- du auch bei wiederkehrenden Formaten dauerhaft sorgfältig arbeitest,

- du Deadlines und Absprachen zuverlässig einhältst,

- du Details wahrnimmst, ohne dich endlos darin zu verlieren,

- du Verantwortung dafür übernimmst, dass deine Projekte fertig und veröffentlichungsbereit sind,

- du gerne Teil eines festen Teams bist und langfristig Verantwortung für unseren visuellen Content übernehmen möchtest.

Das solltest du mitbringen

- Erfahrung in Videoproduktion, Fotografie oder Content-Produktion

- sehr gutes technisches Verständnis für Kamera, Licht und Ton

- Erfahrung im Videoschnitt und in der Nachbearbeitung

- gutes Gespür für Bildsprache, Storytelling und Social-Media-Content

- Verständnis dafür, wie Inhalte je nach Plattform unterschiedlich aufbereitet werden

- selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

- hohe Zuverlässigkeit und Disziplin

- schnelle Auffassungsgabe

- Fähigkeit, klare Briefings und bestehende Prozesse zuverlässig umzusetzen

- Offenheit für Feedback und schnelle Umsetzung von Änderungen

- sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse

Eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Bereich Mediengestaltung, Film, Fotografie oder vergleichbar ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Auch als Autodidakt/in oder mit Erfahrung aus selbstständiger Tätigkeit oder Agenturumfeld kannst du sehr gut zu uns passen.

Wichtiger als dein Abschluss ist die Qualität deiner bisherigen Arbeit.

Bitte bewirb dich über den Button auf dieser Seite und füge ein Portfolio oder Beispiele deiner bisherigen Videoarbeiten bei. 

Deine Einarbeitung bei ESH

Zu Beginn lernst du unsere Marke, Zielgruppen, Content-Formate und bestehenden Abläufe kennen.

Du bekommst Einblick in unsere Social-Media-Kanäle, Werbeanzeigen, bisherigen Produktionen und visuellen Standards.

Anschließend übernimmst du Schritt für Schritt eigene Produktionen und Formate.

Unsere internen Prozesse, Briefings und festen Ansprechpartner helfen dir dabei, schnell zu verstehen, was wir mit unseren Inhalten erreichen möchten.

Unser Ziel ist, dass du Produktionen zunehmend eigenständig planst, umsetzt und bis zur Veröffentlichung verantwortest.

Was gute Content-Produktion für uns bedeutet

Ein Video ist für uns nicht gut, nur weil es schön aussieht.

Guter Content muss Aufmerksamkeit erzeugen, verständlich sein und zur jeweiligen Zielgruppe und Plattform passen.

Deshalb verbinden wir kreative Umsetzung mit klaren Zielen.

Wir testen unterschiedliche Formate und Ideen, werten aus, was funktioniert, und entwickeln erfolgreiche Inhalte weiter.

Dabei erwarten wir keine Perfektion um jeden Preis.

Wichtiger sind eine hohe Qualität, zuverlässige Umsetzung und die Fähigkeit, Content regelmäßig fertigzustellen und zu veröffentlichen.

Das erwartet dich bei ESH

Klare Briefings und Ziele 

Du weißt vor einer Produktion, welches Ziel ein Inhalt verfolgt und für welche Plattform und Zielgruppe er erstellt wird.

Kreativer Gestaltungsspielraum 

Innerhalb unserer Marken- und Contentstandards kannst du deine fachliche Erfahrung und eigene Ideen in die Umsetzung einbringen.

Eigener Verantwortungsbereich 

Du begleitest Produktionen nicht nur in einzelnen Teilschritten, sondern kannst Verantwortung von der Vorbereitung bis zum finalen Ergebnis übernehmen.

Moderne Arbeitsausstattung 

Wir stellen dir die technische Ausstattung zur Verfügung, die du für deine Arbeit benötigst, und arbeiten mit modernen Arbeitsplätzen in Hamburg-Altona.

Direkte Zusammenarbeit 

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Marketing-Team und den Personen zusammen, die für unsere Inhalte vor der Kamera stehen. Entscheidungen und Feedbackwege sind dadurch kurz.

Langfristige Perspektive 

Wir möchten unseren Video- und Social-Media-Content langfristig intern weiter ausbauen und suchen jemanden, der diesen Bereich dauerhaft mit uns betreut und weiterentwickelt.

Attraktive Vergütung 

Je nach Erfahrung und Qualität deiner bisherigen Arbeit liegt dein Gehalt bei 4.000–4.300 € brutto pro Monat .

Mitarbeitervorteile 

Über unser Mitarbeiter-Benefit-System bieten wir dir verschiedene Vergünstigungen und Zuschüsse, unter anderem über Probonio.

Rahmenbedingungen

Arbeitsort: Hamburg-Altona
Beschäftigung: Vollzeit
Arbeitsmodell: vor Ort
Gehalt: 4.000–4.300 € brutto/Monat
Bewerbung: inklusive Portfolio / Arbeitsproben

Wenn du starken Content produzieren möchtest, gerne Verantwortung für deine Projekte übernimmst und Kreativität mit zuverlässiger Umsetzung verbinden kannst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Wirtschaftsinformatiker/in – Digitalisierung & Automatisierung - Vollzeit (m/w/d)
description:
Du denkst gerne in Systemen, erkennst ineffiziente Abläufe schnell und hast Freude daran, aus manuellen Prozessen saubere digitale Lösungen zu machen?

Als Wirtschaftsinformatiker/in bei ESH arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen Geschäftsprozessen, Software und Automatisierung.

Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe, entwickelst digitale Lösungen und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Systeme zuverlässig miteinander funktionieren.

Dabei geht es nicht darum, ständig jedem neuen Tool hinterherzulaufen. Wir suchen jemanden, der Prozesse wirklich versteht, sinnvolle Lösungen entwickelt und diese anschließend sauber, nachvollziehbar und dauerhaft implementiert.

Deine Aufgaben

- Du analysierst bestehende Geschäftsprozesse und identifizierst Möglichkeiten zur Digitalisierung und Automatisierung.

- Du konzipierst und implementierst digitale Prozesse für unsere internen Abläufe.

- Du entwickelst und optimierst Automationen für wiederkehrende Aufgaben.

- Du verbindest unterschiedliche Anwendungen über APIs, Webhooks und Schnittstellen.

- Du betreust und entwickelst unsere bestehenden SaaS-Anwendungen weiter.

- Du führst neue Softwarelösungen ein und integrierst sie sinnvoll in unsere bestehenden Prozesse.

- Du sorgst dafür, dass Daten zuverlässig zwischen unseren Systemen übertragen werden.

- Du analysierst Fehler und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen statt kurzfristiger Workarounds.

- Du dokumentierst Prozesse, Systeme und Automationen nachvollziehbar.

- Du arbeitest eng mit Vertrieb, Marketing, Kundenbetreuung und Geschäftsführung zusammen, um deren Anforderungen technisch sinnvoll umzusetzen.

- Du schulst Mitarbeiter bei neuen Systemen und sorgst dafür, dass neue Prozesse im Alltag tatsächlich funktionieren.

- Du überprüfst bestehende Lösungen regelmäßig auf Stabilität, Effizienz und mögliche Verbesserungen.

So sieht dein Arbeitsalltag aus

Ein großer Teil deiner Arbeit besteht darin, bestehende Abläufe zu verstehen und daraus funktionierende digitale Systeme zu entwickeln.

Du bekommst beispielsweise einen Prozess aus Vertrieb, Marketing, Kundenbetreuung oder interner Organisation und analysierst zunächst:

Was passiert aktuell? Wo entstehen Fehler oder unnötige manuelle Schritte? Welche Daten werden benötigt? Welche Systeme sind beteiligt? Und was lässt sich sinnvoll automatisieren? 

Anschließend entwickelst du eine Lösung, setzt sie technisch um, testest sie und dokumentierst den neuen Ablauf.

Dabei arbeitest du überwiegend konzentriert und eigenständig an deinen Aufgaben und Projekten. Für fachliche Anforderungen stimmst du dich direkt mit den zuständigen Kollegen ab.

Wir legen Wert darauf, dass Lösungen nicht nur technisch funktionieren, sondern verständlich dokumentiert, stabil und langfristig wartbar sind.

Die Stelle passt besonders gut zu dir, wenn …

- du gerne logisch und analytisch denkst,

- du komplexe Abläufe schnell verstehen kannst,

- du Spaß daran hast, Probleme systematisch zu lösen,

- du sehr strukturiert und präzise arbeitest,

- du lieber eine saubere langfristige Lösung entwickelst als mehrere kurzfristige Workarounds,

- du dich längere Zeit konzentriert mit einem Problem beschäftigen kannst,

- du bestehende Prozesse zunächst verstehen möchtest, bevor du sie veränderst,

- du gerne eigenständig arbeitest, Anforderungen aber zuverlässig mit anderen abstimmst,

- du Fehler nicht nur behebst, sondern ihre Ursache verstehen möchtest,

- du Wert auf Dokumentation und nachvollziehbare Systeme legst,

- du Verantwortung für die Funktionsfähigkeit deiner Lösungen übernimmst,

- du gerne einen Bereich langfristig aufbaust und immer besser verstehst.

Das solltest du mitbringen

- abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder einen vergleichbaren fachlichen Hintergrund

- sehr gutes analytisches und strukturiertes Denkvermögen

- schnelle Auffassungsgabe

- gutes Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse und deren Digitalisierung

- Erfahrung mit digitalen Systemlandschaften und SaaS-Anwendungen

- Verständnis von APIs, Webhooks und Schnittstellen

- Erfahrung mit Automatisierungsplattformen oder die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in diese einzuarbeiten

Der Maschinenraum ist das geteilte Innovationsökosystem deutscher Mittelstands- und Familienunternehmen, um gemeinsam Zukunftsthemen besser zu verstehen und mutiger zu gestalten. Als CRM & Marketing Intelligence Manager (m/w/d) bist du die datengetriebene Kraft hinter unserer Mitgliederkommunikation. Du analysierst, wie sich unsere Mitglieder verhalten – welche Formate sie nutzen, wo sie aktiv sind und wo sie abspringen – und übersetzt diese Erkenntnisse in gezielte Maßnahmen, die Engagement und Bindung stärken. Auf Basis deiner Analysen entwickelst und steuerst du gezielte Handlungen sowie automatisierte Marketingmaßnahmen zur Steigerung von Awareness, Engagement und Loyalität. Du arbeitest dabei eng mit den anderen Teams des Maschinenraum zusammen und unterstützt sie mit Handlungsempfehlungen für die Weiterentwicklung sowie Vermarktung von Angeboten.

- Du bist eigeninitiativ und verlierst dich nicht in der Analyse – du willst Dinge bewegen.

Was dich erwartet

This role reports to the Global Head of Tax and will have an impact on SumUp's IPO readiness.

What you'll do 

- Lead delivery of SumUp's tax agenda across corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and indirect tax, within the Group tax strategy set by the Head of Tax

- Oversee the transfer pricing framework and its implementation, and propose improvements to both substance and automation

- Draft and maintain tax policies, controls, and governance documentation for Group entities, for sign-off by the Head of Tax

- Act as the first point of contact for tax authority audits and controversies, keeping the Head of Tax aligned on positions and exposure

- Provide independent technical judgement on high-stakes tax positions, challenging assumptions and bringing options and recommendations to the Head of Tax

- Partner with Tax Compliance and Tax Operations to keep strategic positions compliant and operationally workable

- Lead the Pillar Two and CbCR implementation, turning requirements into practical plans for affected markets

- Lead, develop, and prioritise the tax team, and deputise for the Head of Tax when required

You'll be great for this role if… 

- Senior tax experience across corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and indirect tax in a multinational, combining strategic leadership with hands-on technical delivery. You're comfortable working through the detail yourself, from modelling and documentation to reviewing returns, and you don't need to hand every technical question to an adviser.

- A track record of building in-house tax expertise, with a preference for developing capability internally and using external advisers selectively, for specialist opinions and peer review rather than day-to-day analysis.

- Proven track record developing senior tax team members, including people leadership, prioritisation, and performance development.

- Strong knowledge of European corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and cross-border structuring, along with Pillar Two, CbCR, and EU Directives.

- Experience leading tax audits and controversies, including extensive direct engagement with tax authorities.

- Ability to translate complex regulatory and commercial issues into clear tax positions, communicated confidently to non-tax stakeholders such as finance leadership and auditors.

title: International Expansion
description:
About Us 

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here .

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the German market. 

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in German markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak German and fluent English. Other European languages are also be an asset.

What you will be doing 

- Owning new customer acquisition end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, setting our partners up to generate meaningful revenue

- High-level strategy development, defining and executing Axle’s international expansion plans, and assessing the commercial value of German markets and business models

- Diving deep into policy and regulations, understanding how market access works and what needs doing to achieve it

- Developing the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships with key stakeholders. You’ll be jumping on the phone (and eventually, getting on the ground) with grid operators, utilities/retailers and potential clients to create and disprove hypotheses as quickly as possible.

- Acting as a conduit between partners and engineering teams creating fast, structured feedback loops that help translate field insights into meaningful product enhancements

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets.

You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification.

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in the Germany. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

- Initial interview

- Take-home exercise

- Final interview (in-person)

- Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

title: Account Manager II (German Speaking)
description:
About Pleo 

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role 

We're looking for a commercially-minded Account Manager to join our Mid-Market Account Management Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help grow and expand our existing customer base and be part of the Customer Growth & Expansion team as we scale. If you're excited about strategic account management, obsessed with customer outcomes, know how to unlock expansion across complex organisation, you love nurturing relationships, identifying growth levers, proving ROI, and are passionate about spend management, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to 

You’ll report to our Senior Sales Manager, Account Management and work closely with teams in Customer Success, Deal Desk, Pricing and Enablement. Our team of 16 is highly collaborative and dedicated to delivering value and growing our existing customer base. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Sales, Support, Product and Marketing to ensure success.

What you’ll be doing 

As an Account Manager, you will:

- Identify and close opportunities within your book of business to grow accounts through upsells, new entities, teams, and product capabilities aligned to evolving customer needs.

- Build deep relationships with key stakeholders to understand their strategic initiatives, and uncover whitespace opportunities.

- Use MEDDICC (or similar) to rigorously qualify upsell and cross-sell opportunities to ensure forecast accuracy and deal velocity.

- Showcase new product features, integrations, and advanced workflows that drive stronger adoption and platform value for upsells.

- Create custom proposals and business cases that quantify value, align with commercial goals, and support customer budgeting cycles.

- Work across senior finance, procurement, and operations stakeholders to land multi-threaded expansions.

- Lead commercial conversations ensuring terms reflect the value Pleo delivers.

- Use customer success stories, usage data, and ROI metrics to proactively pitch new functionality and deepen platform adoption.

What you bring 

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

- A solid understanding of value-based selling and consultative approach

- Skilled in contract negotiations and building business cases linking features to value

- Strong understanding of qualification methodologies (e.g., MEDDICC)

- A passion for solving problems with a solution-oriented approach

- Data-driven, goal-oriented, and accurate forecasting ability

- Strong commercial acumen and ability to navigate senior stakeholders

- A background in SaaS Account Management or Customer Growth with a proven track record of expansion revenue and high net revenue retention

- Complete fluency in English

Why is this role a good fit for you 

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You are naturally curious and driven to map out complex organisations, identifying white space where Pleo can solve a genuine business need.

- You get a rush from closing upsells by proving ROI and prefer driving proactive growth over simply waiting for a renewal.

- You use frameworks like MEDDICC to keep deals on track and can easily show a CFO how tech features translate into financial value.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

- You view Account Management solely as responding to support tickets or handling administrative renewals rather than proactively hunting for expansion opportunities and driving revenue.

- You require a rigid, unchanging playbook to succeed. We are scaling fast, which means processes evolve and you’ll need to be comfortable building the plane while flying it.

- You prefer simple, single-point-of-contact relationships. This role requires multi-threading across Finance, IT, and Procurement in mid-market organizations.

How you’ll develop in this role 

In your first 6 to 12 months at Pleo, you’ll:

- Lead targeted account whitespace analysis to drive impact in your assigned market segment.

- Collaborate with Product and Marketing to improve feedback loops that influence our mid-market product roadmap.

- Grow your skills in complex commercial negotiation and value engineering, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale

The location 

[Delete this for critical/hard to fill role where VISA sponsorship can be an option] 
Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work . We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits! 

💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

The interview process 

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

- Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.

- Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience

- Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

- Bar Raiser : A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

- CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

- Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

- Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application 

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

- Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here .

- Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Onboarding Manager (m/w/d) – Customer Onboarding für Praxissoftware
description:
Berlin | Hybrid 

Du erklärst gern, behältst bei mehreren Projekten den Überblick und packst bei technischen Fragen mit an? Dann begleite Arztpraxen beim Wechsel auf eine neue Software – vom ersten Planungsgespräch bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live.

DOMUS Consult sucht für einen Anbieter cloudbasierter Praxisverwaltungssoftware im Raum Berlin einen Onboarding Manager (m/w/d) . Im Customer Onboarding verbindest du Projektmanagement, Technik und persönlichen Kundenkontakt. Dein Ziel: Software Onboarding für Arztpraxen so gestalten, dass Praxisteams gut vorbereitet mit ihrem neuen System arbeiten können.

Du machst aus einem Softwarewechsel einen guten Start

- Du steuerst das gesamte Onboarding von der Vertragsunterschrift bis zum Go-live und der anschließenden Übergabe an den Kundenservice.

- Du lernst die Abläufe und Anforderungen der Praxen kennen und konfigurierst das Praxisverwaltungssystem entsprechend.

- Du koordinierst die Datenmigration gemeinsam mit dem internen Datenmigrationsteam.

- Du schulst Ärztinnen, Ärzte, Medizinische Fachangestellte und das Praxismanagement – verständlich und passend zum jeweiligen Wissensstand.

- Du bringst alle Beteiligten zusammen: Praxisteams, Labore, externe IT-Dienstleister und Anbieter der Telematikinfrastruktur.

- Du bleibst die zentrale Ansprechperson für deine Praxen und gibst Feedback sowie eigene Verbesserungsideen an Produktmanagement und Entwicklung weiter.

Du kannst erklären, organisieren und mitdenken

Du bringst mindestens ein Jahr Erfahrung im Projektmanagement oder mindestens drei Jahre im Customer Service beziehungsweise Customer Success im IT- oder Softwareumfeld mit.

Außerdem passt die Rolle zu dir, wenn du:

- sicher vor Gruppen auftrittst und Freude daran hast, anderen etwas verständlich zu erklären;

- ein gutes technisches Verständnis mitbringst und bei Hardware- und Netzwerkthemen praktisch mit anpackst;

- mehrere Projekte strukturiert organisierst und auch bei Hindernissen nach Lösungen suchst;

- klar und freundlich kommunizierst, gern im Team arbeitest und Verantwortung für deine Ziele übernimmst;

- den Gesundheitsmarkt kennenlernen möchtest und situativ flexibel bist;

- verhandlungssicher Deutsch auf Niveau C1/C2 sprichst und gute Englischkenntnisse hast.

Zusätzlich hilfreich: Erfahrung mit Praxisverwaltungssystemen oder Praxisabläufen, etwa als MFA, Kenntnisse der Telematikinfrastruktur, Erfahrung als Trainer oder Schulungsleitung sowie Salesforce- oder vergleichbare CRM-Kenntnisse. Das sind Pluspunkte, keine Voraussetzungen.

Damit du selbst gut ankommst

Dich erwartet eine strukturierte Einarbeitung in das Produkt, den Praxisalltag und die Telematikinfrastruktur. Du arbeitest im Support- und Onboarding-Team eng mit der Teamleitung zusammen und kannst auf kollegiale Unterstützung zählen.

Warum sich der Wechsel für dich lohnen kann

Du begleitest Kundenprojekte vom Anfang bis zum Abschluss und erlebst, wie deine Arbeit im Praxisalltag ankommt. Dabei verbindest du Kundenkontakt, Softwareimplementierung und Kundenschulung. Deine Erfahrungen aus den Projekten fließen in bessere Abläufe und die Weiterentwicklung des Produkts ein.

title: Mid Market Account Executive
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role 

Elastic, the Search Analytics company, is seeking a dynamic Mid-Market Account Executive. To excel as an Account Executive at Elastic , you need a blend of high-level technical curiosity and the gravitas of a value-based seller. Because Elastic isn't just a "product" but a versatile search, observability, and security platform, the role requires moving beyond simple transactions to solving complex data problems.

We are seeking a Mid-Market Account Executive dedicated to 100% net-new revenue generation . In this role, you will own the full sales cycle—from cold outreach to close—focused entirely on acquiring new logos in an assigned territory. If you excel at navigating new organizations and demonstrating the value of advanced search technology to stakeholders, this is your opportunity to drive our next phase of growth.

What You Will Be Doing 

- Drive Adoption: Fuel the adoption of Elastic’s AI-powered search solutions, Observability and Security solutions within new Mid-Market accounts while deepening engagement with existing ones.

- Be a Trusted Advisor: Assist users and customers in harnessing the full power of search analytics to transform data into actionable insights.

- Domain & cloud acumen: Position Elastic as the Search AI platform of choice by speaking fluently about cloud economics, usage-based pricing, and modern data architectures.

- Solve Complex Problems: Move beyond simple transactions to address the intricate data challenges our customers face.

- Champion Open Source: Articulate the value of our advanced commercial features while advocating for our Open-Source offerings.

- Identify New Use Cases: Showcase how Elastic’s solutions enable users to work more efficiently and intelligently.

- Strategic Planning: Develop comprehensive business plans leveraging community, customer, and partner ecosystems to drive significant territory growth.

- Navigate Sales Cycles: Proactively identify new opportunities and successfully manage complex sales cycles.

- Deep discovery & qualification: Uncover pain, business impact, budget, and decision criteria using frameworks like MEDDPICC so you chase only the highest-confidence deals.

- Cross-functional partnership: Work hand-in-glove with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Marketing, and RevOps to accelerate deals and drive exceptional customer outcomes.

What You Bring 

- The Right Blend: A combination of high-level technical curiosity and the grit of a value-based seller.

- Proven Track Record: Success in SaaS subscription sales in Mid -Market accounts, evidenced by overachievement.

- Mindset: Pure focus on acquiring new logos with a record to prove it. 

- Value Storytelling: The ability to craft tailored narratives that link Elastic’s technical capabilities (Search, Observability, Security) to measurable business outcomes like revenue gain or risk mitigation is critical.

- Executive negotiation & closing: Lead high-stakes contract and pricing discussions

- Technical & cloud fluency: Comfortable discussing a broad range of technical topics including security, observability, vector/traditional search, and cloud cost optimization.

- Relationship Building: Adept at establishing credibility with both technical developers and executive leadership.

- Mutual deal strategy & forecast accuracy: Consistent, predictable and accurate sales forecasting skills. Collaborate with customers to build formal close plans and keep your CRM up to date.

- Ability to create alignment across teams to accelerate deals

- AI Mindset: Use new technologies for performance advantage and deal structuring

- Open-Source Appreciation: Enthusiasm for the Open-Source model and the community relying on our solutions.

If you’re driven to build your own pipeline, master complex deal cycles, and help customers unlock the power of Search AI, we’d love to talk. Apply today!

description:

If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

12-month fixed-term contract | Global Revenue Systems and AI Team | 

About the Role 

Our reps spend most of their day in Salesforce, and how it feels to use directly affects how much they sell. We're hiring a Salesforce Developer with a UI/UX focus to redesign the rep experience across our Sales and Revenue teams. You'll join the global Salesforce team for 12 months to make the CRM faster, clearer and more intuitive.

This is a hands-on build role. You'll design the experience and code it in Lightning Web Components, working with Sales, RevOps, Marketing and Data, and directly with the reps who use the result.

What You Will Do 

Redesign the rep experience 

- Audit the current Lightning experience (record pages, console apps, list views, home pages) and find where reps lose time to clicks, clutter and missing context.

- Turn what you find into a prioritised roadmap of UI improvements tied to rep productivity and adoption.

- Design and prototype improved layouts, workflows and components, and validate them with reps before building.

Build with LWC 

- Develop custom Lightning Web Components (and supporting Apex where needed) that replace clunky standard layouts with focused, usable interfaces.

- Configure and extend Lightning App Builder pages, Dynamic Forms, Dynamic Actions and console apps to deliver a consistent experience across teams and regions.

- Build reusable components and follow SLDS conventions so the UI stays consistent and maintainable after your contract ends.

Make it stick 

- Run feedback sessions, usability tests and pilots with reps and managers, and iterate on the results.

- Track adoption, page performance and user satisfaction to show what each release changed.

- Create release notes, short walkthroughs and handover documentation so changes land well and the team can maintain what you build.

Work as part of the global team 

- Work within the global team's standards for source control, code review, sandboxes and release management.

- Partner with admins, architects and data teams so UI changes fit the wider data model, security model and automation.

- Pass on what you learn about Lightning UX patterns and LWC best practices to the wider team.

What You Will Need 

Must have 

- Strong, demonstrable experience building Lightning Web Components in production.

- Solid Apex, SOQL and Salesforce data model knowledge to support your components.

- Deep knowledge of Lightning Experience customisation: App Builder, Dynamic Forms, page layouts, console apps and Flows.

- Experience with Salesforce DX, Git and a CI/CD or deployment process.

- A UX mindset: you start from user problems, can explain design decisions, and can take feedback from non-technical users.

- Clear communication and the ability to work independently across time zones in a global team.

Nice to have 

- Portfolio or examples of Salesforce UI work you've shipped (screenshots or demos are ideal).

- Experience with SLDS, Figma or similar prototyping tools, and accessibility (WCAG) principles.

- Experience in Sales Cloud, especially rep-facing workflows such as opportunity management, account planning and pipeline views.

- Jest testing for LWC, and Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, JavaScript Developer I, Platform App Builder).

- Experience with performance profiling and optimisation in Lightning pages.

What Success Looks Like (12 Months) 

- Month 3: UX audit complete and a prioritised roadmap agreed with Sales leadership.

- Month 6: First wave of redesigned pages and components live for a pilot group, with adoption and feedback baselined.

- Month 12: Redesigned experience rolled out to target teams, a maintained component library in place, and full documentation handed to the global team.

What we offer

- 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

- Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

- Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

- Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

- Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

- Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

- 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

- 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

- Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

- A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

- Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

AI at Perk 
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work 

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Account Executive Nordics
description:
Who is Litmus 

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus 

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible 

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world 

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast 

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team 

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture 

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

About the role

Litmus is hiring an Account Executive to own and grow new business with industrial manufacturers across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Iceland and Finland.

Litmus is an industrial DataOps and edge AI platform. We help manufacturers connect, normalize and use data from their plants, from shop-floor assets up to the cloud. Our customers use Litmus to break down OT data silos and scale analytics and AI across sites.

You will be the face of Litmus in the Nordics. You will build pipeline, run complex enterprise sales cycles end to end, and work closely with our pre-sales team, hyperscaler partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Databricks) and system integrators. You report to the EMEA sales lead.

What you will do

• Own a Nordic territory and its revenue target, from prospecting to signed contract and expansion.

• Build and qualify pipeline through outbound, events, partners and inbound leads.

• Run discovery with plant, operations, OT and IT stakeholders up to C-level, and map their business case for change.

• Lead structured, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles, including proofs of value, commercial proposals and negotiation.

• Work hand in hand with pre-sales on demos, solution design and technical validation.

• Co-sell with hyperscalers and system integrators, and develop partner-sourced opportunities in your region.

• Keep forecasts and opportunity data accurate in Salesforce.

• Expand existing accounts from first site to multi-site and global rollouts.

• Bring market feedback back to product, marketing and leadership.

What you bring

Segment experience (required) 

• 5+ years of B2B enterprise software sales, with a proven record of meeting or beating quota.

• Direct sales experience in industrial software: IIoT, industrial DataOps, data historians, MES, SCADA, edge computing or manufacturing analytics.

• A solid grasp of the OT/IT landscape in manufacturing, and of how plant data flows from machines to the cloud.

• Experience selling into manufacturing, process industries, energy or similar industrial sectors.

Nordic market knowledge (required) 

• An established network among industrial manufacturers in the Nordics.

• A working understanding of Nordic buying culture, decision-making and procurement.

• Familiarity with the regional partner and system integrator landscape.

• Fluency in English and at least one Nordic language (Swedish, Norwegian, Danish or Finnish).

How you work 

• Comfortable running long, complex deals with many stakeholders.

• Disciplined in qualification and forecasting (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC or similar).

• Self-driven and at ease building a territory in a growing team.

Nice to have

• Experience selling alongside Microsoft, AWS, Google or Databricks.

• Track record of displacing incumbent industrial software, such as historians or legacy integration tools.

• Experience in an early-stage or scale-up team in a new region.

Travel and location

• Up to 40% travel within the Nordics and to EMEA team and partner events.

• Based in the Nordics, ideally near Stockholm, Oslo, Copenhagen or Helsinki.
