- Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.

If you think that you have been a victim of fraud,

As a Legal Engineer in our Paris team, you’ll help tax and audit professionals put AI to work in their day-to-day practice. Some of what you’ll be doing:

- Understand the work. Work with tax partners, audit leaders and their teams to identify where Legora can make a meaningful difference, from tax research and advisory to evidence review and audit documentation.

- Build and test workflows. Translate client needs into working use cases, check outputs against source material and professional standards, and refine the approach with the people using it.

You come from tax, audit, assurance or a closely related advisory practice. You may have trained at a Big Four firm, worked at another professional services firm, or built your experience in an in-house function. Perhaps you’ve already moved into innovation, technology implementation or consulting.

You understand the pressure of client deadlines, the importance of defensible conclusions and how much work sits behind a finished report or piece of advice. You also have ideas about how that work could be done better.

- Have practical experience in tax or audit and can discuss the work credibly with experienced practitioners. You don’t need to be a specialist in both.

You’ll join a growing Tax & Audit team with room to shape how we work. There is real autonomy and responsibility, alongside colleagues who will challenge your thinking and help you develop.

description:
Handicap International / Humanité & Inclusion (HI) est une association de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et vulnérabilisées, elle agit et témoigne pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels et améliorer leurs conditions de vie. Elle s’engage à promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux. Depuis sa création en 1982, HI a mis en place des programmes de développement dans plus de 60 pays et intervient dans de nombreuses situations d’urgence. Aujourd'hui, nous avons un budget d'environ 255 millions d'euros, avec 4794 employés dans le monde.

Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap. 

Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux 1ers entretiens.

CONTEXTE : 

La Direction des Programmes Internationaux (DPI) de Humanité & Inclusion comprend entre autres 5 Directions Géographiques, 4 Directions Techniques, 1 Direction Atlas Logistique et 1 Direction Urgence.

La Direction Urgence est composée de 15 personnes: une équipe en charge de la veille, de l'alerte et de la préparation aux urgences et une équipe en charge des interventions d'urgence au niveau du siège et sur le terrain. C’est au sein de cette dernière, composée de 6 spécialistes des urgences et prêts à être déployés sous 72 heures que nous recrutons un ou une Responsable Réadaptation physique et Fonctionnelle en Urgence dans le cadre d’un remplacement temporaire.

OBJECTIFS DU POSTE : 

Sous la responsabilité du responsable du pool d'urgence et en étroite coordination avec les Spécialistes en Réadaptation Physique et Fonctionnelle du siège, le responsable Réadaptation Physique et Fonctionnelle d'urgence aura la charge de :

Participer au diagnostic initial des opérations de réponse d'urgence, à la suite d’une crise humanitaire ; 

· Contribuer à la définition de la stratégie, de la méthodologie et du dimensionnement du diagnostic initial, y compris la création et/ou l'adaptation des outils d'évaluation des besoins ;

· Participer aux évaluations des besoins ;

· Contribuer à l'analyse des résultats et à la définition de la stratégie de réponse immédiate en anticipant le nexus urgence-réhabilitation-développement ;

· Contribuer à l'élaboration du projet et à la rédaction des propositions ;

Diriger et coordonner : 

Piloter le déploiement des activités de réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle lors de l’ouverture de nouveaux programmes d’urgence, en assurant la définition du cadre opérationnel, le management des équipes, la coordination avec les autres secteurs d’intervention et les partenaires, ainsi que le suivi de la qualité, du budget, des résultats et du reporting. Le poste contribue également à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie d’intervention d’urgence, au renforcement des capacités des équipes et partenaires, et à la capitalisation des retours d’expérience.

Représenter et promouvoir le mandat d’Humanité & Inclusion dans le cadre des réponses d’urgence dans votre domaine d’expertise ; 

· Promouvoir le mandat et son positionnement en coordination avec les partenaires de mise en œuvre ;

· Représenter et participer aux mécanismes de coordination des réponses liées à la Réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle d’urgence (groupe de travail santé, groupe de travail traumatologie etc…)

· Participer, sur demande de la hiérarchie, aux actions liées aux campagnes de plaidoyer et institutionnelles mises en œuvre par Humanité & Inclusion au siège et/ou sur le terrain ;

· Contribuer à la mobilisation des acteurs publics et privés pour assurer l’inclusion de la vulnérabilité et du handicap dans leurs programmes et initiatives.

Contribuer à la capitalisation institutionnelle et participer au développement et à la mise à jour des méthodologies, procédures, outils et formations d'urgence d’Humanité & Inclusion. 

· Participer aux travaux de formalisation et de capitalisation dans son domaine d'expertise en étroite collaboration avec le responsable de secteur et le spécialiste technique du siège ;

· Participer à la stratégie Direction Urgence et autres, si nécessaire ;

· Contribuer de façon proactive et constructive à la conception des processus et méthodologies de réponse aux urgences ;

· Contribuer au développement et/ou à l'optimisation des outils, procédures et ressources utilisés par Humanité & Inclusion pour la réponse aux urgences en étroite collaboration avec le spécialiste technique du siège.

· Contribuer au renforcement des capacités de réponse aux urgences du personnel et/ou des partenaires d'Humanité & Inclusion en fonction des besoins identifiés ;

· Contribuer à l'amélioration des outils et modules de formation dans ses domaines d'expertise ;

· Participer activement aux ateliers organisés au sein de l'Equipe de Réponse aux Urgences ou par d'autres départements au sein d'Humanité & Inclusion, en relation avec les réponses aux urgences

· Apporter un support au spécialiste technique du siège sur des sujets spécifiques et transversaux.

Requirements 

Vous avez une expérience d’au moins trois ans en réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle en contexte d’urgence et votre situation personnelle actuelle vous permet d’être déployé sous 72 heures ? Voici plus en détail le profil requis pour ce poste passionnant ouvert dans le cadre d’un remplacement temporaire :

Formation / Connaissances 

- Un diplôme de kinésithérapeute ou ergothérapeute

- Une formation complémentaire en gestion et développement de projets / opérations humanitaires ou équivalent de préférence dans le domaine de l’action humanitaire internationale

- Bonne connaissance des réglementations et processus des bailleurs d’urgence

- Langues : anglais et français maitrisés. La maitrise de l’espagnol ou l’arabe serait un plus.

- Informatique : maitrise du Pack Office

Profil recherché 

- Expérience confirmée d’au moins 2 ans dans des fonctions de coordination ou de management de projets en réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle.

title: AI Engineer H/F - Paris
description:
AVISIA, qui sommes-nous ?

AVISIA est une société de conseil spécialisée en Data, Intelligence Artificielle et Digital , créée en 2007. Avec plus de 320 collaborateurs répartis dans 5 agences en France, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la valorisation de leurs données et le développement de solutions innovantes, de la stratégie jusqu’à la mise en production. 

Nos équipes interviennent sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de la donnée, avec une forte expertise en Data Science, Data Engineering, IA générative et LLM. Chez AVISIA, nous associons excellence technique, proximité humaine et projets à forte valeur ajoutée pour faire de la Data un véritable levier de transformation. 

Nous intervenons auprès de clients aux secteurs d’activité variés, sur des missions qui combinent enjeux techniques, Data, IA et transformation opérationnelle. Selon votre profil et vos affinités, vous pourrez contribuer à des projets allant de la conception de prototypes jusqu’à la mise en production de solutions IA robustes, sécurisées et maintenables. 

Nos clients évoluent notamment dans les secteurs du Luxe, du Retail, des Télécoms, de la Banque, de l’Assurance et de l’Industrie . Cette diversité vous permettra de découvrir différents environnements métiers et de travailler sur des problématiques techniques variées. 

Quelques exemples de projets AI Engineer 

- Conception et développement d’agents autonomes pour automatiser des processus métiers : conception de workflows complexes, notamment dans l’industrie ou la relation client, dans lesquels des agents IA enchaînent des tâches, prennent des décisions et interagissent avec les outils et les données internes de l’entreprise. 

- Conception et orchestration de plateformes multi-agents : mise en place d’architectures dans lesquelles plusieurs agents IA spécialisés collaborent pour résoudre des problématiques complexes, par exemple en combinant recherche d’informations, synthèse et exécution de code, afin d’améliorer l’efficacité opérationnelle. 

- Déploiement de plateformes Cloud : conception et déploiement d’environnements permettant de développer, sécuriser, superviser et faire évoluer des solutions IA. 

- Évaluation, observabilité et gouvernance des solutions IA : mise en place de dispositifs permettant de suivre la qualité, les coûts, les performances et la sécurité des applications IA, afin d’en garantir la fiabilité et la pérennité. 

AI Engineer – Data & IA (H/F)

Votre profil

Nous recherchons un profil de formation supérieure (Bac+5) en informatique, ingénierie logicielle, data ou domaine équivalent. 

Vous justifiez de 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en développement Data & IA, en data engineering, machine learning engineering ou conception de solutions IA. Vous disposez de solides bases en Python et en développement logiciel : APIs, Git, tests, conteneurisation et CI/CD. 

Vous avez déjà participé à des projets d’industrialisation de solutions IA, idéalement autour du RAG, des agents IA, des environnements Cloud et de la mise en production. 

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons une personne autonome, pragmatique et curieuse, capable de comprendre un besoin métier pour le traduire en solution technique concrète. Une bonne maîtrise du français et un niveau d’anglais technique sont attendus. 

Votre rôle en tant qu’AI Engineer 

Chez AVISIA, vous interviendrez sur des problématiques techniques variées, de la conception jusqu’au déploiement de solutions IA en production. 

Selon votre expérience, vos compétences et les projets, vous pourrez notamment intervenir sur : 

- L’analyse des besoins et la conception d’architectures IA adaptées aux enjeux métiers. 

- Le développement d’agents IA, de workflows et d’applications RAG . 

- L’intégration d’outils, d’APIs et de données d’entreprise. 

- Le développement d’APIs, de serveurs MCP et de services backend. 

- L’industrialisation et le déploiement de solutions dans des environnements Cloud. 

- La mise en place de tests, d’évaluations, de dispositifs d’observabilité et de sécurité. 

- La documentation des solutions et le partage des bonnes pratiques avec les équipes. 

Vous travaillerez en proximité avec les clients et les consultants AVISIA pour contribuer aux choix techniques, proposer des solutions pertinentes et faire progresser les expertises autour de l’IA générative. 

Les environnements techniques 

Pas besoin de maîtriser l’ensemble de ces technologies pour nous rejoindre ! Nous recherchons avant tout des profils solides en développement, curieux et motivés, avec l’envie d’apprendre et de monter en compétences sur les sujets d’IA générative, d’industrialisation et de Cloud. 

Selon vos compétences, vos envies et les projets sur lesquels vous interviendrez, vous pourrez être amené(e) à travailler avec différentes technologies : 

- Langages & frameworks : Python, SQL, Node.js, FastAPI, LangChain, ADK, LlamaIndex, APIs d’IA générative (OpenAI, Anthropic…). 

- DevOps & industrialisation : Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Git. 

- Plateformes Data & Cloud : Google Cloud, AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, Dataiku. 

L’objectif : vous permettre de développer progressivement votre expertise, de découvrir de nouvelles technologies et de construire un parcours professionnel qui vous ressemble. 

Ce que nous vous offrons 

Chez AVISIA, nous accordons autant d’importance à votre évolution professionnelle qu’à votre épanouissement au quotidien. 

- Un équilibre vie pro / vie perso , grâce à notre politique de télétravail. 

- Une mutuelle familiale pour prendre soin de vous et de vos proches. 

- Une formation continue via l’AVISIA School, pour développer vos compétences et rester à la pointe des technologies Data & IA. 

- Des certifications pour valoriser votre expertise et accompagner votre montée en compétences. 

- De réelles perspectives d’évolution : Contributeur, Senior, Tech Lead, Business Leader, Practice Leader… Plusieurs parcours sont possibles selon vos envies et vos ambitions. 

- Un accompagnement de proximité , avec des échanges réguliers pour suivre vos projets et construire la suite de votre parcours. 

- Le partage et l’intelligence collective , grâce à nos communautés d’experts, nos retours d’expérience et nos initiatives internes. 

- Une culture d’entreprise conviviale et engagée , où l’humain compte autant que l’expertise technique. 

Le processus de recrutement 

Nous privilégions un processus structuré et transparent, pour vous permettre de découvrir AVISIA et de mieux comprendre les attentes du poste à chaque étape. 

- Un premier échange avec notre équipe Talent Acquisition : un entretien téléphonique, en visio ou sur site pour échanger sur votre parcours, vos envies et notre environnement. 

- Un test technique : un QCM et des cas pratiques vous seront envoyés par mail le soir même de votre entretien RH. Vous disposerez de 7 jours pour les réaliser. 

- Un entretien technique : vous rencontrerez un consultant senior, un manager ou un Practice Leader, idéalement sur site, pour approfondir vos compétences et échanger sur les projets. 

Des échanges informels avec l’équipe pourront également être organisés si besoin, afin de vous permettre de découvrir votre futur environnement de travail. 

Envie de construire la suite de votre parcours dans la Data & l’IA ? Rejoignez AVISIA !

Selon votre profil, vos compétences et vos affinités, vous pourrez intervenir sur des projets variés, de la conception de modèles prédictifs à leur déploiement en production, en passant par l’analyse des données et l’optimisation des performances. 

L’objectif : concevoir des solutions concrètes, exploiter pleinement le potentiel des données et contribuer directement à la prise de décision de nos clients.

title: Senior Performance Creative Strategist (gn) @ Female Health Consumer Startup, London
description:
About DITTO 

DITTO is a science-led brand redefining menstrual health. As a fast-growing, VC-backed business, we're scaling a new standard in menstrual wellbeing — empowering anyone with cycle symptoms to understand, support and optimise their health every day, not just during their period. Developed by female scientists and powered by biotechnology, the Cycle Supplement is backed by over 100 clinical trials and validated in its own clinical trial.

Beyond the capsule, DITTO is building a movement — combining credible science, thoughtful design, and inclusive storytelling to change how menstrual health is perceived and supported. As we grow, performance creative will be central to how we convert attention into action.

About the role 

You will sit at the intersection of data and creativity — turning science into content that stops the scroll and drives sales. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You will define what makes a potential customer stop, engage, and convert — and then build the systems to do it at scale.

You are not just briefing others. You are embedded in the work from the first concept through to post-production feedback and the next iteration. If you are equally energised by diving into data and dreaming up ideas, this role was built for you.

Performance creative strategy 

- Own creative strategy across Meta, TikTok and YouTube with clear KPIs across ROAS, conversion and scalable growth.

- Develop creative frameworks that harness DITTO's scientific credibility to build trust and drive purchase decisions.

- Analyse performance data to surface winning signals, identify trends and shape the next generation of assets.

- Build and own a structured testing roadmap — challenging creative hypotheses, running experiments and scaling what works.

- Track and report on hook rate, watch time, CTR, CVR, and ROAS — using data to drive every creative decision.

Hands-on execution 

- Lead end-to-end creative development: concepting, scripting, storyboarding, briefing, and post-production feedback.

- Develop high-performing short-form content with a relentless focus on hooks, retention and shareability.

- Identify repeatable formats and frameworks that can be systematically tested and scaled.

- Ensure all output balances performance intent with DITTO's brand identity — science-led, design-forward and inclusive.

What we're looking for 

- Extensive experience in performance marketing or creative strategy, ideally within D2C or the wellness space.

- Thinks in data and dreams in concepts — equally comfortable interpreting performance metrics as developing bold creative ideas.

- Deep understanding of Meta & TikTok — the nuances, the algorithms and what actually makes content perform.

- Can translate complex science into consumer messaging that earns trust and drives action.

- Proactive, highly organised and thrives in a fast-moving environment where you own your output.

- Cares about purpose-led brands, women's health and reshaping the conversation around menstrual wellbeing.

Bonus points if you: 

- Have experience in a high-growth startup environment.

- Have a personal interest in health, nutrition, or scientific innovation.

- Are familiar with motion design or video editing tools.

description:
About FoodLabs 

FoodLabs is Europe's leading early-stage VC and venture studio, backing founders who are shaping the future of the food, health, and climate value chains. We build companies from zero, putting capital, our own team, and hands-on operating time behind a founding team before there's a product or even a name. The studio's work spans wherever a market and the data or infrastructure underneath it are broken enough to justify building the fix from scratch. 

About The General Data Corporation 

General Data is the infrastructure for licensing proprietary data: The platform runs the whole deal from request to delivery, with privacy checks, rights evidence and contracts built in. The vision is to become the system of record between AI and the world’s private data, the data that has never been published but that the next generation of AI depends on. On one side are enterprises, AI labs and robotics teams that need real-world data, and on the other are companies whose operations generate it. General Data is the data infrastructure for the modern economy, connecting every party so that data can be licensed safely, transparently and at scale. 

Why this is a unique opportunity 

AI has absorbed the public internet, and its next gains will come from private, real-world data, yet today these deals still run on email, WhatsApp and brokers, with no visibility into what was checked, who holds the rights, or whether personal data was removed. Labs are already paying for this data, and regulation like GDPR and the EU Data Act makes a trusted, verifiable layer a necessity. 

General Data is VC-backed and looking for its technical co-founder. Together with Founder & CEO Louai Allani , you will own the product and architecture, shape the company’s direction as an equal partner and build the team from the ground up. 

About the role 

- Supplier intake: Build connectors for where companies actually keep their data: Databases, document stores, ticketing systems, machine logs, and sensor and video archives. 

- Transaction layer: Own the pipeline, rights evidence, contracts, permissions, audit trail and delivery API. 

- ML and data quality: Build anonymisation across text, tables, images and video, plus re-identification checks, deduplication, quality scoring and tooling that turns raw records into training-ready data. 

- Delivery and compute: Decide whether data is processed in our cloud or inside the supplier’s environment. Build secure delivery, recurring updates and our GPU infrastructure. 

- Technical direction: Own the architecture and roadmap. Work directly with labs, suppliers and researchers to understand what the system needs to become. 

What you need to succeed 

- Data infrastructure at scale: You have built pipelines for large unstructured datasets, such as video, images, sensor logs or documents, at terabyte scale or more. 

- Physical-world data: You have worked with documents, logs, video or sensor streams, ideally in robotics, industrial or autonomous systems and know what embodied AI teams need from data and where it breaks. 

- Sensitive data: You know how to handle personal and confidential data safely. Experience with regulated data is a plus. 

- Technical leadership: You make architectural decisions, explain them clearly and raise the engineering bar as the team grows. 

- Hands-on Builder: You have taken a product, platform or open-source project from 0 to 1 that others relied on, and you still write code and own the critical paths. 

- Founder mindset: You care about the outcome, not the title. You form strong views, test them quickly and are comfortable owning technical, product and operational problems. 

- Location: Paris preferred. English required; French is a plus. 

Please note: As a co-founder, you take a real stake in what we build. The compensation is a founder salary, and your upside grows with the company through your equity. Come build the infrastructure between AI and the world's data with us!

title: 3D Chiplet Engineer
description:
About Us : AI compute is hitting a hard physical wall, and memory bottlenecks are throttling the entire industry. Founded in October 2024 and backed by €57M in funding, Vertical Compute is solving this with proprietary Vertical Integrated Memory (VIM™) chiplets, making AI hardware faster, greener, and vastly more scalable. We are an interdisciplinary team transforming breakthrough semiconductor physics into commercial reality. 

Why Now : After 18 months of intensive R&D, Vertical Compute has reached a critical inflection point. Our underlying technology is validated, and we have successfully met our core technical milestones. Armed with a proven technical data package and ongoing system studies, we are now shifting from pure R&D to active engagement with global enterprise customers. As we prepare for our next phase of scale and growth starting in 2027, joining us today means taking direct ownership of the hardware foundation that will power the next era of AI compute. 

About the role: 

We are looking for a 3D Integration / Chiplet Expert to define and implement 2.5D/3D advanced packaging solutions for our Vertical Integrated Memory (VIM) technology. You will collaborate across teams to define optimal interconnect strategies and die stacking approaches to enable high-bandwidth, low-power operation. This job sits at the intersection of SoC architecture (specifically the physical design) , package design, and 3D manufacturing processes. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Integration Architecture & Process Definition : 
Develop and define architectures for 2.5D/3D stacking of VIM chiplets with compute chiplets. 
Collaborate with design and technology teams to develop interconnect solutions that ensure high bandwidth and low latency.
Define clearly the impact of the chiplet physical design chiplets (through-silicon vias, micro-bumps, hybrid bonds, redistribution layers, and chiplet interfaces, …)
define fabrication flows and design rules with foundries, packaging partners, and internal physical design teams 

- Performance Analysis & Simulation: 
Conduct early multi-physics simulations (thermal, electrical, mechanical) to analyze and optimize the performance and reliability of integrated systems.
drive external partners for final package design 

- Collaboration & Communication:
Partner closely with design, process engineering, metrology, and system architecture teams. 
Participate in conferences, standardization bodies and industry events to promote or lead discussions about the future of chiplet integration. 

- Technical Leadership:Provide 
technical leadership and project management guidance to multidisciplinary teams. 

About the team: 

This role is part of the Product & system team, partnering closely with our cross-functional engineering teams in Product & system and Memory Design. We foster a highly collaborative, inclusive environment where strong alignment, high transparency and seamless team coordination are central to our shared success. 

About who you are: 

- You’ve spent 5–10 years exploring the frontiers of 2.5D/3D packaging and heterogeneous integration, turning complex ideas into manufacturable systems. 

- You have a deep understanding on the SoC physical design, TSVs, Redistribution Layers, hybrid bonding and how they are used at system level to implement chip IOs (Functional and power IOs) 

- You are mastering Integrity 3D-IC Platform to define the chiplets interface, to define 3D stacking system, to generate the 3Dblox views, and to run all the 3D system level analysis (Power Delivery Network, Thermal, STA, LVS, SI/PI, …) 

- You thrive where architecture meets technology — translating ambitious concepts into elegant, high-performance designs. 

- Multi-physics isn’t just theory to you; you use thermal, electrical, and mechanical simulations to see the whole system clearly. 

- You’re naturally collaborative — just as comfortable in technical deep dives as you are building bridges between design, process, and system teams. 

- You’re the kind of engineer who balances vision with execution: leading projects, mentoring peers, and pushing boundaries with a calm hand. 

- Above all, you’re curious — drawn to the challenge of building something new and meaningful at the intersection of memory, compute, and packaging innovation. 

- Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication abilities. 

Why Join Us: 

- You will get the opportunity to work at the forefront of memory technology innovation. 

- Vertical Compute is not only a state-of-the art but also a human adventure. We believe you must have a lot of fun developing the best of you. Making sure you and your team are going to enjoy the journey and become passionate about what we do is a key goal of our founders. 

- You can be part of a talented and dedicated team in a fast-paced startup environment. 

- In this role, you contribute to projects that will have a significant impact on the future of computing and electronics. 

- You can count on a motivating total rewards package. 

- Flexible ways of working. 

Join us in shaping the future of compute & memory technology — and celebrating success!

description:
About ActAI 

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

description:
About Hilo by Aktiia 

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. 

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

As Performance Marketing Manager – Paid Social , you will own Hilo’s paid social strategy and performance across our key markets and prepare the channel for Hilo’s next stage of growth. Creative strategy is a core driver of paid social performance: You turn customer insight and campaign data into compelling concepts, run a rigorous testing program and work with creative partners to bring the strongest ideas to market. 

You connect that work to measurable business outcomes, improving conversion and return on investment while making sure every health claim is accurate and approved.

Reporting to the Head of Performance Marketing, you will play a key role in our performance marketing team, working with internal teams and external partners to drive growth.

Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required.

Core responsibilities 

- Lead paid social strategy, planning and execution across the US, UK, Germany and other growth markets.
- Develop creative hypotheses based on customer research, market differences and performance data.
- Brief, test and refine ad concepts, messages, formats and landing pages in partnership with creative and product teams.
- Manage campaign budgets, audiences and optimisation across Meta, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
- Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate, from ad click through to purchase.
- Measure performance against acquisition cost, revenue and return on investment and turn findings into clear decisions and next steps.
- Work with clinical, regulatory and legal colleagues to ensure advertising claims and health messaging are accurate and approved.
- Steer agencies and freelancers, set clear priorities and ensure high-quality execution and continuous performance improvement.
Requirements 

Background & Experience 

- At least 5 years of hands-on paid social experience in an international setting, including direct ownership of campaigns and budgets.
- Strong creative strategy skills and a track record of turning insights into ads that perform.
- A data-driven approach to testing, measurement, and decision-making.
- Experience improving conversion rates and managing campaigns against ROI goals.
- Deep knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and experience with other relevant social platforms.
- Ability to adapt messaging and execution across markets while keeping the brand consistent.
- Clear communication and sound judgment when working with sensitive health topics.
- Nice to have: experience in health tech, medical devices, wearables, or subscription products.
Benefits 

What Makes You A Great Fit 

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully and iterate quickly. You take ownership, act hands-on and always look for smarter, faster ways to get things done, including leveraging AI and new tools.

Team First — You put the team above individual interests, building trust through openness and respect. You encourage healthy debate, challenge directly while caring personally and stand behind team decisions. You act as an owner, stepping in when needed and doing what’s necessary for the team’s success.

Why Join Us? 

- Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies and you can be part of this exciting story.
- Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
- Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
- Collaborate with a diverse, passionate and talented team.
- Competitive compensation, equity program and other benefits (depending on location).
Ready to Move the Needle? 

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

As Energetic Materials Engineer in the Warhead team, you will be the technical authority ensuring the energetic materials in our systems are properly selected, tested and qualified for their intended use. - Master’s degree or PhD in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering or a related field.

- Hands-on experience with analytical techniques such as DSC, TGA, FTIR and Raman spectroscopy.

- Experience characterizing and evaluating materials in accordance with NATO qualification standards.

- Experience running qualification programs for materials used in pyrotechnic or energetic systems.

- Understanding of materials manufacturing processes and quality controls.

- Fluency in English required.

Our talented team is at the heart of this mission, and we are looking for an Industrial Software Engineer - Railway Applications to join us in developing robust software solutions that operate reliably in real-world railway environments.

What you will do 

- Industrial Software Development: Design, implement and maintain robust application software for industrial and railway products using C++, C#, Python or comparable technologies.

- Commissioning & Field Support: Support installation, commissioning and field testing on prototypes, test systems and rail vehicles, including travel to customer and test sites when required.

- Diagnostics & Troubleshooting: Analyse logs, interfaces and system behaviour to identify root causes and solve software and integration issues efficiently.

- Testing & Validation: Develop unit, integration and system-level tests and contribute to HIL/SIL or other validation activities where relevant.

- Software Architecture, Quality & Controlled Releases: Own software architecture and release discipline, including configuration and version control, code reviews, test evidence and controlled software releases.

- Product Cybersecurity: Own threat assessment, secure access and software updates, vulnerability handling and lifecycle security maintenance; coordinate specialist security reviews and work with Systems/RAMS on vehicle interfaces and safety consequences.

- Technical Guidance & Mentoring: Review implementations, share practical software-engineering practices and mentor colleagues to strengthen consistency, maintainability and technical ownership across the team.

- Tools & Data: Develop tools for configuration, testing, diagnostics, data acquisition and analysis that support engineering and field activities.

- Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Maintain clear software and interface documentation and improve existing code as Traila products mature from development into deployed systems.

What you bring 

- Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical technical experience.

- Hands-on professional software-development experience in an industrial, automation, automotive, machinery or comparable technical environment.

- Proven professional railway software experience, including products released and maintained in service.

- Strong practical programming skills in C++, C#, Python or a comparable industrial software stack; you do not need to be an expert in every language listed.

- Experience developing software that interacts with real hardware, devices or physical systems.

- Experience taking software beyond prototypes into tested, maintainable and deployable industrial use.

- Practical railway software lifecycle experience aligned with EN 50716:2023, including requirements traceability, configuration management and verification/validation appropriate to the required software integrity level; relevant EN 50128 / EN 50657 predecessor experience is also valuable.

- Practical embedded or industrial cybersecurity experience, including secure credentials and access, signed software updates and rollback, and handling vulnerabilities in released products.

- Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across software, communication and hardware interfaces.

- Experience with Git and structured software-development workflows.

- A practical ownership mindset: comfortable working directly with prototypes, test equipment and deployed systems and driving technical problems through to resolution.

- Ability to work effectively across engineering disciplines and communicate technical issues clearly.

- Fluent English; German is a strong advantage.

Nice to have 

- Experience with industrial Linux, embedded Linux, automation or control systems.

- MATLAB/Simulink, HIL/SIL testing, data acquisition or condition-monitoring experience.

- Working knowledge of railway cybersecurity under CLC/TS 50701:2023 and of EN IEC 62443-4-1 (secure development) and EN IEC 62443-4-2 (component security) is desirable.

- Familiarity with EN 50155 and EN 50126 for equipment integration and collaboration with Systems/RAMS.

- Experience in a regulated or safety-relevant product-development environment.

Benefits

- Flexible working hours and home office options.

- Annual professional development allowance for courses, certifications and conferences.

- Competitive compensation with milestone bonus scheme and full Swiss social coverage.

title: (Senior) Integration Engineer, ERP (Oracle)
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 

About the role

BLP only works when it talks to our customers’ ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for enterprise customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You’ll lead our Oracle integrations across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards, while also contributing to other integrations.

What you’ll do

- Own our integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards and ensure their market fit, usability and reliability.

- Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, direct DB access and file transfers.

- Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them.

- Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers.

- Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, and document them so teammates can pick them up.

- Enable technical project managers to consult on, install and configure mature integrations.

What you'll bring

- Hands-on integration experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, ideally more than one. You have built or maintained interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user.

- Experience with the native interfaces of at least one of these:

- Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP: REST and SOAP web services, File-Based Data Import (FBDI) through the ERP Integration Service, and data extraction with BI Publisher or BI Cloud Connector (BICC).

- NetSuite: SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL, SuiteScript 2.x (e.g., RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts), and Token-Based Authentication or OAuth 2.0.

- JD Edwards EnterpriseOne: AIS Server and Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), and Z-file interface tables (e.g., F0411Z1) with their batch processors.

- A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in Oracle ERPs: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching.

- Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go, that works for us.

- A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role.

- Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region.

Nice to have: 

- Experience with both cloud (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite) and on-premise (JD Edwards) environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access in Fusion, governance limits in NetSuite).

- Extensive experience with SQL, common data formats (JSON, XML, CSV) and transports (REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP).

- Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

- Integration experience with other ERPs, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Infor.

Integration Engineer or Senior Integration Engineer

We hire at both levels. Four things decide where you start: years of experience, breadth of experience, coaching experience and scope.

Integration Engineer 

- Years: 2+ years of hands-on integration work, including Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

- Breadth: in-depth experience with one Oracle ERP and its interfaces.

- Coaching: you learn quickly from senior colleagues and share what you learn with the team.

- Scope: you deliver and maintain integrations and resolve issues independently, with guidance on architecture decisions.

Senior Integration Engineer 

- Years: 5+ years of hands-on integration work, several of them with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

- Breadth: integration experience across two or more of Fusion, NetSuite and JD Edwards, or across Oracle and other ERPs, in cloud and on-premise environments.

- Coaching: you have coached or mentored other engineers and help technical project managers grow.

- Scope: you own our Oracle integrations end to end, set technical direction and take on the most complex customer cases.

Why BLP 

- Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live.

- Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards.

- Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.

- Team: regular team events.

Practical information

- Location: our Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week, or remotely from anywhere in Europe.

- If you work remotely, we pay for regular visits and stays in Zurich.

- Employment: full-time, permanent.

Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation and control stack of the fusion energy reactors of the future.

Our technology enables effective and reliable operation, monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices — which will one day provide clean, practically limitless power to the grid. We have spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and have just completed our pre-seed fundraise.

We are looking for a Senior Control Systems Engineer to join our founding team in Lausanne and help build our core technology.

This job is for you if you are a passionate engineer with deep knowledge cutting across real-time / embedded systems, software and hardware, and excited about building the systems to monitor and control real-world fusion plasmas.

Tasks

- Implement real-time control, analysis, data acquisition systems in the kHz to MHz range, as individual contributor and in a team.

- Fluency in a mix of high-level and low-level languages such as C, C++, Rust, MATLAB/Simulink, Python. Obsession with code quality, testing and reliability.

- Experience with distributed real-time systems, real-time networking and field buses and/or SCADA is an advantage.

- Experience with embedded/μC/FPGA technologies and/or safety critical systems is an advantage.

Benefits

- The unique opportunity to play a foundational role at a dynamic, fast-growing startup, shaping the technical solutions and products from the ground up.

- The opportunity to build cutting edge technology to monitor and control plasmas in real fusion devices, working side-by-side with leading plasma and control experts.

- Great working conditions, located in Lausanne, Switzerland, a city and country known for its high quality of life.

You will develop a thorough understanding of H55’s corporate framework, including its shareholder arrangements, financing agreements and key contractual commitments, and translate these obligations into clear responsibilities, practical policies and timely action.

You will oversee finance, HR, IT, facilities and general administration, supported by internal specialists and external partners. As a central point of coordination for Swiss site matters, you will help teams resolve operational issues, improve ways of working and ensure corporate services meet the needs of the business.

Key responsibilities

Corporate governance and administration 

- Coordinate Board and shareholder matters with the CEO and legal counsel, including meeting preparation, resolutions, corporate records and follow through on decisions.

- Maintain a clear overview of the company’s corporate structure, shareholder arrangements, financing agreements and material contractual commitments.

- Track related obligations and deadlines, ensuring clear ownership and timely action across relevant functions.

- Ensure governance requirements, delegated authorities and approval processes are understood and applied.

- Manage relationships with external legal advisers, insurers and corporate service providers.

Policies, compliance and internal controls 

- Coordinate the development, implementation and review of company policies in line with business needs, investor commitments and applicable requirements.

- Work with functional owners on anti corruption, cybersecurity and incident response, related party transactions, internal financial controls, global trade controls, personal data protection, and health and safety.

- Translate policies into practical procedures, with clear responsibilities and guidance for employees and managers.

- Coordinate communication and training, maintaining appropriate records.

- Monitor implementation, address gaps with relevant owners and bring matters requiring attention to the leadership team.

Swiss site and corporate services 

- Coordinate Swiss site administration and corporate support activities, working closely with production, engineering and other teams.

- Oversee facilities, workplace services and external providers, ensuring a safe and effective working environment.

- Help resolve site issues and coordinate improvements that support daily operations.

- Oversee IT services and infrastructure through internal resources and external partners.

- Drive improvements in digital tools, systems and administrative processes.

- Coordinate site procedures and business continuity arrangements with relevant specialists.

HR oversight and organisational support 

- Oversee the HR function, supporting the HR team in delivering effective people processes and reliable daily operations.

- Work with the CEO and managers on workforce planning, organisational changes and recruitment priorities.

- Ensure employment administration, payroll coordination and HR policies are managed consistently and appropriately.

- Support clear internal communication and effective collaboration across teams.

Financial management and business support 

- Oversee budgeting, forecasting, cash flow planning and financial reporting, supported by internal finance resources and external partners.

- Ensure reliable accounting, statutory reporting, tax and audit processes.

- Provide clear financial visibility to support business decisions and resource allocation.

- Maintain appropriate financial controls, spending discipline and approval processes.

- Monitor costs and commitments with budget owners and programme teams.

- Support investor reporting, financing activities and due diligence when required.

Leadership and continuous improvement 

- Lead and support a small multidisciplinary team, coordinating external expertise where needed.

- Set priorities, allocate resources and ensure actions are completed.

- Build trusted working relationships with managers and colleagues across the organisation.

- Simplify processes and adapt corporate services as the business evolves.

Your profile

- Experience in a broad finance and administration, corporate services or business operations leadership role.

- A solid finance background, with experience taking responsibility beyond the finance function.

- Strong understanding of corporate governance and confidence working with corporate documents, contractual commitments and legal advisers.

- Experience implementing policies and translating compliance requirements into practical ways of working.

- Experience coordinating site operations or corporate support functions, ideally in a technology or industrial environment.

- Familiarity with the Swiss business environment and relevant administrative and statutory requirements.

- Ability to lead across different functions, drawing on the expertise of colleagues and external partners.

- Sound judgement, discretion and the ability to build trust with people across the organisation.

- A practical, collaborative approach, with strong organisational skills and a willingness to get involved in day to day matters.

- Fluent English and French.

- A relevant qualification in finance, business administration or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

You do not need to be a specialist in every function. You should be comfortable asking the right questions, bringing together the right expertise and taking responsibility for progress.

Why join H55?

At H55, you will work closely with the people developing electric aviation technology and help create the conditions for them to succeed. Your decisions will shape how we work, support our teams and move the business forward.

You will have room to bring ideas, improve how things are done and see the results of your work. If you enjoy connecting people, making sense of complex issues and turning decisions into action, this role offers the opportunity to do all three.

We would like to hear from you

title: Lead Analytics Engineer
description:
Do you love turning messy business questions into data people can trust? Can you connect the customer journey from the first marketing touch through sales conversion, revenue, retention, and product usage and explain the numbers equally clearly to an engineer, a CMO, and a CFO? AIHR is looking for a Lead Agentic Analytics Engineer to become the hands-on functional lead of our two-person Data & Analytics team. You will own the translation of cross-functional business questions into trusted metrics, governed semantic models, and decision-ready agentic analytics; set the analytical direction; and build the most critical models yourself. You are transforming raw data into governed products that drive decision-making for our business partners. 

About AIHR 

Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the global market leader in online training for HR professionals. We support customers in more than 140 countries, including organizations such as Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. Our goal is to continuously upskill and empower one million HR professionals. 

Today, we are an international team of more than 100 people representing over 30 nationalities. We are driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow, while staying friendly, enthusiastic, and committed to helping each other succeed. 

Working at AIHR means taking real responsibility, improving how we operate, and getting the freedom to develop in new areas and shape your role as the company grows. 

Role and Responsibilities 

AIHR's Data & Analytics team is part of Business Operations. You will work alongside Vahid, our Senior Data Engineer, and report to Leo, our VP of Business Operations. Our ingestion and warehouse foundation is largely established: data from systems such as HubSpot and our own LMS moves through ETL pipelines into Snowflake. Through special Projects, we are building governed semantic layers on top so the business can self-serve trusted analytics through Power BI, Metabase, and AI tools.

Your role owns the step that matters most: translating a business question into a clear definition, a well-designed model, and conversational/agentic analytics that your leadership trusts. You will set the analytical architecture, dbt standards, and roadmap, while Vahid focuses on ingestion, warehouse reliability, and engineering implementation. You will both build: you will personally deliver the most critical business models, review implementations, and ensure the outputs are usable by the business.

This role has no direct reports. Your colleague, Vahid, remains managed by the VP of Business Operations, while you have clear functional decision rights over metric definitions, semantic-model design, analytical quality, dbt standards, and technical priorities. It is designed for someone who wants to lead through expertise while remaining close to the work. 

What You'll Own 

- Own and execute a rolling one-year Data & Analytics roadmap, balancing urgent business needs with foundational work. Guide Vahid through clear priorities, design reviews, code review, and reusable modeling patterns. 

- Lead discovery across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Finance to uncover the decision behind a request and translate it into agreed metric definitions, governed semantic layers, and data models that connect the full customer lifecycle. 

- Set the analytical architecture and dbt standards; design, build, test, and document the most critical governed models yourself using SQL and dbt. 

- Own the full-funnel measurement framework—from marketing reach, demand generation, attribution, and customer acquisition cost through lead and pipeline conversion, sales cycle, bookings, and revenue to onboarding, product adoption, expansion, renewal, churn, and customer lifetime value. Keep core recurring-revenue definitions finance-grade and reconciled while showing how upstream activity drives downstream customer outcomes. 

- Own the logic and quality behind executive dashboards and self-service analytics across Power BI, Metabase, and AI-enabled interfaces. Present the results to senior leaders, explain every assumption, and respond constructively to challenge. 

- Partner closely with Vahid on warehouse and pipeline requirements, resolve conflicting numbers at the source, and raise the technical quality of the team. Apply AI where it improves development speed or data access, while using sound judgment around privacy, governance, validation, and trust. 

A Typical Week 

This is a hands-on lead role. The exact balance will shift with business priorities, but you should expect roughly half your time to remain close to the data—building, reviewing, and investigating—and the rest to be split across discovery, functional leadership, and decision support.

- Design or improve a dbt model that connects data across HubSpot, our LMS, billing, or other source systems; write the SQL, tests, documentation, and metric logic needed to put it into production. 

- Run discovery sessions with leaders in Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, or Finance to clarify the decision they need to make, challenge the requested metric, and agree on the definition. 

- Work side by side with Vahid on source-data requirements, architecture choices, and implementation; review code and unblock delivery without handing off all of the technical work. 

- Investigate a commercial or customer-lifecycle question, improve an executive or functional dashboard, and present the conclusion—including assumptions and limitations—to the relevant leadership team. 

- Reprioritize the Data & Analytics roadmap, resolve competing requests, and invest in the semantic layer, governance, and reusable modeling foundations that reduce future ad hoc work. 

What Success Looks Like 

Within your first three months, you have established a clear operating model with Vahid, mapped ownership of the most important metrics, agreed the Data & Analytics roadmap, and resolved at least one material conflicting-number problem.

Within six months, AIHR has a governed customer-lifecycle domain in dbt and an executive view connecting acquisition and pipeline to revenue, retention, and product usage, and has launched the first MVP of our agentic analytics platform to drive self-serve adoption. The underlying definitions are documented, reconciled where relevant, and trusted across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Finance.

Within twelve months, two or three priority business domains are governed end to end, leadership can trace performance from acquisition through lifetime value using consistent numbers, self-service adoption is growing, and Vahid can independently implement the modeling patterns and quality standards you established.

Throughout, you remain hands-on in SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and analytics while setting direction, coaching through the work, and earning leadership's trust in both the numbers and the roadmap. 

We offer 

- A high-impact role as the functional lead of a small Data & Analytics team, with end-to-end ownership of the semantic layer behind company-wide decisions. 

- Competitive, benchmarked compensation. 

- Substantial autonomy to shape your day-to-day work, with regular growth conversations and support for your career goals. 

- Flexible working hours and work-from-home arrangements after onboarding. 

- 26 paid holidays per year, plus one extra day for each of your first five years at AIHR. 

- The option to exchange any two public holidays for two days of your choice. 

- A work-from-anywhere policy that lets you work abroad for up to 20 days per calendar year. 

- A pension plan, four Trust Days for ad hoc recovery, and access to the OpenUp mental health platform. 

- A personal development budget, training opportunities, and the books you need to keep learning. 

- All public-transport expenses covered through an NS Business Card, plus a MacBook and the equipment you need. 

- A beautiful office opposite Rotterdam Central Station, a satellite office in Amsterdam, daily chef-prepared lunch, regular drinks, team activities, and free access to the office gym. 

Get a taste of working at AIHR in our AIHR Benefits Guide . 

Apply for the Job 

Are you excited to become our Lead Analytics Engineer? We would love to hear from you. We are aiming for a start date in December 2026 or January 2027. 

P.S. If this role excites you but you do not meet every point, we still encourage you to apply. We care about the evidence behind your experience and your potential to grow—not a perfect checklist. 

Who you are 

You are a hands-on technical leader: commercially sharp, calm under challenge, and confident enough to defend your numbers in any room. You also have the patience to build data foundations properly and raise the quality of the work around you.

- You bring 5+ years of experience across analytics engineering, BI, data engineering, or business-facing analytics roles, including substantial recent hands-on analytics engineering and evidence of leading work beyond your own delivery. 

- You have a proven track record of building semantic layers or governed dimensional models end-to-end—from business discovery and metric definition to production models and adoption—not only dashboards. 

- You have expert SQL and data modeling skills, strong production experience with dbt, and hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable warehouse, along with a BI tool such as Power BI, Looker, Omni, or Metabase. 

- You bring strong financial acumen, but your analytical experience extends across the full customer lifecycle. You can connect marketing acquisition and attribution, sales pipeline and conversion, revenue and unit economics, customer retention and expansion, and product adoption into one coherent model. You understand how bookings, billings, recognized revenue, cash, ARR, and NRR differ without treating financial reporting as the whole analytical problem. 

- You have worked in a B2B SaaS, subscription, fintech, or marketplace business and have modeled several stages of the funnel spanning marketing or growth, sales, customer success and retention, and product usage—rather than specializing in only one function. 

- You explain complex logic in plain language, push back constructively on senior stakeholders, and build trust without becoming defensive—even when you discover that your own number or assumption needs to change. 

- You take pride in driving the analytical roadmap and architectural vision, leading technical work through architecture and code review, and mentoring experienced colleagues without relying on formal authority. You want the majority of your role to remain hands-on. 

- You balance pragmatic execution with rigorous analysis, adapting precision levels to fit business needs and operational constraints. 

- You are used to leveraging a broad range of AI tools to boost your productivity and know how to configure them to produce output that lives up to our quality standards and best practices 

Nice to Have 

- Earlier experience in RevOps, Growth, FP&A, product analytics, or commercial analytics, ideally combined with experience in a fast-growing scale-up. 

- Experience with HubSpot, marketing automation and attribution data, subscription or billing data, LMS or product-usage event data, Personio, or building semantic layers for AI-enabled and conversational analytics.

title: Senior Sales Operations (SalesOps) Manager
Senior Partnership Manager
description:
Do you look at a partner program that works and immediately see what it could become at three times the size? Are you the kind of person who owns your number and a running book of business, while designing the channels that will carry the next phase of growth? Do you want a mandate that is yours: rethink how we work with resellers, open up consultancies and universities, and work out where tech partnerships fit? And do you like variety, where growing an existing commercial partner one day and presenting a new partner model to leadership the next is just part of the job? 

AIHR is looking for a Senior Partnership Manager to grow our commercial partner book and build the partner programs that take us into the next phase of growth within our Sales Department. This is not a marketing position. 

About AIHR 

Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spanning 140+ countries, including companies such as Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals. 

We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players. 

Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility. For a senior hire, that means real ownership: the room to shape a commercial channel, direct access to leadership, and the potential to craft your own role as the program grows. 

Role and Responsibilities 

As Senior Partnership Manager, you come in with the ambition to triple the AIHR partnership program. Today that program is a global portfolio of 130+ commercial partners driving primarily single-seat e-commerce sales, plus a reseller channel that brings in B2B business. Both work, and both have far more potential than we currently capture. Your job is to optimize what we have, evolve it into a set of structured commercial partner programs, and work out which new channels deserve investment. 

This is a quota-carrying role with a build mandate. You manage a running book of business with our existing commercial partners and stay their main point of contact. On top of that, you design and launch larger partner programs with resellers, HR consultancies, system integrators, and universities. We have a strong belief that these partners, HR implementation consultants in particular, are well placed to position our courses with their clients, and that this can become a major revenue stream for AIHR. 

Your work is built from three connected workstreams: 

- Grow the existing partner channel: run the existing book, grow partner revenue, and identify the commercial opportunities that drive meaningful additional business. 

- Build the extended partner programs: restructure the reseller program so it generates more predictable, repeatable B2B revenue, and extend it to consultancies, system integrators, and universities. 

- Define the tech partnership go-to-market: research which commercial models fit AIHR, propose the strategy, then test, validate, and build out what works. 

You’ll report to the Team Lead for Channel & Strategic Partnerships, work closely with Marketing, Sales, and Product to get your partners what they need, and act as the partnership network’s advocate across the wider commercial team. You will regularly present proposals and results to AIHR leadership. 

On a typical day 

On a typical Monday morning, you start with your pipeline. Your existing partner book is quick to review: a few conversations need a nudge, two QBRs are coming up. The larger partnerships take more thought. Other companies in our industry have built significant revenue through resellers, consultancies, and universities, but these deals have a longer sales cycle, so you always keep several opportunities moving at the same time. Today that means a value-added reseller in the middle of a negotiation, a prospective university that wants to add AIHR’s courses to its 2027 academic year, and a consultancy that signed last month and now needs to get moving. 

After lunch you speak with the managing partner of a German niche consultancy that does a lot of HR implementation work. Her clients keep running into the same problem: the new system goes live, and the HR team lacks the skills to get the most out of it. You talk through how capability building could become part of her offering, with AIHR as the partner behind it. She is interested, and you agree to work out a commercial proposal together. Next you work on an enablement session for consultants, covering what they need to know about our courses, how they bring AIHR into a client conversation, what a first joint win could look like, and you brief Marketing on the materials their consultants will need. 

The next morning is for outreach. You build a sourcing list of potential partners in a segment you want to open up, and you contact them yourself. AIHR has a very good name in the HR industry, and that usually helps open doors. Later that week you run a QBR with one of your strongest commercial partners. You review their numbers together, agree on two concrete actions, and set a date to check back in. You identify where there is room to grow the relationship and push for more where performance has stalled. You also notice that a large part of their customer base works in corporate HR teams, so you bring in a colleague from Sales to explore a B2B opportunity through the same relationship. 

On Thursday you are back with the value-added reseller. They want to bundle our courses with their own services. It is a model we haven’t proven yet. There is no standard agreement to pull off the shelf, so you work with our Sales Engineer to design the deal while you negotiate it: what they sell, how they are rewarded, how revenue is generated, and what would tell you both it is working. You treat it as a pilot and agree on a first version you can learn from. Some of these experiments will not work out. The ones that do become the programs you build the channel on, and you will be the person who figured them out. 

You close out the week updating your forecast and walking your manager through where the existing book, pipeline, and new programs stand. Friday afternoon wraps with a quick team catch-up and, if you're in the Rotterdam office, our regular Friday drinks. 

Your Target 

This is a quota-carrying role. Your number is built from the revenue of the partner book you run and the new partner programs you launch. In your first year, that means growing revenue across the existing partner portfolio, a restructured reseller program, the first signed partners among consultancies, system integrators, and universities, and a tech partnership go-to-market strategy that has been proposed, tested, and started generating commercial opportunities. 

We offer 

- Competitive, benchmarked compensation, including a commission plan tied to your target 

- A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team 

- A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Millenniumtoren), with a satellite office in Amsterdam 

- 26 paid holidays per year 

- Exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice 

- Work-from-anywhere policy: up to 20 days a year working abroad 

- Pension plan 

- Access to the OpenUp mental health platform 

- Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read 

- All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card) 

- MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work 

- Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities 

- Free access to the office gym 

Get a taste of AIHR experience and check out our AIHR Benefits Guide ! 

Who you are 

- 7+ years of experience in commercial partnerships, channel sales, business development, or strategic account management , ideally in SaaS, e-commerce, or EdTech 

- A proven track record of owning and delivering against a revenue target , with direct responsibility for pipeline, partner acquisition, and growth 

- A track record of building or restructuring a commercial partner program, not only running one: reseller, consultancy, system integrator, or tech partnerships 

- Experience creating a go-to-market strategy for a new channel and taking it from proposal to signed partners and first revenue 

- Experienced in sourcing, negotiating, and closing complex commercial partnerships with senior stakeholders 

- AI-first mindset to drive & improve operational efficiencies 

- A natural relationship builder — people trust you and want to keep working with you, from partner owners to senior executives 

- Highly organized and execution-oriented, able to run an active partner book and build new programs at the same time without dropping the ball 

- Commercially sharp, comfortable structuring and negotiating larger agreements, setting revenue targets with partners, and having direct conversations when performance needs to move 

- Able to work with ambiguity and shape your own mandate where no playbook exists yet 

- A strong, clear communicator in English, comfortable building business cases and presenting commercial proposals to senior leadership 

- Available to work at least 3 days a week from our Rotterdam office 

Nice to have 

- Experience with HubSpot 

- Background in HR tech, EdTech, or SaaS industry 

- An existing network among HR consultancies, system integrators, resellers, or HR tech companies 

Apply for the job 

Are you excited to become our Senior Partnership Manager ? Then we'd love to hear from you! 

P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit.

title: Test Engineer
description:

Dan is deze stage in nowcasting en econometrie precies wat je zoekt. 

Dit is jouw uitdaging 

Bij het ramen van de kwartaalcijfers van het bbp (economische groei) gebruiken we voor een aantal bedrijfstakken momenteel een relatief eenvoudige methode: de ontwikkeling van het aantal banen dient als benadering voor de economische activiteit. Dit gebeurt omdat directe en tijdige broninformatie ontbreekt. Een belangrijk gevolg hiervan is dat we de eerste ramingen later vaak moeten bijstellen wanneer er meer volledige data beschikbaar komt bij de definitieve raming (ongeveer anderhalf jaar later). 

Het is aan jou om deze methodiek te verbeteren. 

Je gaat een geavanceerder model ontwikkelen waarmee we de economische activiteit van deze bedrijfstakken kort na afloop van de verslagperiode nauwkeuriger kunnen inschatten. Dit wordt ook wel “nowcasting” genoemd. Het doel is om dichter bij de uiteindelijke realisatie te zitten en daarmee het aantal en de omvang van latere bijstellingen te verkleinen. 

Een belangrijk onderdeel van jouw opdracht is om te onderzoeken welke databronnen tijdig beschikbaar zijn en we kunnen gebruiken als input voor dit model. Vervolgens ga je met behulp van historische data eerdere verslagperiodes simuleren. Zo kun je analyseren of jouw voorgestelde methode daadwerkelijk beter presteert dan de huidige aanpak, bijvoorbeeld door te kijken naar kleinere bijstellingen.
